rootChoices.label: Course
rootChoices.definition: Single structured sequence of one or more educational activities that aims to develop a prescribed set of competencies of learners.

rootChoices.label: Learning Opportunity Profile
rootChoices.definition: Entity describing an educational or training opportunity.

rootChoices.label: Learning Program
rootChoices.definition: Set of learning opportunities that leads to an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate.

ceterms:Course.label: Course
ceterms:Course.definition: Single structured sequence of one or more educational activities that aims to develop a prescribed set of competencies of learners.

ceterms:IdentifierValue.label: Identifier Value
ceterms:IdentifierValue.definition: Means of identifying a resource, typically consisting of an alphanumeric token and a context or scheme from which that token originates.

ceterms:CredentialAlignmentObject.label: Credential Alignment Object
ceterms:CredentialAlignmentObject.definition: Entity describing an affiliation or association between an entity such as a credential, learning opportunity or assessment and another entity in a structured framework such as a concept scheme, enumerated list, or competency framework.

ceterms:LearningResource.label: Learning Resource
ceterms:LearningResource.definition: Entity that is used as part of an learning activity (e.g. a textbook) or that describes (e.g. a lesson plan) or records the educational activity (e.g. an audio- or video-recording of a lesson).

ceterms:LearningOpportunity.label: Learning Opportunity
ceterms:LearningOpportunity.definition: Structured and unstructured learning and development opportunities based in direct experience, formal and informal study, observation, and involvement in discourse and practice.

ceterms:Assessment.label: Assessment
ceterms:Assessment.definition: Direct, indirect, formative, and summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality of an entity, performance, or outcome of an action.

ceterms:ConditionProfile.label: Condition Profile
ceterms:ConditionProfile.definition: Entity describing a constraint, prerequisite, entry condition, or requirement.

ceterms:JurisdictionProfile.label: Jurisdiction Profile
ceterms:JurisdictionProfile.definition: Geo-political information about applicable geographic areas and their exceptions.

ceterms:Place.label: Place
ceterms:Place.definition: Entity describing a physical location or geospatial area.

ceterms:ContactPoint.label: Contact Point
ceterms:ContactPoint.definition: Means of contacting an organization or its representative.

ceterms:CollectionMember.label: Collection Member
ceterms:CollectionMember.definition: Provides information about the membership of a resource in a Collection.

ceterms:AlignmentObject.label: Alignment Object
ceterms:AlignmentObject.definition: Entity describing the relationship between two nodes in different frameworks.

ceterms:DurationProfile.label: Duration Profile
ceterms:DurationProfile.definition: Entity describing the temporal aspects of a resource.

ceterms:CostProfile.label: Cost Profile
ceterms:CostProfile.definition: Entity that describes direct costs one would incur if one were to pursue a credential, assessment, learning opportunity, or aspects thereof.

ceterms:ValueProfile.label: Value Profile
ceterms:ValueProfile.definition: A description of value awarded for, required by, or otherwise related to the resource.

ceterms:accreditedBy.label: Accredited By
ceterms:accreditedBy.definition: Quality assurance organization that provides official authorization to, or approval of, a credential, organization, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:accreditedIn.label: Accredited In
ceterms:accreditedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential, learning opportunity or assessment is accredited.

ceterms:advancedStandingFrom.label: Advanced Standing From
ceterms:advancedStandingFrom.definition: Resource that has its time or cost reduced by another resource.

ceterms:alternateName.label: Alternate Name
ceterms:alternateName.definition: Alias for the entity including acronyms, alpha-numeric notations, and other forms of name abbreviations in common use.

ceterms:approvedBy.label: Approved By
ceterms:approvedBy.definition: Agent that pronounces favorable judgment for this resource.

ceterms:approvedIn.label: Approved In
ceterms:approvedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which an organization pronounces favorable judgment for this resource.

ceterms:approximateDateEffective.label: Approximate Date Effective
ceterms:approximateDateEffective.definition: Approximate date after which this resource is available or applicable.
ceterms:approximateDateEffective.note: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateDateEffective.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:dateEffective.

ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.label: Approximate Expiration Date
ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.definition: Approximate date beyond which the resource is no longer offered or available.
ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.note: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:expirationDate.

ceterms:assessmentMethodDescription.label: Assessment Method Description
ceterms:assessmentMethodDescription.definition: Description of the methods used to conduct assessment.

ceterms:assessmentMethodType.label: Assessment Method Type
ceterms:assessmentMethodType.definition: Type of method used to conduct an assessment; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:assessmentMethodType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:AssessmentMethod vocabulary.

ceterms:atLevel.label: At Level
ceterms:atLevel.definition: Indicates the stage or level of achievement in a progression of learning.
ceterms:atLevel.usageNote: Indicates the level an audience will hold upon completion or attainment. To indicate the level of the audience that should be qualified to pursue this resource, use audienceLevel.

ceterms:audienceLevelType.label: Audience Level Type
ceterms:audienceLevelType.definition: Type of level indicating a point in a progression through an educational or training context, for which the resource is intended; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:audienceLevelType.usageNote: Best practice is to use terms from the CTDL Audience Level vocabulary.

ceterms:audienceType.label: Audience Type
ceterms:audienceType.definition: The type of audience for which the resource is applicable, intended, or useful; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:audienceType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:Audience vocabulary.

ceterms:availabilityListing.label: Availability Listing
ceterms:availabilityListing.definition: Listing of online and/or physical locations where a resource can be found or pursued.

ceterms:availableAt.label: Available At
ceterms:availableAt.definition: Physical location where the credential, assessment, or learning opportunity can be pursued.

ceterms:availableOnlineAt.label: Available Online At
ceterms:availableOnlineAt.definition: Online location where the credential, assessment, or learning opportunity can be pursued.

ceterms:classification.label: Classification
ceterms:classification.definition: Category or classification of this resource.
ceterms:classification.usageNote: Where a more specific property exists, such as ceterms:naics, ceterms:isicV4, ceterms:credentialType, etc., use that property instead of this one.

ceterms:coPrerequisite.label: Co-Prerequisite
ceterms:coPrerequisite.definition: Resource that must be completed prior to, or pursued at the same time as, this resource.

ceterms:codedNotation.label: Coded Notation
ceterms:codedNotation.definition: Set of alpha-numeric symbols as defined by the body responsible for this resource that uniquely identifies this resource and supports its discovery and use.
ceterms:codedNotation.note: Examples include course codes (e.g., "ENG101"), US Standard Occupation Codes (e.g., "31-9091"), North American Industry Classification System codes (e.g., "236117"), or any other bespoke code used by the provider of the resource to identify it.
ceterms:codedNotation.usageNote: For identifiers that come from a recognized identification scheme use the specific property for that identifier type, such as ceterms:opeID, ceterms:ncesID, ceterms:leiCode, etc., or use ceterms:identifier so that the identification schema can be named.

ceterms:commonConditions.label: Common Conditions
ceterms:commonConditions.definition: Set constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements that are shared across an organization, organizational subdivision, set of credentials, or category of entities and activities.

ceterms:commonCosts.label: Common Costs
ceterms:commonCosts.definition: Set of costs maintained at an organizational or sub-organizational level, which apply to this credential, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:complaintProcess.label: Complaint Process
ceterms:complaintProcess.definition: Description of a process for handling complaints about a resource or related resources.

ceterms:corequisite.label: Corequisite
ceterms:corequisite.definition: Resources that must be pursued concurrently.
ceterms:corequisite.note: Includes dual (double) degrees that cannot be earned independently of each other.

ceterms:creditUnitTypeDescription.label: Credit Unit Type Description
ceterms:creditUnitTypeDescription.definition: Detailed description of credit unit type.

ceterms:ctid.label: CTID
ceterms:ctid.definition: Globally unique Credential Transparency Identifier (CTID) by which the creator, owner or provider of a resource recognizes it in transactions with the external environment (e.g., in verifiable claims involving the resource).
ceterms:ctid.note: The CTID is the equivalent of a version identifier for the resource. Different versions of a resource are considered distinct expressions and each must be assigned its own CTID. Each version of a resource can have only one CTID assigned. However, a single version of a resource may have distinct identifier values for both the ctid property and the credentialId property. In such a case both identifiers will be recognized by the resource creator/owner/provider in transactions with the external environment.

ceterms:dateEffective.label: Date Effective
ceterms:dateEffective.definition: Date after which this resource is available or applicable.
ceterms:dateEffective.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateDateEffective instead.

ceterms:deliveryType.label: Delivery Type
ceterms:deliveryType.definition: Type of means by which a learning opportunity or assessment is delivered to credential seekers and by which they interact; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:deliveryType.usageNote: Best practice is to use concepts from a controlled vocabulary such as the ceterms:DeliveryType vocabulary.

ceterms:deliveryTypeDescription.label: Delivery Type Description
ceterms:deliveryTypeDescription.definition: Detailed description of the delivery type of an assessment or learning opportunity.

ceterms:description.label: Description
ceterms:description.definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.

ceterms:developmentProcess.label: Development Process
ceterms:developmentProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource was created.

ceterms:entryCondition.label: Entry Condition
ceterms:entryCondition.definition: Requirements for entry into a credentialing program, a learning opportunity, or an assessment, including credentials, transcripts, records of previous experience, or other forms of entry documentation.
ceterms:entryCondition.usageNote: For Courses required to be taken before entry into another Course, use prerequisite.

ceterms:estimatedCost.label: Estimated Cost
ceterms:estimatedCost.definition: Estimated cost of a credential, learning opportunity or assessment.

ceterms:estimatedDuration.label: Estimated Duration
ceterms:estimatedDuration.definition: Estimated time it will take to complete an activity, event, or resource.

ceterms:expirationDate.label: Expiration Date
ceterms:expirationDate.definition: Date beyond which the resource is no longer offered or available.
ceterms:expirationDate.note: Previously earned, completed, or attained resources may still be valid even if they are no longer offered.
ceterms:expirationDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateStartDate instead.

ceterms:financialAssistance.label: Financial Assistance
ceterms:financialAssistance.definition: Entity that describes financial assistance for which this resource qualifies.
ceterms:financialAssistance.note: The type of resource that the financial aid is associated with is dependent on context.

ceterms:hasOffering.label: Has Offering
ceterms:hasOffering.definition: Indicates an offering and typical schedule.
ceterms:hasOffering.usageNote: Only use this property when it is necessary and useful to provide data about specific offerings of a learning opportunity or assessment, such as particular combinations of schedule, location, and delivery.

ceterms:hasPart.label: Has Part
ceterms:hasPart.definition: Indicates a separately identifiable and independently useful component of the entity.
ceterms:hasPart.note: Such partitive components can frequently be used in more than one context.

ceterms:hasProxy.label: Has Proxy
ceterms:hasProxy.definition: Indicates a resource that acts as a stand-in for the resource.

ceterms:hasRegulatoryInformation.label: Has Regulatory Information
ceterms:hasRegulatoryInformation.definition: Information about this resource that is provided in order to comply with a regulation or legal requirement.

ceterms:hasSupportService.label: Has Support Service
ceterms:hasSupportService.definition: Reference to a relevant support service.

ceterms:identifier.label: Identifier
ceterms:identifier.definition: Alphanumeric token that identifies this resource and information about the token's originating context or scheme.
ceterms:identifier.usageNote: Where a specific property for the originating context or scheme exists, such as ceterms:opeID, ceterms:ncesID, ceterms:leiCode, etc., use that property instead of this one. Where the identifier has no nameable originating context or scheme other than that of the resource being identified, ceterms:codedNotation may be used.

ceterms:inCatalog.label: In Catalog
ceterms:inCatalog.definition: An inventory or listing of resources that includes this resource.

ceterms:inLanguage.label: In Language
ceterms:inLanguage.definition: The primary language or languages of the entity, even if it makes use of other languages.
ceterms:inLanguage.usageNote: A course offered in English to teach Spanish would have an inLanguage of English, while a credential in Quebec could have an inLanguage of both French and English.

ceterms:industryType.label: Industry Type
ceterms:industryType.definition: Type of industry; select from an existing enumeration of such types such as the SIC, NAICS, and ISIC classifications.
ceterms:industryType.usageNote: Best practice in identifying industries for U.S. resources is to provide the NAICS code using the ceterms:naics property. Other resources may use the ceterms:industrytype property and any framework of the class ceterms:IndustryClassification.

ceterms:instructionalProgramType.label: Instructional Program Type
ceterms:instructionalProgramType.definition: Type of instructional program; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:instructionalProgramType.usageNote: For U.S. credentials, best practice is to use a framework such as the CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs). Other credentials may use any framework of the class CTDL InstructionalProgramClassification.

ceterms:isAdvancedStandingFor.label: Is Advanced Standing For
ceterms:isAdvancedStandingFor.definition: This resource reduces the time or cost required to earn or complete the referenced resource.
ceterms:isAdvancedStandingFor.usageNote: A third-party credential agent claiming that its credential provides advanced standing for the credential of another credential agent should consider using ceterms:recommendedFor instead of ceterms:advancedStandingFor in the absence of an explicit and verifiable agreement on advanced standing between the agents of the two credentials.

ceterms:isMemberOf.label: Is Member Of
ceterms:isMemberOf.definition: Collection to which this resource belongs.

ceterms:isNonCredit.label: Is Non-Credit
ceterms:isNonCredit.definition: Resource carries or confers no official academic credit according to the provider of the resource.

ceterms:isPartOf.label: Is Part Of
ceterms:isPartOf.definition: Indicates another entity of which this entity is a component.

ceterms:isPreparationFor.label: Is Preparation For
ceterms:isPreparationFor.definition: This resource provides preparation for the resource being referenced.

ceterms:isRecommendedFor.label: Is Recommended For
ceterms:isRecommendedFor.definition: It is recommended to earn or complete this resource before attempting to earn or complete the referenced resource.

ceterms:isRegisteredApprenticeship.label: Is Registered Apprenticeship
ceterms:isRegisteredApprenticeship.definition: The resource is registered with a governmental agency or other authorized organization because it has been vetted, approved and validated to meet specific criteria.

ceterms:isRequiredFor.label: Is Required For
ceterms:isRequiredFor.definition: This resource must be earned or completed prior to attempting to earn or complete the referenced resource.

ceterms:isSimilarTo.label: Is Similar To
ceterms:isSimilarTo.note: The property is generally applicable in describing the similarity between any two entities.

ceterms:jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
ceterms:jurisdiction.definition: Geographic or political region in which the resource is formally applicable or an organization has authority to act.

ceterms:keyword.label: Keyword
ceterms:keyword.definition: Keyword or key phrase describing relevant aspects of an entity.
ceterms:keyword.usageNote: Use the keyword property to enter free text keywords. A subject concept in a controlled vocabulary should use the subject property.

ceterms:learningMethodDescription.label: Learning Method Description
ceterms:learningMethodDescription.definition: Description of the methods used to conduct learning.

ceterms:learningMethodType.label: Learning Method Type
ceterms:learningMethodType.definition: Types of methods used to conduct the learning opportunity; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:learningMethodType.usageNote: Best practice is to use concepts from a controlled vocabulary such as the ceterms:LearningMethod.

ceterms:lifeCycleStatusType.label: Life Cycle Status Type
ceterms:lifeCycleStatusType.definition: Type of state of the resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle; select from an enumeration of such types.

ceterms:maintenanceProcess.label: Maintenance Process
ceterms:maintenanceProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource is maintained, including review and updating.
ceterms:maintenanceProcess.note: Such maintenance does not include renewal of a credential by an individual holder.

ceterms:name.label: Name
ceterms:name.definition: Name or title of the resource.

ceterms:objectOfAction.label: Object of Action
ceterms:objectOfAction.definition: Action carried out upon this resource.

ceterms:occupationType.label: Occupation Type
ceterms:occupationType.definition: Type of occupation; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:occupationType.usageNote: For U.S. resources, best practice is to identify an occupation using a framework such as the ONet. Other resources may use any framework of the class ceterms:OccupationClassification, such as the EU's ESCO, ISCO-08, and SOC 2010.

ceterms:offerFrequencyType.label: Offer Frequency Type
ceterms:offerFrequencyType.definition: Type of frequency at which a resource is offered; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:offerFrequencyType.note: This relates to how often something starts.
ceterms:offerFrequencyType.usageNote: For information relating to the frequency of events associated with a resource when it is running, use ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.

ceterms:offeredIn.label: Offered In
ceterms:offeredIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale where the credential, learning resource or assessment is offered.

ceterms:ownedBy.label: Owned By
ceterms:ownedBy.definition: Agent with an enforceable claim or legal title to the resource.
ceterms:ownedBy.note: Agent includes credentialing organizations, quality assurance organizations and persons. It does not not include credential holders.

ceterms:preparationFrom.label: Preparation From
ceterms:preparationFrom.definition: Indicates a resource that is useful in preparing for the resource being described.

ceterms:prerequisite.label: Prerequisite
ceterms:prerequisite.definition: Course that is required as a prior condition to this course.
ceterms:prerequisite.usageNote: Conditions of entry into Programs can be specified with entryCondition; requirements for Courses other than prerequisite Courses (e.g., Competencies) can be specified with requires.

ceterms:providesTransferValueFor.label: Provides Transfer Value For
ceterms:providesTransferValueFor.definition: This resource provides transfer value for the referenced Transfer Value Profile.
ceterms:providesTransferValueFor.note: Refer to the referenced Transfer Value Profile for more information. Other resources may be included for the full value.

ceterms:receivesTransferValueFrom.label: Receives Transfer Value From
ceterms:receivesTransferValueFrom.definition: This resource receives transfer value from the referenced Transfer Value Profile.
ceterms:receivesTransferValueFrom.note: Refer to the referenced Transfer Value Profile for more information. Other resources may be included for the full value.

ceterms:recognizedBy.label: Recognized By
ceterms:recognizedBy.definition: Agent that acknowledges the validity of the resource.

ceterms:recognizedForIndustry.label: Recognized For Industry
ceterms:recognizedForIndustry.definition: Industry for which this resource is acknowledged to be valid.

ceterms:recognizedIn.label: Recognized In
ceterms:recognizedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the resource has been publicly recommended, acknowledged or endorsed..

ceterms:recommends.label: Recommends
ceterms:recommends.definition: Indicates a resource that it is advisable to earn or complete before attempting the resource being described.

ceterms:region.label: Region
ceterms:region.definition: Entity that describes the longitude, latitude and other location details of an area.

ceterms:registeredBy.label: Registered By
ceterms:registeredBy.definition: Agent with which the resource is registered because it has been vetted, approved and validated to meet specific criteria.

ceterms:regulatedBy.label: Regulated By
ceterms:regulatedBy.definition: Organization that enforces the legal requirements related to the resource being described.

ceterms:regulatedIn.label: Regulated In
ceterms:regulatedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential, learning opportunity or resource is regulated.

ceterms:requires.label: Requires
ceterms:requires.definition: Requirement or set of requirements for this resource.
ceterms:requires.usageNote: Consider using the more specific subproperties of requires such as prerequisite, coPrerequisite, entryCondition, and corequisite, where appropriate.

ceterms:resultsInCredential.label: Results In Credential
ceterms:resultsInCredential.definition: Credential awarded as the result of successful completion of the resource being described.
ceterms:resultsInCredential.usageNote: Use when completion of the resource being described is the only requirement for the award of the Credential; otherwise use one of ceterms:isPreparationFor, ceterms:isRecommendedFor, ceterms:isRequiredFor.

ceterms:reviewProcess.label: Review Process
ceterms:reviewProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource is reviewed.

ceterms:sameAs.label: Same As
ceterms:sameAs.definition: Another source of information about the entity being described.
ceterms:sameAs.note: Other sources may include descriptions of entities in open databases such as DBpedia, Wikidata, the Credential Engine Registry, or other platforms.

ceterms:sced.label: SCED
ceterms:sced.definition: School Courses for the Exchange of Data code for a course.
ceterms:sced.usageNote: It is preferable to record the whole 12 character alphanumeric code, however it is also valid to record just the five digit subject code + course number.

ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.label: Schedule Frequency Type
ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.definition: Type of frequency indicating the cadence at which events associated with a resource typically occur; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.note: This relates to the frequency of events associated with a resource once it is running.
ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.usageNote: For information relating to how often something starts, use ceterms:offerFrequencyType.

ceterms:scheduleTimingType.label: Schedule Timing Type
ceterms:scheduleTimingType.definition: Type of time at which events typically occur; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:subject.label: Subject
ceterms:subject.definition: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.
ceterms:subject.usageNote: Use the subject property to reference a concept in a controlled vocabulary. Free text subjects should use the keyword property.

ceterms:subjectWebpage.label: Subject Webpage
ceterms:subjectWebpage.note: The web page being referenced describes the entity. The value of subjectWebpage is an authoritative location for information about the subject but should not be assumed to be a persistent identifier of the subject.

ceterms:supersededBy.label: Superseded By
ceterms:supersededBy.note: For example, a credential that outright replaces the credential being described, and is not simply a newer version of the same credential (the two credentials have different CTIDs).

ceterms:supersedes.label: Supersedes
ceterms:supersedes.note: For example, the credential that is outright replaced by the credential being described, and is not simply an older version of the same credential (the two credentials have different CTIDs).

ceterms:targetAssessment.label: Target Assessment
ceterms:targetAssessment.definition: Assessment that provides direct, indirect, formative or summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality for an entity.

ceterms:targetCredential.label: Target Credential
ceterms:targetCredential.definition: Credential that is a focus or target of the condition, process or verification service.

ceterms:targetLearningOpportunity.label: Target Learning Opportunity
ceterms:targetLearningOpportunity.definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.

ceterms:targetLearningResource.label: Target Learning Resource
ceterms:targetLearningResource.definition: Learning object or resource that is used as part of a learning activity.
ceterms:targetLearningResource.note: Examples include a textbook or lesson plan that describes or records the educational activity (e.g. an audio- or video-recording of a lesson).

ceterms:targetPathway.label: Target Pathway
ceterms:targetPathway.definition: Pathway in which this resource is a potential component.

ceterms:teaches.label: Teaches
ceterms:teaches.definition: Competency that the learning opportunity is intended to teach.

ceterms:versionCode.label: Version Code
ceterms:versionCode.definition: Alphanumeric identifier of the version of the resource that is unique within the organizational context of its owner and which does not need the context of other information in order to be interpreted.
ceterms:versionCode.usageNote: Intended for simple string and/or numeric version codes or identifiers, such as "10" or "3B.1" or "2024 Release". For version identifiers that need to reference additional information, such as a type of version or framework for versioning, use versionIdentifier.

ceterms:versionIdentifier.label: Version Identifier
ceterms:versionIdentifier.definition: Alphanumeric identifier of the version of the resource and information about the identifier's originating context or scheme.
ceterms:versionIdentifier.usageNote: Use versionCode for any local identifier of the version of the resource that come from the organizational context its owner and which do not need the context of other information in order to be interpreted.

qdata:relevantDataSet.label: Relevant Data Set
qdata:relevantDataSet.definition: Data Set on which earnings or employment data is based.

ceterms:identifierType.label: Identifier Type
ceterms:identifierType.definition: Framework, scheme, type, or other organizing principle of this identifier.

ceterms:identifierTypeName.label: Identifier Type Name
ceterms:identifierTypeName.definition: Formal name or acronym of the framework, scheme, type, or other organizing principle of this identifier, such as ISBN or ISSN.

ceterms:identifierValueCode.label: Identifier Value Code
ceterms:identifierValueCode.definition: Alphanumeric string identifier of the entity.
ceterms:identifierValueCode.note: Where a formal identification system exists for the identifier, recommended best practice is to use a string conforming to that system.

ceterms:alignmentDate.label: Alignment Date
ceterms:alignmentDate.definition: The date  the alignment was made.

ceterms:alignmentType.label: Alignment Type
ceterms:alignmentType.definition: Type of relationship between two entities.
ceterms:alignmentType.usageNote: This property is necessary only for AlignmentObjects as part of an AlignmentMap where it is the property that expresses the alignment from the source node (as subject) and target node (as object). When the CredentialAlignmentObject is used, the type value is definitively identified by the property that points to it and so in this case the alignmentType property is redundant.

ceterms:framework.label: Framework URL
ceterms:framework.definition: Credential framework to which the entity is aligned.
ceterms:framework.note: Frameworks may include, but are not limited to, competency frameworks and concept schemes such as industry, occupation, and instructional program codes.

ceterms:targetNode.label: Target Node
ceterms:targetNode.definition: Individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the target of an alignment.
ceterms:targetNode.note: The target node returned must be the exact competency or concept being described and no other competency or concept. References to data or a document that returns all of the competencies or concepts in the framework to which the target node belongs should use the ceterms:framework property.
ceterms:targetNode.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:targetNodeDescription.label: Target Description
ceterms:targetNodeDescription.definition: Textual description of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the target of an alignment.
ceterms:targetNodeDescription.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:targetNodeName.label: Target Node Name
ceterms:targetNodeName.definition: Name of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the target of an alignment.
ceterms:targetNodeName.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:weight.label: Weight
ceterms:weight.definition: Measurement of the weight, degree, percent, or strength of a recommendation, requirement, or comparison.
ceterms:weight.usageNote: Best practice is to assign a decimal value weight between 0 and 1 that indicates the strength of the assertion, with 0 being weakest and 1 being strongest.

ceterms:affiliation.label: Affiliation
ceterms:affiliation.definition: Organization to which a person is formally related through work, sudy, or social engagement.

ceterms:alternativeCondition.label: Alternative Condition
ceterms:alternativeCondition.definition: Constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements in a context where more than one alternative condition or path has been defined and from which any one path fulfills the parent condition.
ceterms:alternativeCondition.note: A set of alternative conditions are not necessarily mutually exclusive paths; for example, a set of alternative concentrations for a degree may allow a person to optionally complete more than one concentration even though only one is required to earn the degree.

ceterms:assertedBy.label: Asserted By
ceterms:assertedBy.definition: Agent making a statement based on fact or belief.

ceterms:condition.label: Condition
ceterms:condition.definition: Single constraint, prerequisite, entry condition, requirement, or cost.

ceterms:conditionExcludes.label: Condition Excludes
ceterms:conditionExcludes.definition: Resource that does not count toward fulfilling a constraint, prerequisite, entry condition, or requirement.
ceterms:conditionExcludes.note: Intended for cases where it is simplest to express exceptions to a general requirement, for example when a requirement is met by any Math course except "Access Math".

ceterms:experience.label: Experience
ceterms:experience.definition: Amount and nature of required work, experiential learning or other relevant experience.

ceterms:minimumAge.label: Minimum Age
ceterms:minimumAge.definition: Minimum allowed age at which a person is eligible.

ceterms:residentOf.label: Resident Of
ceterms:residentOf.definition: Geographic or political region of which a person must be a legal resident or citizen in order to be eligible for the credential.
ceterms:residentOf.note: Residency defines the duration of stay required by national, state, provincial or local laws that entitles a person to the legal protection and benefits provided to the applicable type.

ceterms:submissionOf.label: Submission Of
ceterms:submissionOf.definition: Artifact to be submitted such as a transcript, portfolio, or an affidavit.

ceterms:submissionOfDescription.label: Submission Of Description
ceterms:submissionOfDescription.definition: Name, label, or description of an artifact to be submitted such as a transcript, portfolio, or an affidavit.

ceterms:targetCompetency.label: Target Competency
ceterms:targetCompetency.definition: A competency relevant to the resource being described.

ceterms:targetJob.label: Target Job
ceterms:targetJob.definition: Job that is the focus or target of this resource.

ceterms:targetMetric.label: Target Metric
ceterms:targetMetric.definition: Metric used to assess whether a condition has been met.

ceterms:targetOccupation.label: Target Occupation
ceterms:targetOccupation.definition: Occupation that is the focus or target of this resource.

ceterms:targetTask.label: Target Task
ceterms:targetTask.definition: Task that is the focus or target of this resource.

ceterms:yearsOfExperience.label: Years of Experience
ceterms:yearsOfExperience.usageNote: Non-integer year values may be expressed as point value, for example, 0.25, 1.5, etc.

ceterms:globalJurisdiction.label: Global Jurisdiction
ceterms:globalJurisdiction.definition: Whether or not the credential is useful, applicable or recognized everywhere.
ceterms:globalJurisdiction.note: Exceptions indicated by the ceterms:jurisdictionException property apply.

ceterms:jurisdictionException.label: Jurisdiction Exception
ceterms:jurisdictionException.definition: Geographic or political region in which the credential is not formally recognized or an organization has no authority to act .
ceterms:jurisdictionException.note: The ceterms:jurisdictionalException property is used in conjunction with the ceterms:jurisdiction property and expresses any exceptions to a more general statement; e.g., the United states except for Colorado.

ceterms:mainJurisdiction.label: Main Jurisdiction
ceterms:mainJurisdiction.definition: Primary geographic or political region in which the credential is recognized as applicable or in which an organization has recognized authority to act.

ceterms:addressCountry.label: Address Country
ceterms:addressCountry.definition: Nation with its own government and occupying a particular territory identified by the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

ceterms:addressLocality.label: Address Locality
ceterms:addressLocality.definition: Town, city, or village in which a particular location is situtated.

ceterms:addressRegion.label: Address Region
ceterms:addressRegion.definition: State or province in which a particular location is situated.

ceterms:geoURI.label: Geographic URI
ceterms:geoURI.definition: Entity that describes the longitude, latitude and other location details of a place.
ceterms:geoURI.note: This may define a place at any scale. Examples include a city, state, province, country, or continent.
ceterms:geoURI.usageNote: It is recommended to use services such as http://www.geonames.org to provide values for this property.

ceterms:postOfficeBoxNumber.label: Post Office Box Number
ceterms:postOfficeBoxNumber.definition: Post office box number for post office addresses.

ceterms:subRegion.label: Sub-region
ceterms:subRegion.definition: An administrative subdivision within a country that is intermediate between a region and a locality.
ceterms:subRegion.note: This may be referred to as a county in the United States, a département in France, a district in India, a raion in Russia, a municipio in Mexico, or equivalent terms in other jurisdictions.

ceterms:targetContactPoint.label: Target Contact Point
ceterms:targetContactPoint.definition: Options for contacting the organization or person.

ceterms:contactType.label: Contact Type
ceterms:contactType.definition: Text identifying the type of service provided by an organizational contact.
ceterms:contactType.note: A person or organization may have different contact points for different services. The contact type property provides for adding text to identity the service; e.g., "toll-free number" or "support for hearing-impaired callers".

ceterms:email.label: Email
ceterms:email.definition: Email address of the organization or person.

ceterms:socialMedia.label: Social Media
ceterms:socialMedia.definition: Social media access point for an agent or an agent's contact point.

ceterms:approximateEndDate.label: Approximate End Date
ceterms:approximateEndDate.definition: Approximate date some event or activity ends.
ceterms:approximateEndDate.note: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateEndDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:endDate.

ceterms:approximateStartDate.label: Approximate Start Date
ceterms:approximateStartDate.definition: Approximate date the validity or usefulness of the information in this resource begins.
ceterms:approximateStartDate.note: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateStartDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:startDate.

ceterms:endDate.label: End Date
ceterms:endDate.definition: Date some event or activity ends.
ceterms:endDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateEndDate instead.

ceterms:proxyFor.label: Proxy For
ceterms:proxyFor.definition: Indicates the resource for which a pathway component or similar proxy resource is a stand-in.
ceterms:proxyFor.note: The subject for this property will be acting as proxy in a context such as a pathway for the resource that is its object, so that assertions can be made about relationships between things in that context that are not universally true of the resources for which they are proxies.

ceterms:startDate.label: Start Date
ceterms:startDate.definition: Date the validity or usefulness of the information in this resource begins.
ceterms:startDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateStartDate instead.

ceterms:sourceNode.label: Source Node
ceterms:sourceNode.definition: Individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the source of an alignment.
ceterms:sourceNode.note: This is the node to which the target node is being compared. It is the subject of the property used as the alignment type.
ceterms:sourceNode.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.label: Source Node Description
ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.definition: Textual description of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the source of an alignment.
ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.note: This relates to the node to which the target node is being compared, that is the subject of the property used as the alignment type.
ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:sourceNodeName.label: Source Node Name
ceterms:sourceNodeName.definition: Name of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the source of an alignment.
ceterms:sourceNodeName.note: This relates to the node to which the target node is being compared, that is the subject of the property used as the alignment type.
ceterms:sourceNodeName.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:exactDuration.label: Exact Duration
ceterms:exactDuration.definition: Overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:exactDuration.note: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:exactDuration.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 6 months as P6M.

ceterms:maximumDuration.label: Maximum Duration
ceterms:maximumDuration.definition: Maximum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:maximumDuration.note: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:maximumDuration.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 9 months as P9M. Do not use ceterms:maximumDuration to identify the renewal frequency of a credential; use ceterms:renewalFrequency instead.

ceterms:minimumDuration.label: Minimum Duration
ceterms:minimumDuration.definition: Minimum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:minimumDuration.note: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:minimumDuration.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 3 months as P3M.

ceterms:timeRequired.label: Time Required
ceterms:timeRequired.definition: Total engaged or participating time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:timeRequired.note: This is intended to indicate only the sum of the individual amounts of time which are spent actively engaged in pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource, regardless of the overall time span required to complete it.
ceterms:timeRequired.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 50 hours as PT50H.

ceterms:costDetails.label: Cost Details
ceterms:costDetails.definition: Webpage or online document containing human-readable, in-depth information about costs.

ceterms:currency.label: Currency
ceterms:currency.definition: Currency in which the monetary amount is expressed in 3-letter ISO 4217 format such as "USD".

ceterms:directCostType.label: Direct Cost Type
ceterms:directCostType.definition: Types of direct costs associated with earning or completing a credential, assessment or learning opportunity; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:directCostType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:CostType vocabulary.

ceterms:paymentPattern.label: Payment Pattern
ceterms:paymentPattern.definition: Applicable pattern for payments such as "per semester" and "every three months".

ceterms:price.label: Price
ceterms:price.definition: Offer price of a credential, learning resource, assessment, related activity or resource.

ceterms:residencyType.label: Residency Type
ceterms:residencyType.definition: Type of legal residency status of a person; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:residencyType.note: Residency defines the duration of stay required by national, state, provincial or local laws that entitles a person to the legal protection and benefits provided to the applicable type.
ceterms:residencyType.usageNote: Best practice for U.S. credentials and for submission to the Credential Engine Registry, is to use concepts from the ceterms:Residency vocabulary.

ceterms:creditLevelType.label: Credit Level Type
ceterms:creditLevelType.definition: The level of credit associated with the credit awarded or required.

ceterms:creditUnitType.label: Credit Unit Type
ceterms:creditUnitType.definition: The type of credit associated with the credit awarded or required.

qdata:percentage.label: Percentage
qdata:percentage.definition: Quotient of two values of the data set, expressed as a percentage.
qdata:percentage.usageNote: Best practice is to treat the value of this property as a verbatim percentage; for example, a value of 1.5 should be interpreted as 1.5%

schema:maxValue.label: Maximum Value
schema:maxValue.definition: The upper value of some characteristic or property.
schema:maxValue.usageNote: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

schema:minValue.label: Minimum Value
schema:minValue.definition: The lower value of some characteristic or property.
schema:minValue.usageNote: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

schema:value.label: Value
schema:value.definition: The value of the property value node.
schema:value.usageNote: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

ceterms:Alignment.label: Alignment
ceterms:Alignment.definition: Types of relationship that can be asserted as existing between nodes in frameworks.

concepts.label: Broad Match
concepts.definition: Assertion indicates that the referenced concept is broader in some way than this concept.

concepts.label: Close Match
concepts.definition: Assertion indicates that two concepts are sufficiently similar that they can be used interchangeably.

concepts.label: Exact Match
concepts.definition: Indicates semantic similarity denoting an even higher degree of closeness than skos:closeMatch.

concepts.label: Narrow Match
concepts.definition: Assertion indicates that the referenced concept is narrower in some way than this concept.

concepts.label: No Match
concepts.definition: Assertion indicating that there is no related concept in the target framework.

concepts.label: Related Match
concepts.definition: Assertion indicating an associative, non-hierarchical relationship between the two concepts where neither is broader nor narrower than the other.

concepts.label: Artifact
concepts.definition: Work or product created or produced by the person being assessed.

concepts.label: Exam
concepts.definition: Mix of scored items presented in fixed or open response formats including qualifying and comprehensive exams.

concepts.label: Performance
concepts.definition: Set of behaviors or actions assessed as demonstration of competencies where the assessment occurs either as the actions take place (i.e., live) or through review of recordings of those actions in a persistent media (e.g., video, audio, keystroke records, etc.)

concepts.label: Portfolio Evaluation
concepts.definition: Assessment method that evaluates a learner’s portfolio of evidence to determine knowledge, skills, or competencies.

ceterms:Audience.label: Audience
ceterms:Audience.definition: Types of audiences for which the resource being described is applicable or available.
ceterms:Audience.note: If the resource is applicable or available for any type of audience, do not select anything.

concepts.label: Citizen
concepts.definition: Person who is a legally recognized subject of a particular nation, state, province, or commonwealth.

concepts.label: Cultural/Ethnic Minority
concepts.definition: Person who belongs to a cultural and/or ethnic minority group, relative to the surrounding population.

concepts.label: Currently Incarcerated
concepts.definition: Person who is currently incarcerated.

concepts.label: Current Military
concepts.definition: Current member of a nation's military.

concepts.label: Current Military Dependent
concepts.definition: Dependent (usually a child) of a current member of a nation's military.

concepts.label: Current Military Spouse
concepts.definition: Spouse of a current member of a nation's military.

concepts.label: Current Student
concepts.definition: Student currently participating in a learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Displaced
concepts.definition: Person who has been displaced from their home or community.

concepts.label: Formerly Incarcerated
concepts.definition: Person who was formerly incarcerated.

concepts.label: Former Member
concepts.definition: Former member of an organization, society, or recognized group.

concepts.label: Former Military / Veteran
concepts.definition: Veteran of military service.

concepts.label: Former Military Dependent
concepts.definition: Former dependent (usually a child) of a veteran of a nation's military.

concepts.label: Former Military Spouse
concepts.definition: Spouse of a veteran of a nation's military.

concepts.label: Former Student / Alumni
concepts.definition: Student who previously participated in a learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Full-Time
concepts.definition: Participation in a learning opportunity to an extent that meets the opportunity's requirements for full-time status.

concepts.label: Future Member
concepts.definition: Future member of an organization, society, or recognized group.

concepts.label: Future Student
concepts.definition: Student who intends to participate in a learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Homemaker
concepts.definition: Person who provides unpaid services to family members in the home.

concepts.label: Job Seeker
concepts.definition: Person who is currently seeking work.

concepts.label: Member
concepts.definition: Current member of an organization, society, or recognized group.

concepts.label: Non-Citizen
concepts.definition: Person who is not a legally recognized subject of a particular nation, state, province, or commonwealth.

concepts.label: Non-Member
concepts.definition: Individual without membership status or privileges conferred by an organization, society, or recognized group.

concepts.label: Non-Resident
concepts.definition: Person whose primary residence is not in nation, state, province, or commonwealth of concern.

concepts.label: Part-Time
concepts.definition: Participation in a learning opportunity to an extent that meets the opportunity's requirements for part-time status.

concepts.label: Private Employee
concepts.definition: Person employed in the private sector.

concepts.label: Public Employee
concepts.definition: Person employed in the public sector.

concepts.label: Resident
concepts.definition: Person whose permanent and principal home is in a particular nation, state, province, or commonwealth.

concepts.label: Unemployed
concepts.definition: Person who is not employed.

concepts.label: Youth
concepts.definition: Person roughly between the ages of 15 and 24.

ceterms:AudienceLevel.label: Audience Level
ceterms:AudienceLevel.definition: Types of levels in an academic or training progression expected of, or to be developed by, the typical person for the resource being described.

concepts.label: Advanced Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those with significant experience or expertise where developmental expectations are staged for assessing knowledge, skills, or competencies beyond the novice and intermediate levels.

concepts.label: Associates Degree Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those completing college/university-level programs within their first one to two years (lower-division) of post-secondary education.

concepts.label: Bachelors Degree Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those completing college/university-level programs within approximately three to four years where course work and activities advance skills from a lower-division or generalist level to an upper-division level.

concepts.label: Beginner Level
concepts.definition: Intended for novices or those with limited experience.

concepts.label: Doctoral Degree Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those who have completed Bachelors and Masters degrees or their equivalent and who will be required to complete either independent research or a significant project or paper.

concepts.label: Early Childhood
concepts.definition: Intended for children before the start of primary education.

concepts.label: Graduate Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those who enrolled in a degree program or other formal program above the baccalaureate level, such as a masters or doctoral degree program.

concepts.label: Intermediate Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those with some experience, where knowledge, skills, and competency expectations are staged for development beyond novice-level and in preparation for a more advanced-level.

concepts.label: Lower Division Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those in the first half of an undergraduate level program.

concepts.label: Lower Secondary
concepts.definition: Intended for those at the earlier stages of secondary education, building on primary education, typically with a more subject-oriented curriculum.

concepts.label: Masters Degree Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those who have completed a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.

concepts.label: Post-Secondary Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those who have completed secondary level school programs or equivalent.

concepts.label: Primary
concepts.definition: Intended for those who are acquiring fundamental skills in reading, writing and mathematics and establishing a solid foundation for learning.

concepts.label: Professional Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those attending professional programs or equivalent, such as law or medicine.

concepts.label: Remedial Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those who are under-prepared for learning at a particular level.

concepts.label: Secondary School or Equivalent
concepts.definition: Intended for those attending secondary (high-school) level programs.

concepts.label: Undergraduate Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those who are enrolled in a degree program or other formal program at or below the baccalaureate, such as an associate’s degree, vocational, or technical program.

concepts.label: Upper Division Level
concepts.definition: Intended for those in the second half of an undergraduate level program.

concepts.label: Upper Secondary
concepts.definition: Intended for those at the later stages of secondary education, preparing for tertiary education or employment.

ceterms:CostType.label: Cost Type
ceterms:CostType.definition: Entity that describes the types of costs related to earning or completing a credential, assessment, or learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Aggregate Cost
concepts.definition: Sum of direct costs.

concepts.label: Application
concepts.definition: Cost of applying for the resource being described.

concepts.label: Background Check
concepts.definition: Cost for a background check.

concepts.label: Childcare
concepts.definition: Financial aid towards paying for supervision, care, and activities for children.

concepts.label: Consumables
concepts.definition: Cost for supplies or materials that are depleted or replaced.

concepts.label: Enrollment Fee
concepts.definition: Cost to enroll in the learning opportunity being described.

concepts.label: Equipment
concepts.definition: Cost for durable tools, instruments or machines.

concepts.label: Graduation Fee
concepts.definition: Separate graduation fee.

concepts.label: Learning Resource
concepts.definition: Cost for one or more learning resources.

concepts.label: Meals
concepts.definition: Cost for meals while participating in the learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Mixed Fees
concepts.definition: The sum of fees that are not identified individually.

concepts.label: Optional Charges
concepts.definition: Cost for additional fees, other services, equipment, or facilities that are not required.

concepts.label: Personal Expenses
concepts.definition: Cost for personal living or incidental expenses.

concepts.label: Processing Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for processing or expediting information related to the resource being described.

concepts.label: Program Specific Fee
concepts.definition: Additional cost for participation with a specific program or course of study such as engineering, business, and nursing.

concepts.label: Reexamination Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for retaking an instance of the resource being described.

concepts.label: Maintenance Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for maintenance or renewal of the resource being described.

concepts.label: Rescheduling Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for rescheduling an instance of the resource being described.

concepts.label: Room or Residence
concepts.definition: Cost for room, residence or boarding.

concepts.label: Scoring Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for scoring the resource being described.

concepts.label: Special Hardship
concepts.definition: Financial aid towards covering hardship arising from unforeseen circumstances.

concepts.label: Special Needs
concepts.definition: Financial aid towards paying for extra costs associated with accommodating a special need.

concepts.label: Standalone/Extra Assessment
concepts.definition: Cost for standalone assessments.

concepts.label: Student Services Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for student services related to the learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Technology Fee
concepts.definition: Cost for accessing technologies related to the learning opportunity or activity.

concepts.label: Travel
concepts.definition: Financial aid towards paying for travel costs.

concepts.label: Tuition
concepts.definition: Cost for teaching and instruction.

ceterms:CreditUnit.label: Credit Unit
ceterms:CreditUnit.definition: Broad descriptions of units used to measure credit associated with a resource.

concepts.label: Academic Year
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted as being related to one or more academic years.

concepts.label: Carnegie Unit
concepts.definition: Credit that is based on 120 hours of contact time or class time with an instructor.

concepts.label: Certificate Credit
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for certificates.

concepts.label: Clock Hour
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted as being related to one or more temporal hours.

concepts.label: Competency Credit
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for a particular competency or set of competencies.

concepts.label: Contact Hour
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted as being related to one or more temporal hours of instruction presented to students.

concepts.label: Continuing Education Unit
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or is accepted as education units for meeting professional development requirements.

concepts.label: Degree Credit
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or is accepted as credit for earning a college-level degree.

concepts.label: Dual Credit
concepts.definition: Credit that is applicable to two different educational levels.

concepts.label: Quarter Hour
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted at an academic quarter level.

concepts.label: Requirement Credit
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for some type of requirement.

concepts.label: Secondary Diploma Credit
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for a secondary diploma.

concepts.label: Semester Hour
concepts.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted at a semester level.

concepts.label: Time-Based Credit
concepts.definition: Credit with a unit of measurement based on time, either figuratively or literally.

concepts.label: Type-Based Credit
concepts.definition: Credit with a unit of measurement based on the type of credit.

ceterms:Delivery.label: Delivery Type
ceterms:Delivery.definition: Types of technical form for providing instances of the entity.

concepts.label: Blended Delivery
concepts.definition: Delivery includes significant levels of both in person and online.

concepts.label: In-Person Only
concepts.definition: Delivery is only face-to-face.

concepts.label: Online Only
concepts.definition: Delivery is only via the Internet.

concepts.label: Variable Site
concepts.definition: Delivery is not tied to a specific site.

ceterms:IndustryClassification.label: Industry Classification
ceterms:IndustryClassification.definition: Class of of concept schemes defining industries such as NAICS in the U.S. and ESCO in the European Union.

ceterms:InstructionalProgramClassificati.label: Instructional Program Classification
ceterms:InstructionalProgramClassificati.definition: Class of concept schemes defining instructional program types such as the CIP codes in the U.S.
ceterms:InstructionalProgramClassificati.usageNote: Class of concept schemes defining types

ceterms:LearningMethod.label: Learning Method
ceterms:LearningMethod.definition: Types of methods used to conduct the learning opportunity.

concepts.label: Applied Instruction
concepts.definition: Provides learning opportunities in the context of real world examples, cases, and applications.

concepts.label: Apprenticeship
concepts.definition: Learning through work that leads to a credential that is recognized by a relevant authority and is deliberately structured and supported to provide a progression of learning experiences.

concepts.label: Augmented Reality
concepts.definition: Provides interactive learning experience through technology that superimposes a computer-generated image on a user's view of the real world, thus providing a composite view.

concepts.label: Clinical Rotation
concepts.definition: Learning through real-world work experience in a medical context under the direct supervision of a qualified practitioner.

concepts.label: Cocurricular Learning
concepts.definition: Learning opportunity that supplements or complements the curriculum.

concepts.label: Cohort-Based
concepts.definition: Format in which people  progress as a group.

concepts.label: Competency Based
concepts.definition: Method that focuses on learners demonstrating the knowledge, skills and/or attitudes in highly specific units regardless of time, place, or pace of learning, usually in authentic contexts.

concepts.label: Gaming
concepts.definition: Provides interactive educational experiences which demonstrate concepts in a way that promotes critical thinking, overcoming challenges within prescribed rule sets, problem solving, and in some cases, teamwork and/or competition.

concepts.label: Internship
concepts.definition: Work position that is intended to provide a learner with an opportunity to gain experience but that is not structured around learning and does not itself lead to a credential recognized by a relevant authority.

concepts.label: Laboratory
concepts.definition: Hands-on individual or group experiences for applied learning concepts and methods, procedures and protocols with equipment and technologies.

concepts.label: Lecture
concepts.definition: Primary method is presentation by an instructor of learning material and may include student discussion.

concepts.label: Medical Residency
concepts.definition: Learning through real-world work experience at the graduate level in a medical context where a qualified participant works under the direct supervision of a senior practicioner.

concepts.label: Prerecorded
concepts.definition: Learning by using video, audio, or other prerecorded content.

concepts.label: Self Paced
concepts.definition: Provides for personalization and flexibility in the timing and progression of learning for individual learners based on their preferences and needs, prior learning experiences, and ability to progress through learning opportunities.

concepts.label: Seminar
concepts.definition: Primary method is active student discussion leading to advancement of the topic and facilitated by an instructor.

concepts.label: Simulation
concepts.definition: Provides interactive learning experience through imitation of a situation or process.

concepts.label: Work Based
concepts.definition: Provides real-world work experiences that may be paid or unpaid and provided in group or individual formats normally outside the classroom.

ceterms:LifeCycleStatus.label: Life Cycle Status
ceterms:LifeCycleStatus.definition: Types of states of a resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle.

concepts.label: Active
concepts.definition: Resource is active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

concepts.label: Ceased
concepts.definition: Resource is permanently no longer active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

concepts.label: Ceasing
concepts.definition: Resource is in the process of becoming no longer active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

concepts.label: Developing
concepts.definition: Resource is under development and may or may not become active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

concepts.label: Suspended
concepts.definition: Resource is temporarily not active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

concepts.label: Teach Out
concepts.definition: Arrangement by which an educational institution provides its current students with the opportunity to complete their course of study when the program, institution or location offering access closes.

ceterms:OccupationClassification.label: Occupation Classification
ceterms:OccupationClassification.definition: Class of concept schemes identifying occupations such as the Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) system in the U.S. and the European Skills/Competences, Qualifications and Occupations (ESCO).

concepts.label: In-State
concepts.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is the state or province of the relevant activity.

concepts.label: Foreign/International
concepts.definition: Legal residency, domicile, or citizen status of the agent is as a foreign national.

concepts.label: Local
concepts.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is local.

concepts.label: Out-of-State
concepts.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is a state or province different from the state or provincial locus of the relevant activity.

concepts.label: Regional
concepts.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is the same geographic or political region as that of the relevant activity.

ceterms:ScheduleFrequency.label: Schedule Frequency
ceterms:ScheduleFrequency.definition: Types for how often events occur.

concepts.label: Annually
concepts.definition: Schedule is on an annual basis, typically occurring once per year.

concepts.label: Bi-Monthly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a bi-monthly basis, typically occurring every other month.

concepts.label: Bi-Weekly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a bi-weekly basis, typically occurring every other week.

concepts.label: Daily
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a daily basis, typically occurring once per day.

concepts.label: Event-Based
concepts.definition: Schedule is determined or triggered by other events, such as completion of activities, completion of the resource, events external to the resource, or other events; refer to the resource's information for details.

concepts.label: Hourly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a hourly basis, typically occurring once per hour.

concepts.label: Irregular
concepts.definition: Schedule has no significant pattern.

concepts.label: Monthly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a monthly basis, typically occurring once per month.

concepts.label: Multiple Per Week
concepts.definition: Schedule is more frequent than a weekly basis.

concepts.label: On-Demand
concepts.definition: Schedule allows the participant to choose when the resource begins.

concepts.label: Open Entry/Exit
concepts.definition: Schedule allows for the participant to enter, participate with, and complete the resource during any period of the resource's run time.

concepts.label: Quarterly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on an quarterly basis, typically occurring three or four times per year.

concepts.label: Self-Paced
concepts.definition: Schedule allows for participation at a self-determined pace, though some specific dates and deadlines may be involved.

concepts.label: Semi-Annually
concepts.definition: Schedule is on an semi-annual basis, typically occurring twice per year.

concepts.label: Semi-Monthly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a semi-monthly basis, typically occurring twice per month.

concepts.label: Single Instance
concepts.definition: Schedule is a single instance of this event.

concepts.label: Weekly
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a weekly basis, typically occurring once per week.

ceterms:ScheduleTiming.label: Schedule Timing
ceterms:ScheduleTiming.definition: Types for when (in time) events occur.

concepts.label: Daytime
concepts.definition: Schedule is typically during daytime hours.

concepts.label: Evening
concepts.definition: Schedule is typically during evening hours.

concepts.label: Weekdays
concepts.definition: Schedule is Monday through Friday, consecutively or non-consecutively.

concepts.label: Weekends
concepts.definition: Schedule is on a weekly basis, Saturday and/or Sunday.

accommodation:AccessibleHousing.label: Accessible Housing
accommodation:AccessibleHousing.definition: Housing with features, modifications, or adjustments to ensure that individuals with disabilities can access and use the space on an equal basis with others.

accommodation:AccessibleParking.label: Accessible Parking
accommodation:AccessibleParking.definition: A designated parking spot close to a building entrance, with adequate space to allow for accessible van or car parking, and with appropriate signage and markings.

accommodation:AccessibleRestroom.label: Accessible Restroom
accommodation:AccessibleRestroom.definition: Accessible restrooms with grab bars, accessible toilets, and sinks at different heights.

accommodation:AdjustableLighting.label: Adjustable Lighting
accommodation:AdjustableLighting.definition: Adjustable lighting levels and glare reduction.

accommodation:AlternativeFormats.label: Alternative Formats
accommodation:AlternativeFormats.definition: Alternative formats for print and display materials.
accommodation:AlternativeFormats.comment: Examples include large print books or accessible PDFs.

accommodation:AssistiveTechnology.label: Assistive Technology
accommodation:AssistiveTechnology.definition: Assistive technology and software to enable or improve access.

accommodation:AudioCaptioning.label: Audio Captioning
accommodation:AudioCaptioning.definition: Displays for text corresponding to spoken words and audio cues.

accommodation:CaptioningAndTranscripts.label: Captioning and Transcripts
accommodation:CaptioningAndTranscripts.definition: Captioning and/or transcripts for audio and video content.

accommodation:ClearSignage.label: Clear Signage
accommodation:ClearSignage.definition: Clear and simple signage with high contrast and easy-to-read fonts.

accommodation:ColorBlindness.label: Color Blindness
accommodation:ColorBlindness.definition: Accessibility feature or accommodation that is designed to address color vision deficiency or color blindness.
accommodation:ColorBlindness.comment: This service typically involves adjusting the colors used in visual materials, such as websites, videos, or other digital content, to make them more distinguishable.

accommodation:Communication.label: Communication
accommodation:Communication.comment: Examples include written communication, picture communication, or communication boards, telephone relay, assistive listening devices, Braille print, audio communication, or other accommodations.

accommodation:DietaryAccommodation.label: Dietary Accommodation
accommodation:DietaryAccommodation.definition: Alternative meal options to suit dietary needs, restrictions, or preferences.

accommodation:FacilityAccommodation.label: Facility Accommodation
accommodation:FacilityAccommodation.definition: Features, modifications or adjustments made to a physical space or facility to ensure that individuals with disabilities can access and use the space on an equal basis with others.
accommodation:FacilityAccommodation.comment: This can include existing features and modifications to the built environment, such as the installation of ramps, accessible restrooms, or wider doorways, as well as adjustments to lighting, signage, and other environmental factors.

accommodation:FlexibleSchedule.label: Flexible Schedule
accommodation:FlexibleSchedule.definition: Accommodations made for the time frames to complete work or tasks.
accommodation:FlexibleSchedule.comment: Examples include adjustments to working hours, extended deadlines, assessment times, or other modifications to schedules.

accommodation:HearingLoops.label: Hearing Loops
accommodation:HearingLoops.definition: Audio induction loops that transmit signals to hearing aids, cochlear implants or other listening devices.

accommodation:MultipleLanguage.label: Multiple Language
accommodation:MultipleLanguage.definition: Provision of materials or communication in languages other than the primary language used.

accommodation:PhysicalAccessibility.label: Physical Accessibility
accommodation:PhysicalAccessibility.definition: Accommodations to ensure entry and mobility throughout a facility.
accommodation:PhysicalAccessibility.comment: Examples include ramps or lifts for wheelchair accessibility, elevators, automatic doors, and wider doorways to accommodate mobility devices.

accommodation:PlainLanguage.label: Plain Language
accommodation:PlainLanguage.definition: Communication that is clear, concise, and easy to understand for all participants.
accommodation:PlainLanguage.comment: Examples include using everyday language, avoiding technical jargon, and providing relevant context to aid comprehension.

accommodation:ResourceAndServiceAccommod.label: Resource and Service Accommodation
accommodation:ResourceAndServiceAccommod.definition: Accommodations that are designed to provide equal access to resources and services and are not related to physical facilities.

accommodation:ScreenReader.label: Screen Reader
accommodation:ScreenReader.definition: Screen reader compatibility for digital materials.

accommodation:Sensory.label: Sensory
accommodation:Sensory.definition: Accommodations for hypersensitivity or aversion to certain sounds, lights, textures, or smells.
accommodation:Sensory.comment: This can include quiet rooms, and reduced lighting.

accommodation:ServiceAnimal.label: Service Animal
accommodation:ServiceAnimal.definition: Service animal accommodations, including clear guidelines, policies, and facilities for allowing service and support animals.

actionStat:ActiveActionStatus.label: Active Action Status
actionStat:ActiveActionStatus.comment: Examples include: while watching the movie, or driving to a location

actionStat:CompletedActionStatus.label: Completed Action Status
actionStat:CompletedActionStatus.definition: Action that has already taken place.

actionStat:FailedActionStatus.label: Failed Action Status
actionStat:FailedActionStatus.comment: The action's error property and the HTTP return code contain more information about the failure.

actionStat:PotentialActionStatus.label: Potential Action Status
actionStat:PotentialActionStatus.definition: Description of an action that is supported.

agentSector:PrivateForProfit.label: Private For-Profit
agentSector:PrivateForProfit.definition: Sector that contains privately-owned organizations that operate for profit.

agentSector:PrivateNonProfit.label: Private Not-For-Profit
agentSector:PrivateNonProfit.definition: Sector that contains privately-owned organizations that operate on a non-profit basis.
agentSector:PrivateNonProfit.comment: These include both independent not-for-profit schools and those affiliated with a religious organization.

agentSector:Public.label: Public
agentSector:Public.definition: Sector that contains government and quasi-government organizations.

agreementCat:ArticulationAgreement.label: Articulation Agreement
agreementCat:ArticulationAgreement.definition: A formal mechanism establishing course or program equivalencies for recognition and transfer of learning between organizations or programs.

agreementCat:MemorandumOfUnderstanding.label: Memorandum of Understanding
agreementCat:MemorandumOfUnderstanding.definition: A formal mechanism expressing parties’ intent to collaborate or recognize learning, which may precede or accompany specific agreements.

agreementCat:MultipartyAgreement.label: Multiparty Agreement
agreementCat:MultipartyAgreement.definition: An agreement with more than two parties.

agreementCat:StandingTransferArrangement.label: Standing Transfer Arrangement
