agreementCat:StandingTransferArrangement.definition: A formal mechanism applying standardized recognition rules across defined sets of courses or programs.

alignment:BroadMatch.label: Broad Match
alignment:BroadMatch.definition: Assertion indicates that the referenced concept is broader in some way than this concept.

alignment:CloseMatch.label: Close Match
alignment:CloseMatch.definition: Assertion indicates that two concepts are sufficiently similar that they can be used interchangeably.

alignment:ExactMatch.label: Exact Match
alignment:ExactMatch.definition: Indicates semantic similarity denoting an even higher degree of closeness than skos:closeMatch.

alignment:NarrowMatch.label: Narrow Match
alignment:NarrowMatch.definition: Assertion indicates that the referenced concept is narrower in some way than this concept.

alignment:NoMatch.label: No Match
alignment:NoMatch.definition: Assertion indicating that there is no related concept in the target framework.

alignment:RelatedMatch.label: Related Match
alignment:RelatedMatch.definition: Assertion indicating an associative, non-hierarchical relationship between the two concepts where neither is broader nor narrower than the other.

array:AnyOf.label: Any Of
array:AnyOf.definition: Any (one or more) of the values.

array:CountDistinct.label: Count Distinct
array:CountDistinct.definition: The number of unique values; yields a number.

array:Max.label: Maximum
array:Max.definition: The highest of all the values.

array:Mean.label: Mean
array:Mean.definition: The arithmetic mean of all the values.

array:Min.label: Minimum
array:Min.definition: The lowest of all the values.

array:OneOf.label: One Of
array:OneOf.definition: Any one (but no more) of the values.

array:Sum.label: Sum
array:Sum.definition: The numeric total obtained by adding all the values.

assessMethod:Artifact.label: Artifact
assessMethod:Artifact.definition: Work or product created or produced by the person being assessed.
assessMethod:Artifact.comment: Artifact includes, but is not limited to, an academic paper, video documentary, computer software, music composition, choreography, novel, short story, journal article, news article, report, lesson plan, product design, portfolio, manufactured product, etc. Methods of evaluation may include multiple evaluators either individually or as an expert panel using general criteria or more structured rubrics whose scores are combined, etc. Criteria and methods of evaluation are often very similar to those for assessing a performance, without the facets specific to a live performance

assessMethod:Exam.label: Exam
assessMethod:Exam.definition: Mix of scored items presented in fixed or open response formats including qualifying and comprehensive exams.
assessMethod:Exam.comment: Exam includes, but is not limited to, multiple choice, true-false, written essay, short-answer, fill-in or oral response formats that could include measurements of reasoning, problem-solving, critical thinking.

assessMethod:Performance.label: Performance
assessMethod:Performance.definition: Set of behaviors or actions assessed as demonstration of competencies where the assessment occurs either as the actions take place (i.e., live) or through review of recordings of those actions in a persistent media (e.g., video, audio, keystroke records, etc.)
assessMethod:Performance.comment: Performance includes, but is not limited to, dance, music, teaching, acting, medical procedures, truck driving, manufacturing production, etc. Criteria include the categories and benchmarks on which the performance is assessed. Methods of evaluation can include multiple evaluators either individually or as an expert panel using general criteria or more structured rubrics whose scores are combined (e.g., assessing a dance performance, evaluating the performance of a medical procedure, truck driving procedure, manufacturing process such as machining).

assessMethod:PortfolioEvaluation.label: Portfolio Evaluation
assessMethod:PortfolioEvaluation.definition: Assessment method that evaluates a learner’s portfolio of evidence to determine knowledge, skills, or competencies.

assessUse:Formative.label: Formative Assessment
assessUse:Formative.definition: Formal and informal assessment procedures conducted during the learning process to support intentional modification in teaching and learning activities in order to improve learner attainment.

assessUse:Summative.label: Summative Assessment
assessUse:Summative.definition: Assessment of learning at the end of an instructional unit to determine whether some established standard or benchmark has been achieved.

audLevel:AdvancedLevel.label: Advanced Level
audLevel:AdvancedLevel.definition: Intended for those with significant experience or expertise where developmental expectations are staged for assessing knowledge, skills, or competencies beyond the novice and intermediate levels.

audLevel:AssociatesDegreeLevel.label: Associates Degree Level
audLevel:AssociatesDegreeLevel.definition: Intended for those completing college/university-level programs within their first one to two years (lower-division) of post-secondary education.
audLevel:AssociatesDegreeLevel.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 5 – Short-cycle tertiary education.

audLevel:BachelorsDegreeLevel.label: Bachelors Degree Level
audLevel:BachelorsDegreeLevel.definition: Intended for those completing college/university-level programs within approximately three to four years where course work and activities advance skills from a lower-division or generalist level to an upper-division level.
audLevel:BachelorsDegreeLevel.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 6 – Bachelor’s or equivalent level.

audLevel:BeginnerLevel.label: Beginner Level
audLevel:BeginnerLevel.definition: Intended for novices or those with limited experience.

audLevel:DoctoralDegreeLevel.label: Doctoral Degree Level
audLevel:DoctoralDegreeLevel.definition: Intended for those who have completed Bachelors and Masters degrees or their equivalent and who will be required to complete either independent research or a significant project or paper.
audLevel:DoctoralDegreeLevel.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 8 – Doctoral or equivalent level.

audLevel:EarlyChildhood.label: Early Childhood
audLevel:EarlyChildhood.definition: Intended for children before the start of primary education.
audLevel:EarlyChildhood.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 0 – Early childhood education.

audLevel:GraduateLevel.label: Graduate Level
audLevel:GraduateLevel.definition: Intended for those who enrolled in a degree program or other formal program above the baccalaureate level, such as a masters or doctoral degree program.

audLevel:IntermediateLevel.label: Intermediate Level
audLevel:IntermediateLevel.definition: Intended for those with some experience, where knowledge, skills, and competency expectations are staged for development beyond novice-level and in preparation for a more advanced-level.
audLevel:IntermediateLevel.comment: An individual at this level has foundational competencies to function independently with occasional supervision.

audLevel:LowerDivisionLevel.label: Lower Division Level
audLevel:LowerDivisionLevel.definition: Intended for those in the first half of an undergraduate level program.

audLevel:LowerSecondary.label: Lower Secondary
audLevel:LowerSecondary.definition: Intended for those at the earlier stages of secondary education, building on primary education, typically with a more subject-oriented curriculum.
audLevel:LowerSecondary.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 2 – Lower secondary education.

audLevel:MastersDegreeLevel.label: Masters Degree Level
audLevel:MastersDegreeLevel.definition: Intended for those who have completed a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.
audLevel:MastersDegreeLevel.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 7 – Master’s or equivalent level.

audLevel:PostSecondaryLevel.label: Post-Secondary Level
audLevel:PostSecondaryLevel.definition: Intended for those who have completed secondary level school programs or equivalent.

audLevel:Primary.label: Primary
audLevel:Primary.definition: Intended for those who are acquiring fundamental skills in reading, writing and mathematics and establishing a solid foundation for learning.
audLevel:Primary.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 1 – Primary education.

audLevel:ProfessionalLevel.label: Professional Level
audLevel:ProfessionalLevel.definition: Intended for those attending professional programs or equivalent, such as law or medicine.
audLevel:ProfessionalLevel.comment: Other levels can typically be paired with Professional Level to refine a description of a level.

audLevel:RemedialLevel.label: Remedial Level
audLevel:RemedialLevel.definition: Intended for those who are under-prepared for learning at a particular level.

audLevel:SecondaryLevel.label: Secondary School or Equivalent
audLevel:SecondaryLevel.definition: Intended for those attending secondary (high-school) level programs.

audLevel:UndergraduateLevel.label: Undergraduate Level
audLevel:UndergraduateLevel.definition: Intended for those who are enrolled in a degree program or other formal program at or below the baccalaureate, such as an associate’s degree, vocational, or technical program.

audLevel:UpperDivisionLevel.label: Upper Division Level
audLevel:UpperDivisionLevel.definition: Intended for those in the second half of an undergraduate level program.

audLevel:UpperSecondary.label: Upper Secondary
audLevel:UpperSecondary.definition: Intended for those at the later stages of secondary education, preparing for tertiary education or employment.
audLevel:UpperSecondary.comment: Aligns to ISCED 2011 level 3 – Upper secondary education.

audience:Citizen.label: Citizen
audience:Citizen.definition: Person who is a legally recognized subject of a particular nation, state, province, or commonwealth.

audience:CulturalEthnicMinority.label: Cultural/Ethnic Minority
audience:CulturalEthnicMinority.definition: Person who belongs to a cultural and/or ethnic minority group, relative to the surrounding population.

audience:CurrentMilitary.label: Current Military
audience:CurrentMilitary.definition: Current member of a nation's military.

audience:CurrentMilitaryDependent.label: Current Military Dependent
audience:CurrentMilitaryDependent.definition: Dependent (usually a child) of a current member of a nation's military.

audience:CurrentMilitarySpouse.label: Current Military Spouse
audience:CurrentMilitarySpouse.definition: Spouse of a current member of a nation's military.

audience:CurrentStudent.label: Current Student
audience:CurrentStudent.definition: Student currently participating in a learning opportunity.

audience:Displaced.label: Displaced
audience:Displaced.definition: Person who has been displaced from their home or community.

audience:FormerMember.label: Former Member
audience:FormerMember.definition: Former member of an organization, society, or recognized group.
audience:FormerMember.comment: Membership includes types of affiliation such as employment or other work relationships, enrollment at an educational institution etc.

audience:FormerMilitaryDependent.label: Former Military Dependent
audience:FormerMilitaryDependent.definition: Former dependent (usually a child) of a veteran of a nation's military.

audience:FormerMilitarySpouse.label: Former Military Spouse
audience:FormerMilitarySpouse.definition: Spouse of a veteran of a nation's military.

audience:FormerStudent.label: Former Student / Alumni
audience:FormerStudent.definition: Student who previously participated in a learning opportunity.

audience:FullTime.label: Full-Time
audience:FullTime.definition: Participation in a learning opportunity to an extent that meets the opportunity's requirements for full-time status.

audience:FutureMember.label: Future Member
audience:FutureMember.definition: Future member of an organization, society, or recognized group.
audience:FutureMember.comment: Membership includes types of affiliation such as employment or other work relationships, enrollment at an educational institution etc.

audience:FutureStudent.label: Future Student
audience:FutureStudent.definition: Student who intends to participate in a learning opportunity.

audience:Homemaker.label: Homemaker
audience:Homemaker.definition: Person who provides unpaid services to family members in the home.

audience:JobSeeker.label: Job Seeker
audience:JobSeeker.definition: Person who is currently seeking work.
audience:JobSeeker.comment: This includes new job seekers as well as those who already have work and are seeking other work.

audience:Member.label: Member
audience:Member.definition: Current member of an organization, society, or recognized group.
audience:Member.comment: Membership includes types of affiliation such as employment or other work relationships, enrollment at an educational institution etc.

audience:NonCitizen.label: Non-Citizen
audience:NonCitizen.definition: Person who is not a legally recognized subject of a particular nation, state, province, or commonwealth.

audience:NonMember.label: Non-Member
audience:NonMember.definition: Individual without membership status or privileges conferred by an organization, society, or recognized group.

audience:NonResident.label: Non-Resident
audience:NonResident.definition: Person whose primary residence is not in nation, state, province, or commonwealth of concern.

audience:PartTime.label: Part-Time
audience:PartTime.definition: Participation in a learning opportunity to an extent that meets the opportunity's requirements for part-time status.

audience:PrivateEmployee.label: Private Employee
audience:PrivateEmployee.definition: Person employed in the private sector.

audience:PublicEmployee.label: Public Employee
audience:PublicEmployee.definition: Person employed in the public sector.

audience:Resident.label: Resident
audience:Resident.definition: Person whose permanent and principal home is in a particular nation, state, province, or commonwealth.

audience:Youth.label: Youth
audience:Youth.definition: Person roughly between the ages of 15 and 24.

ceasn:abilityEmbodied.label: Ability Embodied
ceasn:abilityEmbodied.definition: Enduring attributes of the individual that influence performance are embodied either directly or indirectly in this resource.
ceasn:abilityEmbodied.usageNote: The abilityEmbodied property may referenced a defined ability in an ontology such as O*NET or an existing competency defined in a competency framework.

ceasn:comment.label: Comment
ceasn:comment.definition: Supplemental text provided by the promulgating body that clarifies the nature, scope or use of this resource.
ceasn:comment.comment: Use this property when the text provides useful context for this resource.

ceasn:hasChild.label: Has Child
ceasn:hasChild.definition: The referenced resource is lower in some arbitrary hierarchy than this resource.
ceasn:hasChild.comment: This property identifies a child node in the downward path in the chain of resources in a taxon path.

ceasn:isChildOf.label: Is Child Of
ceasn:isChildOf.definition: The referenced resource is higher in some arbitrary hierarchy than this resource.

ceasn:knowledgeEmbodied.label: Knowledge Embodied
ceasn:knowledgeEmbodied.definition: Body of information embodied either directly or indirectly in this resource.

ceasn:listID.label: List ID
ceasn:listID.definition: An alphanumeric string indicating the relative position of a resource in an ordered list of resources.
ceasn:listID.comment: Examples of such strings include: such as "A", "B", or "a", "b", or "I", "II", or "1", "2".
ceasn:listID.usageNote: Punctuation accompanying alphanumeric strings should not be included.

ceasn:skillEmbodied.label: Skill Embodied
ceasn:skillEmbodied.definition: Ability to apply knowledge and use know-how to complete tasks and solve problems including types or categories of developed proficiency or dexterity in mental operations and physical processes is embodied either directly or indirectly in this resource.
ceasn:skillEmbodied.usageNote: The skillEmbodied property may reference a defined skill in an ontology such as O*NET or an existing competency defined in a competency framework.

ceterms:AcademicCertificate.label: Academic Certificate
ceterms:AcademicCertificate.definition: Credential awarded for successful completion of a formal education program, demonstrating requisite knowledge and skills.
ceterms:AcademicCertificate.comment: Formal education programs include academic, career, technical programs with defined completion requirements and often require approvals by provincial or federal government.

ceterms:Accommodation.label: Accommodation
ceterms:Accommodation.definition: Types of features, changes, modifications, or adjustments made to a facility, service, or resource to provide equal access and opportunity to people with diverse needs and preferences.
ceterms:Accommodation.comment: These accommodations can include existing physical features or modifications to the environment, alternative formats or modes of communication, flexible scheduling, and personal assistance services, among others.

ceterms:AccreditAction.label: Accredit Action
ceterms:AccreditAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent that certifies an entity as meeting a prescribed set of standards.
ceterms:AccreditAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:ActionStatus.label: Action Status
ceterms:ActionStatus.definition: Types of current status of an action.
ceterms:ActionStatus.comment: Available statuses include ActiveActionStatus, CompletedActionStatus, FailedActionStatus, PotentialActionStatus.

ceterms:AdvancedStandingAction.label: Advanced Standing Action
ceterms:AdvancedStandingAction.definition: Claim by an agent asserting that the object credential of the action provides advanced standing for a credential under the asserting agent's authority.
ceterms:AdvancedStandingAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:Agent.label: Agent
ceterms:Agent.definition: Organization or person that acts or has the power to act.
ceterms:Agent.comment: Broad type that includes both organizations and people who play roles in the lifecycle of a resource.

ceterms:AgentSector.label: Agent Sector
ceterms:AgentSector.definition: Types of sociological, economic, or political subdivision of society.

ceterms:AgentServiceType.label: Agent Service Type
ceterms:AgentServiceType.definition: Types of services offered by an agent.

ceterms:AggregateDataProfile.label: Aggregate Data Profile
ceterms:AggregateDataProfile.usageNote: To express more complex data, use qdata:DataSetProfile.

ceterms:AgreementCategory.label: Agreement Category
ceterms:AgreementCategory.definition: Concepts classifying formal mechanisms used to recognize or transfer learning across organizations or programs.

ceterms:Alignment.label: Alignment
ceterms:Alignment.definition: Types of relationship that can be asserted as existing between nodes in frameworks.

ceterms:AlignmentMap.label: Alignment Map
ceterms:AlignmentMap.definition: Entity comprised of a set of alignment or mapping assertions between two existing entities.
ceterms:AlignmentMap.comment: Alignment maps provide the means for parties to assert sets of alignments between already existing entities created by themselves or other parties.

ceterms:AlignmentObject.label: Alignment Object
ceterms:AlignmentObject.definition: Entity describing the relationship between two nodes in different frameworks.
ceterms:AlignmentObject.comment: "Frameworks" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.
ceterms:AlignmentObject.usageNote: Used to compare concepts in concept schemes, levels in progression models, types of resource in an ontology etc.

ceterms:ApprenticeshipCertificate.label: Apprentice Certificate
ceterms:ApprenticeshipCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at the Apprentice level for successful completion of an apprenticeship program in industry trades and professions.

ceterms:ApproveAction.label: Approve Action
ceterms:ApproveAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent that pronounces a favorable judgment of a credential.
ceterms:ApproveAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:ArrayOperationCategory.label: Array Operation Category
ceterms:ArrayOperationCategory.definition: Concepts describing an action to be taken on an array of values.
ceterms:ArrayOperationCategory.usageNote: Used in CTDL for actions performed on arrays, lists or sets or values in order to obtain some other value.

ceterms:Assessment.label: Assessment
ceterms:Assessment.definition: Direct, indirect, formative, and summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality of an entity, performance, or outcome of an action.

ceterms:AssessmentComponent.label: Assessment Component
ceterms:AssessmentComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a direct, indirect, formative, and summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality of a resource, performance, or outcome of an action.
ceterms:AssessmentComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:AssessmentProfile.label: Assessment Profile
ceterms:AssessmentProfile.definition: Entity that describes the key characteristics of an assessment for a credential.
ceterms:AssessmentProfile.comment: Characteristics described include, but are not limited to, processes for assessment development, maintenance, selection and evaluation as well as assessment examples.
ceterms:AssessmentProfile.usageNote: The ceterms:AssessmentProfile is intended for use in describing stand-alone assessments. Assessments that are a part of a learning opportunity associated with a credential should be described as part the ceterms:LearningOpportunityProfile for that learning opportunity.

ceterms:AssessmentUse.label: Assessment Use
ceterms:AssessmentUse.definition: Types of Intended uses of an assessment.

ceterms:AssociateDegree.label: Associate Degree
ceterms:AssociateDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing the first two years of full-time postsecondary school education.
ceterms:AssociateDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 5, and United States IPEDS Award Level 3.
ceterms:AssociateDegree.usageNote: Use this class for types of Associate Degrees that are not covered by more specific subtypes.

ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedArtsDegree.label: Associate of Applied Arts Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedArtsDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing two years of full-time postsecondary school education in a technical, professional, or vocational program with an emphasis on direct employment in the arts and social sciences fields.
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedArtsDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 5, and United States IPEDS Award Level 3.
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedArtsDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedScienceDegree.label: Associate of Applied Science Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedScienceDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing two years of full-time postsecondary school education in a technical, professional, or vocational program with an emphasis on direct employment in applied scientific and technological fields.
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedScienceDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 5, and United States IPEDS Award Level 3.
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedScienceDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:AssociateOfArtsDegree.label: Associate of Arts Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfArtsDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing the first two years of full-time postsecondary school education with an emphasis in the liberal arts and sciences such as the humanities and social science fields.
ceterms:AssociateOfArtsDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 5, and United States IPEDS Award Level 3.
ceterms:AssociateOfArtsDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:AssociateOfScienceDegree.label: Associate of Science Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfScienceDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing the first two years of full-time postsecondary school education with an emphasis in scientific and technical fields and professional fields of study.
ceterms:AssociateOfScienceDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 5, and United States IPEDS Award Level 3.
ceterms:AssociateOfScienceDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:Audience.label: Audience
ceterms:Audience.definition: Types of audiences for which the resource being described is applicable or available.
ceterms:Audience.comment: If the resource is applicable or available for any type of audience, do not select anything.

ceterms:AudienceLevel.label: Audience Level
ceterms:AudienceLevel.definition: Types of levels in an academic or training progression expected of, or to be developed by, the typical person for the resource being described.

ceterms:BachelorDegree.label: Bachelor's Degree
ceterms:BachelorDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study.
ceterms:BachelorDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 6, and United States IPEDS Award Level 5.
ceterms:BachelorDegree.usageNote: Use for 5-year cooperative (work-study) programs. A cooperative plan provides for alternate class attendance and employment in business, industry, or government; thus, it allows students to combine actual work experience with their college studies. Also includes bachelor's degrees in which the normal 4 years of work are completed in 3 years.

ceterms:BachelorOfArtsDegree.label: Bachelor of Arts Degree
ceterms:BachelorOfArtsDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study, with an emphasis in the liberal arts and sciences such as the humanities and social science fields.
ceterms:BachelorOfArtsDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 6, and United States IPEDS Award Level 5.
ceterms:BachelorOfArtsDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:BachelorOfScienceDegree.label: Bachelor of Science Degree
ceterms:BachelorOfScienceDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study, with an emphasis in scientific and technical fields and professional fields of study.
ceterms:BachelorOfScienceDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 6, and United States IPEDS Award Level 5.
ceterms:BachelorOfScienceDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:Badge.label: Badge
ceterms:Badge.definition: Recognition designed to be displayed as a marker of accomplishment, activity, achievement, skill, interest, association, or identity.

ceterms:BasicComponent.label: Basic Component
ceterms:BasicComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a resource not otherwise covered by the enumerated PathwayComponent subclasses.
ceterms:BasicComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:BasicTechnicalCertificate.label: Basic Technical Certificate
ceterms:BasicTechnicalCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is completed within one semester, demonstrating competencies within a specific occupational area, indicating job readiness.
ceterms:BasicTechnicalCertificate.comment: Typically equivalent to a United States IPEDS level 1a that specifies postsecondary certificates of less than 300 clock hours, or less than 9 semester or trimester credit hours, or less than 13 quarter credit hours and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Levels 3 or 4.

ceterms:Certificate.label: Certificate
ceterms:Certificate.definition: Credential which designates participation in, completion of, or demonstration of requisite knowledge and skills for a formal academic or training program, an occupation, or non-formal learning.
ceterms:Certificate.comment: Distinct from degrees of higher education and typically non-renewable. For degrees of higher education use an appropriate type from the Degree hierarchy.

ceterms:CertificateOfCompletion.label: Certificate of Completion
ceterms:CertificateOfCompletion.definition: Credential that acknowledges completion of an assignment, training or other activity.
ceterms:CertificateOfCompletion.comment: A record of the activity may or may not exist, and the credential may or may not be designed as preparation for another resource such as a credential, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:CertificateOfParticipation.label: Certificate of Participation
ceterms:CertificateOfParticipation.definition: Credential that acknowledges attendance and/or engagement in an activity.
ceterms:CertificateOfParticipation.comment: These certificates do not imply completion, or mastery of specific skills, or that a grade has been awarded, but recognize the individual's active participation with an activity. A record of the activity may or may not exist, and the credential may or may not be designed as preparation for another resource such as a credential, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:Certification.label: Certification
ceterms:Certification.definition: Time-limited, revocable, renewable credential awarded by an authoritative body for demonstrating the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform specific tasks or an occupation.
ceterms:Certification.comment: Certifications can typically be revoked if not renewed, for a violation of a code of ethics (if applicable) or proven incompetence after due process. Description of revocation criteria for a specific Certification should be defined using Revocation Profile.

ceterms:ClaimType.label: Claim Type
ceterms:ClaimType.definition: Types of the claims supported by a verification service.

ceterms:CocurricularComponent.label: Cocurricular Component
ceterms:CocurricularComponent.definition: Resource that identifies an activity, program, or informal learning experience such as a civic or service activity that supplements and complements the curriculum.
ceterms:CocurricularComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:CollectionCategory.label: Collection Category
ceterms:CollectionCategory.definition: Types of collection, list, or array that groups together other resources.

ceterms:CollectionComponent.label: Collection Component
ceterms:CollectionComponent.definition: Resource that is a proxy for the entities contained in or referenced by an external Collection, Framework, or other such list, or for the list itself.
ceterms:CollectionComponent.usageNote: Completion or satisfaction of this Component entails completion or satisfaction of all members of the referenced list, unless otherwise indicated by Constraints or other relevant information.

ceterms:CollectionMember.label: Collection Member
ceterms:CollectionMember.definition: Provides information about the membership of a resource in a Collection.
ceterms:CollectionMember.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular collection so that the relationships between them and the collection can be stated without implying that those relationships are true in other contexts.
ceterms:CollectionMember.usageNote: The data recorded for a Collection Member should refer to the membership of the resource in a Collection.

ceterms:ComparatorCategory.label: Comparator Category
ceterms:ComparatorCategory.usageNote: Used in CTDL constraints as values of the ceterms:comparator property to make a comparison that should yield true or false. In all cases the left source of data is compared to the right source, sometimes the comparison is made after an action is applied, e.g. finding the mean of several numbers.

ceterms:CompetencyComponent.label: Competency Component
ceterms:CompetencyComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a measurable or observable knowledge, skill, or ability necessary to successful performance of a person in a given context.
ceterms:CompetencyComponent.comment: Competency is broadly defined to include assertions of academic, professional, occupational, vocational and life goals, outcomes, and standards, however labeled. Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:ComponentCondition.label: Component Condition
ceterms:ComponentCondition.definition: Resource that describes what must be done to complete a PathwayComponent, or part thereof, as determined by the issuer of the Pathway.
ceterms:ComponentCondition.comment: A ComponentCondition references a single RuleSet defining appropriate values fulfilling the condition.

ceterms:ConditionManifest.label: Condition Manifest
ceterms:ConditionManifest.definition: Set of constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements maintained at the organizational and/or sub-organizational level.
ceterms:ConditionManifest.comment: These conditions are intended to be referenced by external entities such as individual credentials in order to facilitate the process of their description and to reduce unnecessary duplication of data applicable across an array of entities.

ceterms:ConditionProfile.label: Condition Profile
ceterms:ConditionProfile.definition: Entity describing a constraint, prerequisite, entry condition, or requirement.
ceterms:ConditionProfile.comment: Constraints exist with credentials, learning opportunities, assessments and other entities to which they are subject during their lifecycles. In certain circumstances, the condition profile can be read as a description of a Person who meets the conditions.

ceterms:Constraint.label: Constraint
ceterms:Constraint.definition: Resource that identifies the parameters defining a limitation or restriction applicable to candidate pathway components.

ceterms:ConstraintRule.label: Constraint Rule
ceterms:ConstraintRule.comment: An instance of the Constraint Rule class is a deployable machine solution for executing pathway constraints using specifications such as XPath, JSONPath, JsonLogic, ShEx, SHACL, BPMN, XPDL and BPEL.

ceterms:ContactPoint.label: Contact Point
ceterms:ContactPoint.definition: Means of contacting an organization or its representative.
ceterms:ContactPoint.comment: For example, a public relations email address or phone number.

ceterms:CostManifest.label: Cost Manifest
ceterms:CostManifest.definition: Entity that describes a set of costs maintained at, and applicable across the organizational and/or sub-organizational level.
ceterms:CostManifest.comment: Instances of these ceterms:CostManifest entities are intended to be referenced by other entities to augment the process of describing their costs.

ceterms:CostProfile.label: Cost Profile
ceterms:CostProfile.definition: Entity that describes direct costs one would incur if one were to pursue a credential, assessment, learning opportunity, or aspects thereof.

ceterms:CostType.label: Cost Type
ceterms:CostType.definition: Entity that describes the types of costs related to earning or completing a credential, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:Course.label: Course
ceterms:Course.definition: Single structured sequence of one or more educational activities that aims to develop a prescribed set of competencies of learners.
ceterms:Course.comment: Course is distinct from Program, which aggregates several courses.

ceterms:CourseComponent.label: Course Component
ceterms:CourseComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a structured sequence of one or more learning activities that aims to develop a prescribed set of knowledge, skill, or ability of learners.
ceterms:CourseComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:Credential.label: Credential
ceterms:Credential.definition: Qualification, achievement, personal or organizational quality, or aspect of an identity typically used to indicate suitability.
ceterms:Credential.comment: The ceterms:Credential class is broadly defined to encompass credentials used across domains and communities of practice. The class should be used only when speaking of credentials in general. Subclasses of ceterms:Credential as defined by Credential Engine (or other communities) should be used when referencing specific types of credentials.

ceterms:CredentialAlignmentObject.label: Credential Alignment Object
ceterms:CredentialAlignmentObject.definition: Entity describing an affiliation or association between an entity such as a credential, learning opportunity or assessment and another entity in a structured framework such as a concept scheme, enumerated list, or competency framework.

ceterms:CredentialAssertion.label: Credential Assertion
ceterms:CredentialAssertion.definition: Representation of a credential awarded to a person.

ceterms:CredentialComponent.label: Credential Component
ceterms:CredentialComponent.definition: Resource that identifies another resource that describes qualification, achievement, personal or organizational quality, or aspect of an identity typically used to indicate suitability.
ceterms:CredentialComponent.comment: The ceterms:Credential class is broadly defined to encompass credentials used across domains and communities of practice. Subclasses of ceterms:Credential as defined by Credential Engine (or other communities) should be referenced. Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:CredentialFramework.label: Credential Framework
ceterms:CredentialFramework.definition: Class of all structured sets of conceptual entities intentionally designed for use as value vocabulary terms for description and classification in the credentialing context.
ceterms:CredentialFramework.comment: The class includes, but is not limited to, subclasses of specialized concept schemes describing industries, occupations, professions, learning contexts and jobs, as well as specialized subject concept schemes, assessment rubrics, proficiency scales, and competency frameworks.

ceterms:CredentialOrganization.label: Credential Organization
ceterms:CredentialOrganization.definition: Organization that plays one or more key roles in the lifecycle of a credential.
ceterms:CredentialOrganization.usageNote: For organizations that are not a Credential Organization or a QA Credential Organization, use ceterms:Organization.

ceterms:CredentialPerson.label: CredentialPerson
ceterms:CredentialPerson.definition: Person who plays a role as primary agent in a credentialing action.
ceterms:CredentialPerson.comment: The ceterms:CredentialPerson class should be used to describe persons directly engaged as primary agent in credentialing actions such as approving, offering, recognizing, renewing and revoking credentials and should not include persons merely affiliated with, or employed by organizations that perform such actions.

ceterms:CredentialStatus.label: Credential Status
ceterms:CredentialStatus.definition: Types of applicability statuses of a credential.

ceterms:CredentialType.label: Credential Type
ceterms:CredentialType.definition: Type of credential as defined by an authoritative body for use within an officially regulated qualification system.
ceterms:CredentialType.comment: Examples include various qualifications such as generic types of degrees, diplomas and certificates that are defined with official standing in many countries with regulations concerning who can offer them and what is required to earn them. They are often referenced against the qualification framework for the relevant jurisdiction.
ceterms:CredentialType.usageNote: To be used as the value of the credentialType property with the nearest matching subclass of ceterms:Credential used as the value of the type property. The CredentialType allows similar credentials from different jurisdictions to be identified, compared and contrasted; the Credential Class allows grouping of broadly similar credentials.

ceterms:CredentialingAction.label: Credentialing Action
ceterms:CredentialingAction.definition: Action taken by an agent affecting the status of an object entity.
ceterms:CredentialingAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:CreditUnit.label: Credit Unit
ceterms:CreditUnit.definition: Broad descriptions of units used to measure credit associated with a resource.

ceterms:Degree.label: Degree
ceterms:Degree.definition: Academic credential conferred upon completion of a program or course of study, typically over multiple years at a college or university.

ceterms:Delivery.label: Delivery Type
ceterms:Delivery.definition: Types of technical form for providing instances of the entity.

ceterms:Diploma.label: Diploma
ceterms:Diploma.definition: Credential awarded by educational institutions for successful completion of a course of study or its equivalent.

ceterms:DoctoralDegree.label: Doctoral Degree
ceterms:DoctoralDegree.definition: Highest credential award for students who have completed both a bachelor's degree and a master's degree or their equivalent as well as independent research and/or a significant project or paper.
ceterms:DoctoralDegree.comment: Equivalent to UNESCO ISCED, Level 8 and United States IPEDS Award Levels 17, 18, and 19.
ceterms:DoctoralDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:DurationProfile.label: Duration Profile
ceterms:DurationProfile.definition: Entity describing the temporal aspects of a resource.
ceterms:DurationProfile.comment: Temporal aspects include exact, minimum, and maximum timeframes of an activity.

ceterms:EarningsProfile.label: Earnings Profile
ceterms:EarningsProfile.definition: Entity that describes earning and related statistical information for a given credential.
ceterms:EarningsProfile.usageNote: The use of ceterms:AggregateDataProfile instead of this class is strongly recommended.

ceterms:EmploymentOutcomeProfile.label: Employment Outcome Profile
ceterms:EmploymentOutcomeProfile.definition: Entity that describes employment outcomes and related statistical information for a given credential.
ceterms:EmploymentOutcomeProfile.usageNote: The use of ceterms:AggregateDataProfile instead of this class is strongly recommended.

ceterms:EvaluationOutcome.label: Evaluation Outcome
ceterms:EvaluationOutcome.definition: Entity that describes the results of a valuation or appraisal of a resource.
ceterms:EvaluationOutcome.usageNote: Do not use for test results or other outcomes of assessments of people.

ceterms:ExternalInput.label: External Input
ceterms:ExternalInput.definition: Types of external stakeholders that provide input to the process.

ceterms:ExtracurricularComponent.label: Extracurricular Component
ceterms:ExtracurricularComponent.definition: Resource that identifies an activity, program, or informal learning experience that may be offered or provided by a school, college, or other organization that is not connected to a curriculum.
ceterms:ExtracurricularComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:FinancialAssistance.label: Financial Assistance
ceterms:FinancialAssistance.definition: Types of financial assistance typically available in the United States.

ceterms:FinancialAssistanceProfile.label: Financial Assistance Profile
ceterms:FinancialAssistanceProfile.definition: Entity that describes financial assistance that is offered or available.

ceterms:GeneralEducationDevelopment.label: General Education Development (GED)
ceterms:GeneralEducationDevelopment.definition: Credential awarded by examination that demonstrates that an individual has acquired secondary school-level academic skills.
ceterms:GeneralEducationDevelopment.comment: Equivalent to a secondary school diploma, based on passing a state- or province-selected examination such as GED, HiSET, or TASC; or to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011 Levels 2 or 3.

ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel1Certificat.label: General Education Level 1 Certificate
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel1Certificat.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of general education courses that cover a broad range of foundational academic skills and takes less than 1 year.
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel1Certificat.comment: Can lead to a General Education Certificate Level 2 or a degree. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 1b that specifies postsecondary certificates of 300-899 clock hours, or 9-29 semester or trimester credit hours, or 13-44 quarter credit hours and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 4.
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel1Certificat.usageNote: If the competencies are related to a specific subject area or occupational area use the Technical Level 1 or use a Higher Education Certificate.

ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel2Certificat.label: General Education Level 2 Certificate
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel2Certificat.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of general education courses that takes at least 1 year that cover a broad range of foundational academic skills and takes less than 2 years to complete.
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel2Certificat.comment: Can lead to a degree. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 2 that specifies postsecondary certificates of at least 900 but less than 1,800 clock hours, or at least 30 but less than 60 semester or trimester credit hours, or at least 45 but less than 90 quarter credit hours and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 4.
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel2Certificat.usageNote: If the competencies are related to a specific subject area or occupational area use the Technical Level 2 or use a Higher Education Certificate.

ceterms:GeoCoordinates.label: Geographic Coordinates
ceterms:GeoCoordinates.definition: Geographic coordinates of a place or event including latitude and longitude as well as other locational information.

ceterms:HigherEducationLevel1Certificate.label: Higher Education Level 1 Certificate
ceterms:HigherEducationLevel1Certificate.definition: Credential awarded at the postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal higher education program that takes about one year in a specific subject.
ceterms:HigherEducationLevel1Certificate.comment: Typically equivalent to 60 ECTS Credits at Level 5 in the European Qualifications Framework or UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 5.

ceterms:HigherEducationLevel2Certificate.label: Higher Education Level 2 Certificate
ceterms:HigherEducationLevel2Certificate.definition: Credential awarded at the postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal higher education program that takes about two years in a specific subject.
ceterms:HigherEducationLevel2Certificate.comment: Typically equivalent to 120 ECTS Credits at Level 5 in the European Qualifications Framework and the Short Cycle in the Qualifications Framework of the European Higher Education Area, or UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 5.

ceterms:HoldersProfile.label: Holders Profile
ceterms:HoldersProfile.definition: Entity describing the count and related statistical information of holders of a given credential.
ceterms:HoldersProfile.usageNote: The use of ceterms:AggregateDataProfile instead of this class is strongly recommended.

ceterms:IdentifierValue.label: Identifier Value
ceterms:IdentifierValue.definition: Means of identifying a resource, typically consisting of an alphanumeric token and a context or scheme from which that token originates.
ceterms:IdentifierValue.usageNote: Where a formal identification system exists for the identifier, recommended best practice is to use a string conforming to that system.

ceterms:Industry.label: Industry
ceterms:Industry.definition: Broad category of economic activities encompassing various sectors.

ceterms:IndustryClassification.label: Industry Classification
ceterms:IndustryClassification.definition: Class of of concept schemes defining industries such as NAICS in the U.S. and ESCO in the European Union.

ceterms:InstructionalProgramClassificati.label: Instructional Program Classification
ceterms:InstructionalProgramClassificati.definition: Class of concept schemes defining instructional program types such as the CIP codes in the U.S.
ceterms:InstructionalProgramClassificati.usageNote: Class of concept schemes defining types

ceterms:Job.label: Job
ceterms:Job.definition: Set of responsibilities based on work roles within an occupation as defined by an employer.
ceterms:Job.comment: Job describes an abstraction or template that specific job postings or openings could be instances of.

ceterms:JobComponent.label: Job Component
ceterms:JobComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a work position, employment, or occupation.
ceterms:JobComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:JourneymanCertificate.label: Journeyman Certificate
ceterms:JourneymanCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at the Journeyman level for successful completion of an apprenticeship program in industry trades and professions.

ceterms:JurisdictionProfile.label: Jurisdiction Profile
ceterms:JurisdictionProfile.definition: Geo-political information about applicable geographic areas and their exceptions.

ceterms:LearningMethod.label: Learning Method
ceterms:LearningMethod.definition: Types of methods used to conduct the learning opportunity.

ceterms:LearningOpportunity.label: Learning Opportunity
ceterms:LearningOpportunity.definition: Structured and unstructured learning and development opportunities based in direct experience, formal and informal study, observation, and involvement in discourse and practice.
ceterms:LearningOpportunity.comment: Examples of learning opportunities include education and training programs and classes, courses of study, apprenticeship or work experience programs, or other structured experiences intended to serve as educational or training events.
ceterms:LearningOpportunity.usageNote: Classes of learning opportunities defined in other namespaces such as schema.org/Course may be declared as equivaleny or subclasses of ceterms:LearningOpportunity to support their discovery through applications processing CTDL data.

ceterms:LearningOpportunityProfile.label: Learning Opportunity Profile
ceterms:LearningOpportunityProfile.definition: Entity describing an educational or training opportunity.
ceterms:LearningOpportunityProfile.comment: Opportunities include formal and informal educational training programs and classes, apprenticeship or work experience programs, or other structured or unstructured experiences that serve as educational or training activities.

ceterms:LearningProgram.label: Learning Program
ceterms:LearningProgram.definition: Set of learning opportunities that leads to an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate.

ceterms:LearningRecognitionEvidenceCateg.label: Learning Recognition Evidence Category
ceterms:LearningRecognitionEvidenceCateg.definition: Concepts describing types of evidence accepted for learning recognition evaluation.

ceterms:LearningRecognitionMethodCategor.label: Learning Recognition Method Category
ceterms:LearningRecognitionMethodCategor.definition: Concepts describing methods used to evaluate and recognize learning.

ceterms:LearningRecognitionOutcomeCatego.label: Learning Recognition Outcome Category
ceterms:LearningRecognitionOutcomeCatego.definition: Concepts describing outcomes of learning recognition.

ceterms:LearningRecognitionSourceCategor.label: Learning Recognition Source Category
ceterms:LearningRecognitionSourceCategor.definition: Concepts describing formal, non-formal, or informal contexts from which learning may be recognized for applicability toward requirements.

ceterms:LearningResource.label: Learning Resource
ceterms:LearningResource.definition: Entity that is used as part of an learning activity (e.g. a textbook) or that describes (e.g. a lesson plan) or records the educational activity (e.g. an audio- or video-recording of a lesson).

ceterms:License.label: License
ceterms:License.definition: Credential awarded by a government agency or other authorized organization that constitutes legal authority to do a specific job and/or utilize a specific item, system or infrastructure and are typically earned through some combination of degree or certificate attainment, certifications, assessments, work experience, and/or fees, and are time-limited and must be renewed periodically.

ceterms:LifeCycleStatus.label: Life Cycle Status
ceterms:LifeCycleStatus.definition: Types of states of a resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle.

ceterms:LogicalOperatorCategory.label: Logical Operator Category
ceterms:LogicalOperatorCategory.definition: Logical operators applicable to two or more items.
ceterms:LogicalOperatorCategory.usageNote: Used in CTDL for types of logical operator for combining two or more nested ComponentCondition entities, Constraint entities, or a mix of ComponentCondition and Constraint entities.

ceterms:MasterCertificate.label: Master Trade Certificate
ceterms:MasterCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at the Master level for demonstration of the highest level of skills and performance in industry trades and professions.

ceterms:MasterDegree.label: Master's Degree
ceterms:MasterDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent.
ceterms:MasterDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 7, and United States IPEDS Award Level 7.

ceterms:MasterOfArtsDegree.label: Master of Arts Degree
ceterms:MasterOfArtsDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent, with an emphasis in the liberal arts and sciences such as the humanities and social science fields.
ceterms:MasterOfArtsDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 7, and United States IPEDS Award Level 7.
ceterms:MasterOfArtsDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:MasterOfScienceDegree.label: Master of Science Degree
ceterms:MasterOfScienceDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent, with an emphasis in scientific and technical fields and professional fields of study.
ceterms:MasterOfScienceDegree.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 7, and United States IPEDS Award Level 7.
ceterms:MasterOfScienceDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:MicroCredential.label: Micro-Credential
ceterms:MicroCredential.definition: Credential that addresses a subset of field-specific knowledge, skills, or competencies; often developmental with relationships to other micro-credentials and field credentials.

ceterms:MultiComponent.label: Multi Component
ceterms:MultiComponent.definition: Resource that is a proxy for multiple entities.
ceterms:MultiComponent.usageNote: Completion or satisfaction of this Component entails completion or satisfaction of all entities for which this Component is a proxy, unless otherwise indicated by Constraints or other relevant information.

ceterms:Occupation.label: Occupation
ceterms:Occupation.definition: Profession, trade, or career field that may involve training and/or a formal qualification.

ceterms:OccupationClassification.label: Occupation Classification
ceterms:OccupationClassification.definition: Class of concept schemes identifying occupations such as the Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) system in the U.S. and the European Skills/Competences, Qualifications and Occupations (ESCO).

ceterms:OfferAction.label: Offer Action
ceterms:OfferAction.definition: Action by an authoritative agent offering access to a entity such as a credential, learning opportunity or assessment.
ceterms:OfferAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:OpenBadge.label: Open Badge
ceterms:OpenBadge.definition: Visual symbol containing verifiable claims in accordance with the Open Badges specification and delivered digitally.

ceterms:Organization.label: Organization
ceterms:Organization.definition: An entity such as an association, company, corporation, club, co-operative, labor union etc.
ceterms:Organization.usageNote: Use for organizations that are not a Credential Organization or a QACredential Organization.

ceterms:Pathway.label: Pathway
ceterms:Pathway.definition: Resource composed of a structured set of PathwayComponents defining points along a route to fulfillment of a goal or objective.

ceterms:PathwayComponent.label: Pathway Component
ceterms:PathwayComponent.definition: Resource that serves as a defined point along the route of a Pathway which describes an objective and its completion requirements through reference to one or more instances of ComponentCondition.
ceterms:PathwayComponent.comment: An instance of PathwayComponent may serve as the goal or destination node of a Pathway.
ceterms:PathwayComponent.usageNote: PathwayComponent is a super-type that represents a family of more precise sub-types. In pathway descriptions, always use the sub-type of PathwayComponent appropriate to your circumstances, e.g., AssessmentComponent, CocurricularComponent, CompetencyComponent, CourseComponent, CredentialComponent, ExtracurricularComponent, JobComponent, and WorkExperienceComponent. Use BasicComponent for types of entities not covered by the current set of sub-types.

ceterms:PathwaySet.label: Pathway Set
ceterms:PathwaySet.definition: A roadmap of multiple related pathways that lead to one or more destinations.

ceterms:PayProfile.label: Pay Profile
ceterms:PayProfile.definition: Entity that describes the monetary compensation for work.

ceterms:Place.label: Place
ceterms:Place.definition: Entity describing a physical location or geospatial area.

ceterms:PostBaccalaureateCertificate.label: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate
ceterms:PostBaccalaureateCertificate.definition: Credential award that requires completion of an organized program of study at a level beyond that of a bachelor's degree, which is designed for persons who have completed a baccalaureate degree but does not meet the requirements of a master's degree.
ceterms:PostBaccalaureateCertificate.comment: This may include certificates that are for specialties within an occupational field or occupational program of study. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 6 and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 7.

ceterms:PostMasterCertificate.label: Post-Master Certificate
ceterms:PostMasterCertificate.definition: Credential award that requires completion of an organized program of study beyond that of a master's degree, which is designed for persons who have completed a master's degree but does not meet the requirements of a doctor's degree.
ceterms:PostMasterCertificate.comment: This may include certificates that are for specialties within an occupational field or occupational program of study and can include post-doctoral first professional certificates such as healthcare and law. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 7 or 17, 18, and 19, and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 8.

ceterms:PreApprenticeshipCertificate.label: Pre-Apprenticeship Certificate
ceterms:PreApprenticeshipCertificate.definition: Credential awarded to indicate readiness for an apprentice-level program.

ceterms:PriorLearningPolicy.label: Prior Learning Policy
ceterms:PriorLearningPolicy.definition: Authoritative statement of rules, principles, or procedures adopted by an organization to govern decisions and actions within the scope of prior learning.

ceterms:ProcessProfile.label: Process Profile
ceterms:ProcessProfile.definition: Entity describing the type, nature, and other relevant information about a process.

ceterms:ProfessionalCertificate.label: Professional Certificate
ceterms:ProfessionalCertificate.definition: Credential awarded for demonstrating competencies in a profession or particular occupational field, including job readiness.
ceterms:ProfessionalCertificate.comment: These certificates validate competency in tasks, tools, software, or procedures within a particular industry and are often awarded by training centers, career and technical education, industry organizations, or businesses.

ceterms:ProfessionalDoctorate.label: Professional Doctorate
ceterms:ProfessionalDoctorate.definition: Doctoral degree conferred upon completion of a program providing the knowledge and skills for the recognition, credential, or license required for professional practice.
ceterms:ProfessionalDoctorate.comment: Equivalent to UNESCO ISCED, Level 8 and United States IPEDS Award Level 18.
ceterms:ProfessionalDoctorate.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:ProficiencyCertificate.label: Proficiency Certificate
ceterms:ProficiencyCertificate.definition: Credential awarded after assessment of skills in a specific area defined by a recognized body of experts, without regard for how the skills were learned.
ceterms:ProficiencyCertificate.comment: Examples of specific areas include language, typing, music, and dance.

ceterms:QACredentialOrganization.label: QA Credential Organization
ceterms:QACredentialOrganization.definition: Quality assurance organization that plays one or more key roles in the lifecycle of a credential, learning program, or assessment.
ceterms:QACredentialOrganization.usageNote: For organizations that are not a QA Credential Organization or a Credential Organization, use ceterms:Organization.

ceterms:QualificationsFramework.label: Qualifications Framework
ceterms:QualificationsFramework.definition: Instrument for developing, classifying and issuing qualifications at international, national, regional or sectoral levels according to a set of criteria (such as descriptors) applicable to specified levels of learning outcomes.

ceterms:QualityAssuranceCredential.label: Quality Assurance Credential
ceterms:QualityAssuranceCredential.definition: Credential assuring that an organization, program, or awarded credential meets prescribed requirements and may include development and administration of qualifying examinations.

ceterms:RecognizeAction.label: Recognize Action
ceterms:RecognizeAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent acknowledging the validity of a resource.
ceterms:RecognizeAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:RegistrationAction.label: Registration Action
ceterms:RegistrationAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent that registers a resource that has been vetted, approved, and validated to meet specific criteria.

ceterms:RegulateAction.label: Regulate Action
ceterms:RegulateAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent enforcing the legal requirements of a resource.
ceterms:RegulateAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:RegulatoryInformation.label: Regulatory Information
ceterms:RegulatoryInformation.definition: Statements provided about a resource in order to comply with legal requirements.
ceterms:RegulatoryInformation.comment: The statements are provided using the ceterms:structuredStatement property. Other properties provide contextualizing information about these statements.

ceterms:RenewAction.label: Renew Action
ceterms:RenewAction.definition: Action by an agent renewing an existing credential assertion.
ceterms:RenewAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:ResearchDoctorate.label: Research Doctorate
ceterms:ResearchDoctorate.definition: Doctoral degree conferred for advanced work beyond the master level, including the preparation and defense of a thesis or dissertation based on original research, or the planning and execution of an original project demonstrating substantial artistic or scholarly achievement.
ceterms:ResearchDoctorate.comment: Equivalent to UNESCO ISCED, Level 8 and United States IPEDS Award Level 17.
ceterms:ResearchDoctorate.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:RevocationProfile.label: Revocation Profile
ceterms:RevocationProfile.definition: Entity describing conditions and methods by which a credential can be removed from a holder.

ceterms:RevokeAction.label: Revoke Action
ceterms:RevokeAction.definition: Action by an agent removing an awarded credential (credential assertion) from the credential holder based on violations or failure of the holder to renew.
ceterms:RevokeAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:RightsAction.label: Rights Action
ceterms:RightsAction.definition: Action asserting legal rights by an agent to possess, defend, transfer, license, and grant conditional access to a credential, learning opportunity, or assessment.
ceterms:RightsAction.comment: Since an instance of ceterms:CredentialingAction is a claim that a certain agent has taken the action being described, creation of such a ceterms:CredentialingAction should be reserved to the agent of that action.

ceterms:ScheduleFrequency.label: Schedule Frequency
ceterms:ScheduleFrequency.definition: Types for how often events occur.

ceterms:ScheduleTiming.label: Schedule Timing
ceterms:ScheduleTiming.definition: Types for when (in time) events occur.

ceterms:ScheduledOffering.label: Scheduled Offering
ceterms:ScheduledOffering.definition: Offering of a Learning Opportunity or Assessment with a schedule associated with a specified location or modality.
ceterms:ScheduledOffering.comment: Provides data specific to a given scheduled offering; the Learning Opportunity (including Course and Learning Program) or Assessment being offered provides all data that is shared between different offerings.
ceterms:ScheduledOffering.usageNote: Rather than repeating data, only use this class if the data differs from the data provided by the resource for which this is an offer.

ceterms:SecondaryEducationCertificate.label: Secondary Education Certificate
ceterms:SecondaryEducationCertificate.definition: Credential for successful completion of a formal secondary-level education program that is less than a diploma and does not indicate completion of secondary education graduation requirements.
ceterms:SecondaryEducationCertificate.usageNote: Use Diploma or General Education Development to indicate completion of secondary education graduation requirements.

ceterms:SecondarySchoolDiploma.label: Secondary School Diploma
ceterms:SecondarySchoolDiploma.definition: Diploma awarded by secondary education institutions for successful completion of a secondary school program of study.
ceterms:SecondarySchoolDiploma.comment: Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011 Levels 2 or 3.

ceterms:SpecialistDegree.label: Specialist Degree
ceterms:SpecialistDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the master’s degree and less than a doctoral degree and provide specific preparation for advanced careers in a specialist field.
ceterms:SpecialistDegree.comment: Equivalent to UNESCO ISCED, Level 8, and United States IPEDS Award Level 8.
ceterms:SpecialistDegree.usageNote: Use the name property to capture local variations on what this class covers.

ceterms:StatementCategory.label: Statement Category
ceterms:StatementCategory.definition: Concepts used to classify the nature or purpose of structured statements.
ceterms:StatementCategory.usageNote: If a more granular or precise classification is required for local purposes than is available in this concept scheme, best practice is to publish a description of it as a skos:Concept and to use it alongside the best match broader category in this scheme.

ceterms:StructuredStatement.label: Structured Statement
ceterms:StructuredStatement.definition: A statement provided verbatim or by reference, with additional context such as type, source, or citation.
ceterms:StructuredStatement.usageNote: Do not use a StructureStatement if a property such as ceterms:description is adequate. When using ceterms:StructuredStatement use ceterms:statementText for the text in a document. Use ceterms:description and ceterms:subjectWebpage when a link is needed to the text in a document. The link should be directly to the relevant section of the document.

ceterms:SupportService.label: Support Service
ceterms:SupportService.definition: Resources and assistance that help people overcome barriers to succeed in their education and career goals.
ceterms:SupportService.comment: Support services can be provided at any stage of an individual's education or career, and may be targeted towards people with or without direct affiliation with an organization. The goal of support services is to provide people with the assistance they need to achieve their full potential.  Examples of Support Services include career advice, job placement, childcare, transportation, tools, mentorship, counseling, and other forms of aid.

ceterms:SupportServiceCategory.label: Support Service Category
ceterms:SupportServiceCategory.definition: Types of support services to help people succeed in their education and career goals.

ceterms:Task.label: Task
ceterms:Task.definition: Specific activity, typically related to performing a function or achieving a goal.

ceterms:TechnicalLevel1Certificate.label: Technical Level 1 Certificate
ceterms:TechnicalLevel1Certificate.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is more than one semester and less than 1 year, demonstrating competencies within a specific subject area or an occupational area indicating job readiness.
ceterms:TechnicalLevel1Certificate.comment: Can lead to a Technical Certificate Level 2 or a degree. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 1b that specifies postsecondary certificates of 300-899 clock hours, or 9-29 semester or trimester credit hours, or 13-44 quarter credit hours and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 4.

ceterms:TechnicalLevel2Certificate.label: Technical Level 2 Certificate
ceterms:TechnicalLevel2Certificate.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is at least 1 year but less than 2 years, demonstrating competencies within a specific subject area or in an occupational area indicating job readiness.
ceterms:TechnicalLevel2Certificate.comment: Can lead to a degree. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 2 that specifies postsecondary certificates of at least 900 but less than 1,800 clock hours, or at least 30 but less than 60 semester or trimester credit hours, or at least 45 but less than 90 quarter credit hours and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 4.

ceterms:TechnicalLevel3Certificate.label: Technical Level 3 Certificate
ceterms:TechnicalLevel3Certificate.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is at least 2 years but less than 4 years, demonstrating competencies within specific occupational areas indicating job readiness.
ceterms:TechnicalLevel3Certificate.comment: Can lead to a degree. Equivalent to a United States IPEDS Award Level 4 that specifies certificates of 1,800 or more clock hours, or 60 or more semester or trimester credit hours, or 90 or more quarter credit hours and UNESCO ISCED 2011 Level 5.

ceterms:TransferAgreement.label: Transfer Agreement
ceterms:TransferAgreement.definition: Formal agreement between two or more parties that specifies how prior learning is recognized, including its transfer and applicability for credit.
ceterms:TransferAgreement.comment: May include articulation agreements, memoranda of understanding, or similar arrangements that govern how learning achievements are recognized across organizations or other boundaries.

ceterms:TransferIntermediary.label: Transfer Intermediary
ceterms:TransferIntermediary.definition: Surrogate resource to which other resources are mapped in order to indicate their common transferability.
ceterms:TransferIntermediary.usageNote: Used when multiple resources such as courses are grouped together to indicate they have mutually agreed upon transfer value.

ceterms:TransferValueProfile.label: Transfer Value Profile
ceterms:TransferValueProfile.definition: Description of learning value from one context when transferred to another.
ceterms:TransferValueProfile.comment: The learning value described in a Transfer Value Profile is commonly expressed as credit earned in one context and applied toward another, enabling a person to fulfill requirements without repeating equivalent learning. Other forms of recognition of prior learning, such as competencies or exemptions, may also be described.
ceterms:TransferValueProfile.usageNote: Transfer Value Profile is used to describe learning value in contexts such as recognition of prior learning or transfer. It does not describe the inherent credit value of a resource within the organization that owns or offers it; use ceterms:creditValue with a Value Profile for that purpose.

ceterms:ValueProfile.label: Value Profile
ceterms:ValueProfile.definition: A description of value awarded for, required by, or otherwise related to the resource.

ceterms:VerificationServiceProfile.label: Verification Service Profile
ceterms:VerificationServiceProfile.definition: Entity describing the means by which someone can verify whether a credential has been attained.
ceterms:VerificationServiceProfile.comment: Includes, but is not limited to, verification of whether quality assurance credentials have been issued for organizations, learning opportunities, and assessments.

ceterms:WorkBasedLearningCertificate.label: Work-Based Learning Certificate
ceterms:WorkBasedLearningCertificate.definition: Credential awarded for work-based learning and earn-and-learn models that meet standards and are applicable to industry, trades, occupations, and professions.
ceterms:WorkBasedLearningCertificate.comment: Work-based learning includes many types of skills training that are occupation specific including, but not limited to apprenticeships.

ceterms:WorkExperienceComponent.label: Work Experience Component
ceterms:WorkExperienceComponent.definition: Resource describing an activity or training through which a person gains job experience.
ceterms:WorkExperienceComponent.comment: Instances act as proxies or stand-ins for other resources in the context of a particular pathway so that relationships between them as components of that pathway can be stated without implying that the those relationships are true of the resources in other contexts.

ceterms:WorkRole.label: Work Role
ceterms:WorkRole.definition: Collection of tasks and competencies that embody a particular function in one or more jobs.

ceterms:WorkforceDemandAction.label: Workforce Demand Action
ceterms:WorkforceDemandAction.definition: Action taken by an agent asserting that the resource being described has a workforce demand level worthy of note.

ceterms:accommodationType.label: Accommodation Type
ceterms:accommodationType.definition: Type of modification to facilitate equal access for people to a physical location, resource, or service.

ceterms:accreditedBy.label: Accredited By
