ceterms:accreditedBy.definition: Quality assurance organization that provides official authorization to, or approval of, a credential, organization, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:accreditedIn.label: Accredited In
ceterms:accreditedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential, learning opportunity or assessment is accredited.

ceterms:accredits.label: Accredits
ceterms:accredits.definition: Credential, assessment, organization, or learning opportunity for which this organization provides official authorization or approval based on prescribed standards or criteria.
ceterms:accredits.usageNote: Accredits includes the ongoing monitoring to confirm continued conformance to standards to maintain accreditation.

ceterms:actingAgent.label: Acting Agent
ceterms:actingAgent.definition: Organization or person performing an action.

ceterms:actionStatusType.label: Action Status Type
ceterms:actionStatusType.definition: Entity describing the current disposition or standing of an action; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:address.label: Address
ceterms:address.definition: Particulars describing the location of the place.

ceterms:addressCountry.label: Address Country
ceterms:addressCountry.definition: Nation with its own government and occupying a particular territory identified by the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

ceterms:addressLocality.label: Address Locality
ceterms:addressLocality.definition: Town, city, or village in which a particular location is situtated.

ceterms:addressRegion.label: Address Region
ceterms:addressRegion.definition: State or province in which a particular location is situated.

ceterms:administrationProcess.label: Administration Process
ceterms:administrationProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource is administered.
ceterms:administrationProcess.comment: Processes described include the execution of events and the development of resources in the lifecycle of a credential or organization, such as the process for the proctoring of assessments.
ceterms:administrationProcess.usageNote: For assessments and rubrics, this can be used to indicate the scoring algorithm.

ceterms:advancedStandingFrom.label: Advanced Standing From
ceterms:advancedStandingFrom.definition: Resource that has its time or cost reduced by another resource.

ceterms:affiliatedAgent.label: Affiliated Agent
ceterms:affiliatedAgent.definition: Organization or person that plays some role in assigning, performing, assisting with, facilitating, approving of, or otherwise being involved with the task being described.

ceterms:affiliation.label: Affiliation
ceterms:affiliation.definition: Organization to which a person is formally related through work, sudy, or social engagement.

ceterms:agentPurpose.label: Agent Purpose
ceterms:agentPurpose.definition: Organization's primary purpose as found on an "about" page of a website.

ceterms:agentPurposeDescription.label: Agent Purpose Description
ceterms:agentPurposeDescription.definition: Short, key phrases describing the primary purpose of an organization as might be derived from the "about" page of it's website.

ceterms:agentSectorType.label: Agent Sector Type
ceterms:agentSectorType.definition: Type of sociological, economic, or political subdivision served by an organization; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:agentSectorType.usageNote: Recommended best practice for credentials in the Credential Engine Registry is to use concepts from the ceterms:AgentSector vocabulary.

ceterms:agentType.label: Agent Type
ceterms:agentType.definition: Type of organization such as educational institution, credentialing organization or quality assurance body; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:agentType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:OrganizationType vocabulary.

ceterms:agreementType.label: Agreement Type
ceterms:agreementType.definition: Type or nature of the document that is being described.
ceterms:agreementType.usageNote: Best practice is to draw from an existing concept scheme such as ceterms:DocumentCategory, which may be supplemented by more precise terms from a locally defined concept scheme if required.

ceterms:alignmentDate.label: Alignment Date
ceterms:alignmentDate.definition: The date  the alignment was made.

ceterms:alignmentType.label: Alignment Type
ceterms:alignmentType.definition: Type of relationship between two entities.
ceterms:alignmentType.usageNote: This property is necessary only for AlignmentObjects as part of an AlignmentMap where it is the property that expresses the alignment from the source node (as subject) and target node (as object). When the CredentialAlignmentObject is used, the type value is definitively identified by the property that points to it and so in this case the alignmentType property is redundant.

ceterms:alternateName.label: Alternate Name
ceterms:alternateName.definition: Alias for the entity including acronyms, alpha-numeric notations, and other forms of name abbreviations in common use.

ceterms:alternativeCondition.label: Alternative Condition
ceterms:alternativeCondition.definition: Constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements in a context where more than one alternative condition or path has been defined and from which any one path fulfills the parent condition.
ceterms:alternativeCondition.comment: A set of alternative conditions are not necessarily mutually exclusive paths; for example, a set of alternative concentrations for a degree may allow a person to optionally complete more than one concentration even though only one is required to earn the degree.

ceterms:appealProcess.label: Appeal Process
ceterms:appealProcess.definition: Description of a formal process for objecting to decisions of an organization.

ceterms:applicability.label: Applicability
ceterms:applicability.definition: Receiving curriculum or requirement context to which the transfer value is applied.
ceterms:applicability.usageNote: If the types of applicability are formally defined as an enumeration published with URIs, > then the relevant URI can be entered as the targetNode of the Credential Alignment Object; if they are informally defined or not published then use the targetNodeName and targetNodeDescription of the Credential Alignment Object to define the relevant type.

ceterms:approvedBy.label: Approved By
ceterms:approvedBy.definition: Agent that pronounces favorable judgment for this resource.

ceterms:approvedIn.label: Approved In
ceterms:approvedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which an organization pronounces favorable judgment for this resource.

ceterms:approves.label: Approves
ceterms:approves.definition: Credential, assessment, learning opportunity, or organization for which this organization pronounces favorable judgment.

ceterms:approximateClosingDate.label: Approximate Closing Date
ceterms:approximateClosingDate.definition: Approximate date the organization ceased operations or ceased to exist.
ceterms:approximateClosingDate.comment: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateClosingDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:closingDate.

ceterms:approximateDateEffective.label: Approximate Date Effective
ceterms:approximateDateEffective.definition: Approximate date after which this resource is available or applicable.
ceterms:approximateDateEffective.comment: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateDateEffective.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:dateEffective.

ceterms:approximateEndDate.label: Approximate End Date
ceterms:approximateEndDate.definition: Approximate date some event or activity ends.
ceterms:approximateEndDate.comment: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateEndDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:endDate.

ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.label: Approximate Expiration Date
ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.definition: Approximate date beyond which the resource is no longer offered or available.
ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.comment: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateExpirationDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:expirationDate.

ceterms:approximateStartDate.label: Approximate Start Date
ceterms:approximateStartDate.definition: Approximate date the validity or usefulness of the information in this resource begins.
ceterms:approximateStartDate.comment: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.
ceterms:approximateStartDate.usageNote: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05).  If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:startDate.

ceterms:assertedBy.label: Asserted By
ceterms:assertedBy.definition: Agent making a statement based on fact or belief.

ceterms:assessmentDeliveryType.label: Assessment Delivery Type
ceterms:assessmentDeliveryType.definition: Delivery type for the assessment for the credential.
ceterms:assessmentDeliveryType.comment: Indicates the delivery type for the assessment for the credential.

ceterms:assessmentExampleDescription.label: Assessment Example Description
ceterms:assessmentExampleDescription.definition: Text of an example assessment or assessment item.

ceterms:assessmentMethodDescription.label: Assessment Method Description
ceterms:assessmentMethodDescription.definition: Description of the methods used to conduct assessment.

ceterms:assessmentMethodType.label: Assessment Method Type
ceterms:assessmentMethodType.definition: Type of method used to conduct an assessment; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:assessmentMethodType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:AssessmentMethod vocabulary.

ceterms:assessmentOutput.label: Assessment Output
ceterms:assessmentOutput.definition: Description of the assessment artifact, performance or examination.

ceterms:assessmentUseType.label: Assessment Use Type
ceterms:assessmentUseType.definition: Type of intended use of the assessment; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:assessmentUseType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:AssessmentUse vocabulary.

ceterms:associatedDate.label: Associated Date
ceterms:associatedDate.definition: Statement of a date made as part of a StructuredStatement, the meaning of which is indicated by the statementType property.

ceterms:atLevel.label: At Level
ceterms:atLevel.definition: Indicates the stage or level of achievement in a progression of learning.
ceterms:atLevel.usageNote: Indicates the level an audience will hold upon completion or attainment. To indicate the level of the audience that should be qualified to pursue this resource, use audienceLevel.

ceterms:audienceLevelType.label: Audience Level Type
ceterms:audienceLevelType.definition: Type of level indicating a point in a progression through an educational or training context, for which the resource is intended; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:audienceLevelType.usageNote: Best practice is to use terms from the CTDL Audience Level vocabulary.

ceterms:audienceType.label: Audience Type
ceterms:audienceType.definition: The type of audience for which the resource is applicable, intended, or useful; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:audienceType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:Audience vocabulary.

ceterms:availabilityListing.label: Availability Listing
ceterms:availabilityListing.definition: Listing of online and/or physical locations where a resource can be found or pursued.

ceterms:availableAt.label: Available At
ceterms:availableAt.definition: Physical location where the credential, assessment, or learning opportunity can be pursued.

ceterms:availableOnlineAt.label: Available Online At
ceterms:availableOnlineAt.definition: Online location where the credential, assessment, or learning opportunity can be pursued.

ceterms:basePeriod.label: Base Period
ceterms:basePeriod.definition: Duration to which a monetary amount applies.
ceterms:basePeriod.comment: The duration will be specified using ISO8601 duration format. Common examples indicate that a salary is given on a per annum basis, in which case the value would be P1Y; for an hourly rate of pay the value would be PT1H.

ceterms:broadAlignment.label: Broad Alignment
ceterms:broadAlignment.definition: Item that covers all of the relevant concepts in the item being described as well as additional relevant concepts.

ceterms:classification.label: Classification
ceterms:classification.definition: Category or classification of this resource.
ceterms:classification.usageNote: Where a more specific property exists, such as ceterms:naics, ceterms:isicV4, ceterms:credentialType, etc., use that property instead of this one.

ceterms:closingDate.label: Closing Date
ceterms:closingDate.definition: Date the organization ceased operations or ceased to exist.
ceterms:closingDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateClosingDate instead.

ceterms:coPrerequisite.label: Co-Prerequisite
ceterms:coPrerequisite.definition: Resource that must be completed prior to, or pursued at the same time as, this resource.

ceterms:codedNotation.label: Coded Notation
ceterms:codedNotation.definition: Set of alpha-numeric symbols as defined by the body responsible for this resource that uniquely identifies this resource and supports its discovery and use.
ceterms:codedNotation.comment: Examples include course codes (e.g., "ENG101"), US Standard Occupation Codes (e.g., "31-9091"), North American Industry Classification System codes (e.g., "236117"), or any other bespoke code used by the provider of the resource to identify it.
ceterms:codedNotation.usageNote: For identifiers that come from a recognized identification scheme use the specific property for that identifier type, such as ceterms:opeID, ceterms:ncesID, ceterms:leiCode, etc., or use ceterms:identifier so that the identification schema can be named.

ceterms:collectionType.label: Collection Type
ceterms:collectionType.definition: Type of collection, list, array, or other grouping of resources; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:commonConditions.label: Common Conditions
ceterms:commonConditions.definition: Set constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements that are shared across an organization, organizational subdivision, set of credentials, or category of entities and activities.

ceterms:commonCosts.label: Common Costs
ceterms:commonCosts.definition: Set of costs maintained at an organizational or sub-organizational level, which apply to this credential, assessment, or learning opportunity.

ceterms:comparator.label: Comparator
ceterms:comparator.definition: Type of symbol that denotes an operator in a constraint expression such as "GTEQ" (greater than or equal to), "EQ" (equal to), "LT" (less than); select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:compares.label: Compares
ceterms:compares.definition: Framework that contains terms that are compared in this AlignmentMap.
ceterms:compares.comment: Frameworks may be Concept Schemes, Progression Models, and other educational frameworks.

ceterms:complaintProcess.label: Complaint Process
ceterms:complaintProcess.definition: Description of a process for handling complaints about a resource or related resources.

ceterms:componentCategory.label: Component Category
ceterms:componentCategory.definition: Identifies the type of PathwayComponent subclass not explicitly covered in the current array of PathwayComponent subclasses.

ceterms:componentDesignation.label: Component Designation
ceterms:componentDesignation.definition: Label identifying the category to further distinguish one component from another as designated by the promulgating body.

ceterms:condition.label: Condition
ceterms:condition.definition: Single constraint, prerequisite, entry condition, requirement, or cost.

ceterms:conditionExcludes.label: Condition Excludes
ceterms:conditionExcludes.definition: Resource that does not count toward fulfilling a constraint, prerequisite, entry condition, or requirement.
ceterms:conditionExcludes.comment: Intended for cases where it is simplest to express exceptions to a general requirement, for example when a requirement is met by any Math course except "Access Math".

ceterms:contactType.label: Contact Type
ceterms:contactType.definition: Text identifying the type of service provided by an organizational contact.
ceterms:contactType.comment: A person or organization may have different contact points for different services. The contact type property provides for adding text to identity the service; e.g., "toll-free number" or "support for hearing-impaired callers".

ceterms:copyrightHolder.label: Copyright Holder
ceterms:copyrightHolder.definition: Person or organization holding the rights in copyright to this resource.

ceterms:corequisite.label: Corequisite
ceterms:corequisite.definition: Resources that must be pursued concurrently.
ceterms:corequisite.comment: Includes dual (double) degrees that cannot be earned independently of each other.

ceterms:costDetails.label: Cost Details
ceterms:costDetails.definition: Webpage or online document containing human-readable, in-depth information about costs.

ceterms:credentialId.label: Credential Identifier
ceterms:credentialId.definition: Globally unique identifier by which the creator, owner or provider of a credential recognizes that credential in transactions with the external environment (e.g., in verifiable claims involving the credential).
ceterms:credentialId.comment: The  identifier may take the form of a URN, UUID, ARK, DOI, INFO or any other publicly recognized, globally unique identifier scheme.
ceterms:credentialId.usageNote: Best practice for descriptions intended for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:ctid property for this purpose; ceterms:ctid is declared as a subproperty of ceterms:credentialId.

ceterms:credentialStatusType.label: Credential Status Type
ceterms:credentialStatusType.definition: Type of official status of the credential; select from an enumeration of such types.
ceterms:credentialStatusType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:CredentialStatus vocabulary.

ceterms:credentialType.label: Credential Type
ceterms:credentialType.definition: Indicates the specific type of credential or qualification of this resource.
ceterms:credentialType.usageNote: Use to identify a more specific type than is provided using the rdf:type (JSON-LD "@type") property. For example, resources with type CredentialComponent may identify a specific subclass of ceterms:Credential; resources typed as a subclass of ceterms:Credential may identify a specific instance of ceterms:CredentialType.

ceterms:credentialingAction.label: Credentialing Action
ceterms:credentialingAction.definition: Indicates a past or potential credentialing action in which the resource being described plays an 'object' role.

ceterms:creditLevelType.label: Credit Level Type
ceterms:creditLevelType.definition: The level of credit associated with the credit awarded or required.

ceterms:creditUnitType.label: Credit Unit Type
ceterms:creditUnitType.definition: The type of credit associated with the credit awarded or required.

ceterms:creditUnitTypeDescription.label: Credit Unit Type Description
ceterms:creditUnitTypeDescription.definition: Detailed description of credit unit type.

ceterms:ctid.label: CTID
ceterms:ctid.definition: Globally unique Credential Transparency Identifier (CTID) by which the creator, owner or provider of a resource recognizes it in transactions with the external environment (e.g., in verifiable claims involving the resource).
ceterms:ctid.comment: The CTID is the equivalent of a version identifier for the resource. Different versions of a resource are considered distinct expressions and each must be assigned its own CTID. Each version of a resource can have only one CTID assigned. However, a single version of a resource may have distinct identifier values for both the ctid property and the credentialId property. In such a case both identifiers will be recognized by the resource creator/owner/provider in transactions with the external environment.

ceterms:currency.label: Currency
ceterms:currency.definition: Currency in which the monetary amount is expressed in 3-letter ISO 4217 format such as "USD".

ceterms:dateEffective.label: Date Effective
ceterms:dateEffective.definition: Date after which this resource is available or applicable.
ceterms:dateEffective.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateDateEffective instead.

ceterms:dateSigned.label: Date Signed
ceterms:dateSigned.definition: Date on which the document being described was signed.

ceterms:degreeConcentration.label: Degree Concentration
ceterms:degreeConcentration.definition: Focused plan of study within a college or university degree such as a concentration in Aerospace Engineering within an Engineering degree.
ceterms:degreeConcentration.usageNote: Where possible, values should be taken from published frameworks defining degree majors, minors, and concentrations such as the U.S. National Center for Education Statistics' (NCES) Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP).

ceterms:degreeMajor.label: Degree Major
ceterms:degreeMajor.definition: Primary field of study of a degree-seeking student.
ceterms:degreeMajor.usageNote: Where possible, values should be taken from published frameworks defining degree majors, minors, and concentrations such as the U.S. National Center for Education Statistics' (NCES) Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP).

ceterms:degreeMinor.label: Degree Minor
ceterms:degreeMinor.definition: Optional, secondary field of study of a degree-seeking student.
ceterms:degreeMinor.usageNote: Where possible, values should be taken from published frameworks defining degree majors, minors, and concentrations such as the U.S. National Center for Education Statistics' (NCES) Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP).

ceterms:deliveryType.label: Delivery Type
ceterms:deliveryType.definition: Type of means by which a learning opportunity or assessment is delivered to credential seekers and by which they interact; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:deliveryType.usageNote: Best practice is to use concepts from a controlled vocabulary such as the ceterms:DeliveryType vocabulary.

ceterms:deliveryTypeDescription.label: Delivery Type Description
ceterms:deliveryTypeDescription.definition: Detailed description of the delivery type of an assessment or learning opportunity.

ceterms:demographicInformation.label: Demographic Information
ceterms:demographicInformation.definition: Aggregate data or summaries of statistical data relating to the population of credential holders including data about gender, geopolitical regions, age, education levels, and other categories of interest.

ceterms:description.label: Description
ceterms:description.definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.

ceterms:developmentProcess.label: Development Process
ceterms:developmentProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource was created.

ceterms:directCostType.label: Direct Cost Type
ceterms:directCostType.definition: Types of direct costs associated with earning or completing a credential, assessment or learning opportunity; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:directCostType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:CostType vocabulary.

ceterms:duns.label: DUNS
ceterms:duns.definition: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for identifying an organization or business person.

ceterms:earnings.label: Earnings
ceterms:earnings.definition: Entity describing aggregate credential holder earnings data.
ceterms:earnings.usageNote: The use of ceterms:aggregateData instead of this property is strongly recommended.

ceterms:email.label: Email
ceterms:email.definition: Email address of the organization or person.

ceterms:employee.label: Employee
ceterms:employee.definition: Person employed for wages or salary by the organization.

ceterms:employmentOutcome.label: Employment Outcome
ceterms:employmentOutcome.definition: Entity describing aggregate data on jobs obtained with the credential by occupation and industry for a given period of time in a specific region.
ceterms:employmentOutcome.usageNote: The use of ceterms:aggregateData instead of this property is strongly recommended.

ceterms:endDate.label: End Date
ceterms:endDate.definition: Date some event or activity ends.
ceterms:endDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateEndDate instead.

ceterms:endTime.label: End Time
ceterms:endTime.definition: Time some event or activity ends.

ceterms:entryCondition.label: Entry Condition
ceterms:entryCondition.definition: Requirements for entry into a credentialing program, a learning opportunity, or an assessment, including credentials, transcripts, records of previous experience, or other forms of entry documentation.
ceterms:entryCondition.usageNote: For Courses required to be taken before entry into another Course, use prerequisite.

ceterms:environmentalHazardType.label: Environmental Hazard Type
ceterms:environmentalHazardType.definition: Type of condition in the physical work performance environment that entails risk exposures requiring mitigating processes; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:environmentalHazardType.comment: Such types may include exposure to bloodborne pathogens, airborne communicable diseases and dangerous chemicals, battlefield conditions, fire fighting, law enforcement, and so on.

ceterms:estimatedCost.label: Estimated Cost
ceterms:estimatedCost.definition: Estimated cost of a credential, learning opportunity or assessment.

ceterms:estimatedDuration.label: Estimated Duration
ceterms:estimatedDuration.definition: Estimated time it will take to complete an activity, event, or resource.

ceterms:evaluationEvidence.label: Evaluation Evidence
ceterms:evaluationEvidence.definition: Summary of evidence about this resource.

ceterms:evaluationProcess.label: Evaluation Process
ceterms:evaluationProcess.definition: Description of a process used to appraise this resource.

ceterms:evidenceOfAction.label: Evidence of Action
ceterms:evidenceOfAction.definition: Entity that proves that the action occurred or that the action continues to be valid.
ceterms:evidenceOfAction.comment: The evidence verifies the information in the action and is particular to it. It is not a collection relating to several unrelated actions or a description of how such verifications might generically be characterized. It may comprise more than one evidentiary entity relating to the same action.

ceterms:exactAlignment.label: Exact Alignment
ceterms:exactAlignment.definition: Relevant concepts in two entities being compared are coextensive.

ceterms:exactDuration.label: Exact Duration
ceterms:exactDuration.definition: Overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:exactDuration.comment: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:exactDuration.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 6 months as P6M.

ceterms:experience.label: Experience
ceterms:experience.definition: Amount and nature of required work, experiential learning or other relevant experience.

ceterms:expirationDate.label: Expiration Date
ceterms:expirationDate.definition: Date beyond which the resource is no longer offered or available.
ceterms:expirationDate.comment: Previously earned, completed, or attained resources may still be valid even if they are no longer offered.
ceterms:expirationDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateStartDate instead.

ceterms:externalInputType.label: External Input Type
ceterms:externalInputType.definition: Types of external stakeholders that provide input to an entity's processes or resources; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:externalInputType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:ExternalInput vocabulary.

ceterms:externalResearch.label: External Research
ceterms:externalResearch.definition: Research that supports or validates one or more aspects of the entity.

ceterms:facetedDescription.label: Faceted Description
ceterms:facetedDescription.definition: Description of a specific aspect or characteristic of this resource.
ceterms:facetedDescription.usageNote: Use for the level descriptors of a Qualifications Framework when these are defined in terms of several different types of competency.

ceterms:familyName.label: Family Name
ceterms:familyName.definition: Family name such as the last name of a person in the U.S..
ceterms:familyName.comment: The ceterms:familyName property can be used along with givenName instead of the ceterms:name property.

ceterms:fein.label: FEIN
ceterms:fein.definition: Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) identifying organizations, persons, states, government agencies, corporations, and companies.

ceterms:financialAssistance.label: Financial Assistance
ceterms:financialAssistance.definition: Entity that describes financial assistance for which this resource qualifies.
ceterms:financialAssistance.comment: The type of resource that the financial aid is associated with is dependent on context.

ceterms:financialAssistanceForType.label: Financial Assistance For Type
ceterms:financialAssistanceForType.definition: Type of use for which financial assistance is applicable.

ceterms:financialAssistanceType.label: Financial Assistance Type
ceterms:financialAssistanceType.definition: Type of financial assistance; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:financialAssistanceValue.label: Financial Assistance Value
ceterms:financialAssistanceValue.definition: Description of the amount of financial assistance available.

ceterms:framework.label: Framework URL
ceterms:framework.definition: Credential framework to which the entity is aligned.
ceterms:framework.comment: Frameworks may include, but are not limited to, competency frameworks and concept schemes such as industry, occupation, and instructional program codes.

ceterms:geoURI.label: Geographic URI
ceterms:geoURI.definition: Entity that describes the longitude, latitude and other location details of a place.
ceterms:geoURI.comment: This may define a place at any scale. Examples include a city, state, province, country, or continent.
ceterms:geoURI.usageNote: It is recommended to use services such as http://www.geonames.org to provide values for this property.

ceterms:givenName.label: Given Name
ceterms:givenName.usageNote: Family name can be used along with familyName instead of the name property.

ceterms:globalJurisdiction.label: Global Jurisdiction
ceterms:globalJurisdiction.definition: Whether or not the credential is useful, applicable or recognized everywhere.
ceterms:globalJurisdiction.comment: Exceptions indicated by the ceterms:jurisdictionException property apply.

ceterms:hasAlignmentMap.label: Has Alignment Map
ceterms:hasAlignmentMap.definition: Alignment map owned by the agent.

ceterms:hasCatalog.label: Has Catalog
ceterms:hasCatalog.definition: An inventory or listing of resources maintained by this Organization

ceterms:hasCondition.label: Has Condition
ceterms:hasCondition.definition: Resource referenced defines a condition by which this resource is satisfied in full or in part.

ceterms:hasConditionManifest.label: Has Condition Manifest
ceterms:hasConditionManifest.definition: Entity that describes a set of constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements applicable across the organization, sub-organization or sets of credentials or acitivites.

ceterms:hasConstraint.label: Has Constraint
ceterms:hasConstraint.definition: Referenced resource defines a single constraint.

ceterms:hasCostManifest.label: Has Cost Manifest
ceterms:hasCostManifest.definition: Entity that describes a set of cost data applicable across the organization, sub-organization or sets of credentials or acitivites.

ceterms:hasDestinationComponent.label: Has Destination Component
ceterms:hasDestinationComponent.definition: Goal or destination node of the pathway.

ceterms:hasFacetScheme.label: Has Facet Scheme
ceterms:hasFacetScheme.definition: Concept Scheme used to characterize different aspects (facets) of descriptors of nodes in a framework or similar resource.

ceterms:hasGlossary.label: Has Glossary
ceterms:hasGlossary.definition: Terms and definitions applicable to the resource.

ceterms:hasGroupEvaluation.label: Has Group Evaluation
ceterms:hasGroupEvaluation.definition: Whether or not the assessment activity is scored as a group.

ceterms:hasGroupParticipation.label: Has Group Participation
ceterms:hasGroupParticipation.definition: Whether or not two or more participants are required to complete the assessment activity.

ceterms:hasOffering.label: Has Offering
ceterms:hasOffering.definition: Indicates an offering and typical schedule.
ceterms:hasOffering.usageNote: Only use this property when it is necessary and useful to provide data about specific offerings of a learning opportunity or assessment, such as particular combinations of schedule, location, and delivery.

ceterms:hasPart.label: Has Part
ceterms:hasPart.definition: Indicates a separately identifiable and independently useful component of the entity.
ceterms:hasPart.comment: Such partitive components can frequently be used in more than one context.

ceterms:hasPathway.label: Has Pathway
ceterms:hasPathway.definition: A pathway related to this resource.

ceterms:hasProxy.label: Has Proxy
ceterms:hasProxy.definition: Indicates a resource that acts as a stand-in for the resource.

ceterms:hasRegulatoryInformation.label: Has Regulatory Information
ceterms:hasRegulatoryInformation.definition: Information about this resource that is provided in order to comply with a regulation or legal requirement.

ceterms:hasSpecialization.label: Has Specialization
ceterms:hasSpecialization.definition: More specialized profession, trade, career field, or industry that is encompassed by the one being described.

ceterms:hasSpecificService.label: Has Specific Service
ceterms:hasSpecificService.definition: Support Service that is part of this Support Service.

ceterms:hasStatement.label: Has Statement
ceterms:hasStatement.definition: Alignment assertion belonging to the alignment map.

ceterms:hasStructuredStatement.label: Has Structured Statement
ceterms:hasStructuredStatement.definition: Indicates contextualized data that reproduces or links to text such as part of a document or information about some aspect of a resource.
ceterms:hasStructuredStatement.usageNote: Do not use this property if a simple text property such as ceterms:description is adequate.

ceterms:hasSubFrameworkScheme.label: Has Sub-framework scheme
ceterms:hasSubFrameworkScheme.definition: Indicates a Concept Scheme used to differentiate parts of a framework or related resources that are considered to be somewhat independent.
ceterms:hasSubFrameworkScheme.comment: Examples include differentiating those progression levels or credential types that are relevant to different sectors, such as General Education, Higher Education and Technical / Vocational Education and Training.

ceterms:hasSupportService.label: Has Support Service
ceterms:hasSupportService.definition: Reference to a relevant support service.

ceterms:hasTransferValueProfile.label: Has Transfer Value Profile
ceterms:hasTransferValueProfile.definition: Description of transfer value that is part of this resource.

ceterms:hasVerificationService.label: Has Verification Service
ceterms:hasVerificationService.definition: Entity describing available systems provided by the agent to verify credential holders.
ceterms:hasVerificationService.comment: Systems in place to verify credential holders and communicate the current credentialing status of all credential holders to employers and other labor market participants, as well as to education and workforce development funders and regulators.

ceterms:hasWorkRole.label: Has Work Role
ceterms:hasWorkRole.definition: Work Role related to this resource.

ceterms:hasWorkforceDemand.label: Has Workforce Demand
ceterms:hasWorkforceDemand.definition: Indicates the level of demand for a resource via a demand level action.

ceterms:holderMustAuthorize.label: Holder Must Authorize
ceterms:holderMustAuthorize.definition: Whether or not the credential holder must authorize the organization to provide the verification service.

ceterms:holders.label: Holders
ceterms:holders.definition: Entity describing the number and characteristics of credentialed individuals and their geographic location.
ceterms:holders.usageNote: The use of ceterms:aggregateData instead of this property is strongly recommended.

ceterms:honorificSuffix.label: Honorific Suffix
ceterms:honorificSuffix.definition: Honorific suffix preceding a person's name such as M.D. , PhD, or MSCSW.

ceterms:identifier.label: Identifier
ceterms:identifier.definition: Alphanumeric token that identifies this resource and information about the token's originating context or scheme.
ceterms:identifier.usageNote: Where a specific property for the originating context or scheme exists, such as ceterms:opeID, ceterms:ncesID, ceterms:leiCode, etc., use that property instead of this one. Where the identifier has no nameable originating context or scheme other than that of the resource being identified, ceterms:codedNotation may be used.

ceterms:identifierType.label: Identifier Type
ceterms:identifierType.definition: Framework, scheme, type, or other organizing principle of this identifier.

ceterms:identifierTypeName.label: Identifier Type Name
ceterms:identifierTypeName.definition: Formal name or acronym of the framework, scheme, type, or other organizing principle of this identifier, such as ISBN or ISSN.

ceterms:identifierValueCode.label: Identifier Value Code
ceterms:identifierValueCode.definition: Alphanumeric string identifier of the entity.
ceterms:identifierValueCode.comment: Where a formal identification system exists for the identifier, recommended best practice is to use a string conforming to that system.

ceterms:image.label: Image
ceterms:image.definition: Image, icon or logo that represents the entity including registered trade or service marks.

ceterms:inAlignmentMap.label: In Alignment Map
ceterms:inAlignmentMap.definition: Alignment map to which the statement belongs.

ceterms:inCatalog.label: In Catalog
ceterms:inCatalog.definition: An inventory or listing of resources that includes this resource.

ceterms:inDemandAction.label: In Demand Action
ceterms:inDemandAction.definition: Assertion by an agent that this resource has a specific workforce demand level.

ceterms:inLanguage.label: In Language
ceterms:inLanguage.definition: The primary language or languages of the entity, even if it makes use of other languages.
ceterms:inLanguage.usageNote: A course offered in English to teach Spanish would have an inLanguage of English, while a credential in Quebec could have an inLanguage of both French and English.

ceterms:inQualificationsFramework.label: In Qualifications Framework
ceterms:inQualificationsFramework.definition: Indicates a Qualifications Framework that uses this resource.

ceterms:indicativeCredentialType.label: Indicative Credential Type
ceterms:indicativeCredentialType.definition: Category or class of credential that is typical for a level in a qualifications framework or similar progression model.

ceterms:industryType.label: Industry Type
ceterms:industryType.definition: Type of industry; select from an existing enumeration of such types such as the SIC, NAICS, and ISIC classifications.
ceterms:industryType.usageNote: Best practice in identifying industries for U.S. resources is to provide the NAICS code using the ceterms:naics property. Other resources may use the ceterms:industrytype property and any framework of the class ceterms:IndustryClassification.

ceterms:instructionalProgramType.label: Instructional Program Type
ceterms:instructionalProgramType.definition: Type of instructional program; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:instructionalProgramType.usageNote: For U.S. credentials, best practice is to use a framework such as the CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs). Other credentials may use any framework of the class CTDL InstructionalProgramClassification.

ceterms:instrument.label: Instrument
ceterms:instrument.definition: Resource used to carry out an action or process.
ceterms:instrument.comment: May be a credential or rubric whose criteria were applied in executing the action or process; may be a data set profile that provided measurements of relevant metrics.

ceterms:intermediaryFor.label: Intermediary For
ceterms:intermediaryFor.definition: Resource for which this resource is an intermediary.

ceterms:ipedsID.label: IPEDS ID
ceterms:ipedsID.definition: Unique six digit identifier assigned to all U.S. institutions that have submitted data to the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS).

ceterms:isAdvancedStandingFor.label: Is Advanced Standing For
ceterms:isAdvancedStandingFor.definition: This resource reduces the time or cost required to earn or complete the referenced resource.
ceterms:isAdvancedStandingFor.usageNote: A third-party credential agent claiming that its credential provides advanced standing for the credential of another credential agent should consider using ceterms:recommendedFor instead of ceterms:advancedStandingFor in the absence of an explicit and verifiable agreement on advanced standing between the agents of the two credentials.

ceterms:isDestinationComponentOf.label: Is Destination Component Of
ceterms:isDestinationComponentOf.definition: Pathway for which this resource is the goal or destination.

ceterms:isMemberOf.label: Is Member Of
ceterms:isMemberOf.definition: Collection to which this resource belongs.

ceterms:isNonCredit.label: Is Non-Credit
ceterms:isNonCredit.definition: Resource carries or confers no official academic credit according to the provider of the resource.

ceterms:isPartOf.label: Is Part Of
ceterms:isPartOf.definition: Indicates another entity of which this entity is a component.

ceterms:isPreparationFor.label: Is Preparation For
ceterms:isPreparationFor.definition: This resource provides preparation for the resource being referenced.

ceterms:isProctored.label: Is Proctored
ceterms:isProctored.definition: Whether or not the assessment is supervised or monitored by an agent.
ceterms:isProctored.comment: Such supervision or proctoring includes: (1)  guaranteeing of the identities of the examinees; (2) the conditions of the examination including instructions, time, materials, equipment and completion, and (3) completed without unauthorized assistance.

ceterms:isRecommendedFor.label: Is Recommended For
ceterms:isRecommendedFor.definition: It is recommended to earn or complete this resource before attempting to earn or complete the referenced resource.

ceterms:isRegisteredApprenticeship.label: Is Registered Apprenticeship
ceterms:isRegisteredApprenticeship.definition: The resource is registered with a governmental agency or other authorized organization because it has been vetted, approved and validated to meet specific criteria.

ceterms:isRequiredFor.label: Is Required For
ceterms:isRequiredFor.definition: This resource must be earned or completed prior to attempting to earn or complete the referenced resource.

ceterms:isSimilarTo.label: Is Similar To
ceterms:isSimilarTo.comment: The property is generally applicable in describing the similarity between any two entities.

ceterms:isSpecializationOf.label: Is Specialization Of
ceterms:isSpecializationOf.definition: Less specialized profession, trade, career field or industry that encompasses the one being described.

ceterms:isSpecificServiceOf.label: Is Specific Service Of
ceterms:isSpecificServiceOf.definition: Support Service that is this Support Service is part of.

ceterms:isicV4.label: ISIC Revision 4 Code
ceterms:isicV4.definition: The International Standard of Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), Revision 4 code for a particular organization, business person, or place.

ceterms:jobLevelType.label: Job Level Type
ceterms:jobLevelType.definition: Type of level or grade indicating a point in a job or role progression, such as seniority or responsibility; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:jobsObtained.label: Jobs Obtained
ceterms:jobsObtained.definition: Number of jobs obtained in the region during a given timeframe.

ceterms:jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
ceterms:jurisdiction.definition: Geographic or political region in which the resource is formally applicable or an organization has authority to act.

ceterms:jurisdictionException.label: Jurisdiction Exception
ceterms:jurisdictionException.definition: Geographic or political region in which the credential is not formally recognized or an organization has no authority to act .
ceterms:jurisdictionException.comment: The ceterms:jurisdictionalException property is used in conjunction with the ceterms:jurisdiction property and expresses any exceptions to a more general statement; e.g., the United states except for Colorado.

ceterms:keyword.label: Keyword
ceterms:keyword.definition: Keyword or key phrase describing relevant aspects of an entity.
ceterms:keyword.usageNote: Use the keyword property to enter free text keywords. A subject concept in a controlled vocabulary should use the subject property.

ceterms:learningDeliveryDescription.label: Learning Delivery Description
ceterms:learningDeliveryDescription.definition: Detailed description of the mode of delivery for the learning opportunity for the credential.

ceterms:learningDeliveryType.label: Learning Delivery Type
ceterms:learningDeliveryType.definition: Delivery type for the learning opportunity for the credential.
ceterms:learningDeliveryType.comment: Indicates the delivery type for the learning opportunity for the credential.

ceterms:learningMethodDescription.label: Learning Method Description
ceterms:learningMethodDescription.definition: Description of the methods used to conduct learning.

ceterms:learningMethodType.label: Learning Method Type
ceterms:learningMethodType.definition: Types of methods used to conduct the learning opportunity; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:learningMethodType.usageNote: Best practice is to use concepts from a controlled vocabulary such as the ceterms:LearningMethod.

ceterms:learningRecognitionEvidenceType.label: Learning Recognition Evidence Type
ceterms:learningRecognitionEvidenceType.definition: Type of prior learning evidence accepted for evaluation under the policy; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:learningRecognitionMethodType.label: Learning Recognition Method Type
ceterms:learningRecognitionMethodType.definition: Type of method used to evaluate and recognize prior learning; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:learningRecognitionOutcomeType.label: Learning Recognition Outcome Type
ceterms:learningRecognitionOutcomeType.definition: Type of outcome governed or permitted by the policy; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:learningRecognitionSourceType.label: Learning Recognition Source Type
ceterms:learningRecognitionSourceType.definition: Type of context from which prior learning may be recognized; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:leftAction.label: Left Action
ceterms:leftAction.definition: Action performed on the left source; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:leftSource.label: Left Source
ceterms:leftSource.definition: Left hand parameter of a constraint.

ceterms:legalName.label: Legal Name
ceterms:legalName.definition: Name of the organization as formally registered with a governmental or other legal authority.
ceterms:legalName.comment: An officially registered company name would be a legal name and may differ from the commonly used name that may be entered for ceterms:name.
ceterms:legalName.usageNote: If the legal name is different from the data provided for ceterms:name then the legal name must be provided using this property.

ceterms:leiCode.label: Legal Entity Identifier Code
ceterms:leiCode.definition: A 20-digit, alpha-numeric code, based on the ISO 17442 standard, for identifying legal entities participating in financial transactions.

ceterms:lifeCycleStatusType.label: Life Cycle Status Type
ceterms:lifeCycleStatusType.definition: Type of state of the resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle; select from an enumeration of such types.

ceterms:logicalOperator.label: Logical Operator
ceterms:logicalOperator.definition: Type that denotes a logical operation such as "And", "Or", "OnlyOne"; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:logicalOperator.comment: Only a single instance of logicalOperator is allowed defining operations on two or more nested ComponentCondition entities, Constraint entities, or a mix of ComponentCondition and Constraint entities.

ceterms:mainJurisdiction.label: Main Jurisdiction
ceterms:mainJurisdiction.definition: Primary geographic or political region in which the credential is recognized as applicable or in which an organization has recognized authority to act.

ceterms:maintenanceProcess.label: Maintenance Process
ceterms:maintenanceProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource is maintained, including review and updating.
ceterms:maintenanceProcess.comment: Such maintenance does not include renewal of a credential by an individual holder.

ceterms:majorAlignment.label: Major Alignment
ceterms:majorAlignment.definition: Major overlap of relevant concepts between the two resources being compared.

ceterms:maximumDuration.label: Maximum Duration
ceterms:maximumDuration.definition: Maximum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:maximumDuration.comment: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:maximumDuration.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 9 months as P9M. Do not use ceterms:maximumDuration to identify the renewal frequency of a credential; use ceterms:renewalFrequency instead.

ceterms:membershipCondition.label: Membership Condition
ceterms:membershipCondition.definition: Conditions and requirements to be included as a member.

ceterms:minimumAge.label: Minimum Age
ceterms:minimumAge.definition: Minimum allowed age at which a person is eligible.

ceterms:minimumDuration.label: Minimum Duration
ceterms:minimumDuration.definition: Minimum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:minimumDuration.comment: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:minimumDuration.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 3 months as P3M.

ceterms:minorAlignment.label: Minor Alignment
ceterms:minorAlignment.definition: Minor overlap of relevant concepts between the two credentials being compared.

ceterms:missionAndGoalsStatement.label: Mission and Goals Statement
ceterms:missionAndGoalsStatement.definition: Webpage or online document that defines or explains the mission and goals of the organization.

ceterms:missionAndGoalsStatementDescript.label: Mission and Goals Statement Description
ceterms:missionAndGoalsStatementDescript.definition: Textual statement of the mission and goals of the organization.

ceterms:naics.label: NAICS
ceterms:naics.definition: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code of an organization or business person.

ceterms:name.label: Name
ceterms:name.definition: Name or title of the resource.

ceterms:narrowAlignment.label: Narrow Alignment
ceterms:narrowAlignment.definition: Credential covers all of the relevant concepts in another credential as well as relevant concepts not found in the other credential.

ceterms:ncesID.label: NCES ID
ceterms:ncesID.definition: Identifier comprised of a 12 digit code issued by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) for educational institutions where the first 7 digits are the NCES District ID.

ceterms:nextVersion.label: Next Version
ceterms:nextVersion.definition: Version of the resource that immediately follows this version.

ceterms:object.label: Object
ceterms:object.definition: Object upon which the action is carried out, whose state is kept intact or changed.

ceterms:objectOfAction.label: Object of Action
ceterms:objectOfAction.definition: Action carried out upon this resource.

ceterms:occupationType.label: Occupation Type
ceterms:occupationType.definition: Type of occupation; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:occupationType.usageNote: For U.S. resources, best practice is to identify an occupation using a framework such as the ONet. Other resources may use any framework of the class ceterms:OccupationClassification, such as the EU's ESCO, ISCO-08, and SOC 2010.

ceterms:offerFrequencyType.label: Offer Frequency Type
ceterms:offerFrequencyType.definition: Type of frequency at which a resource is offered; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:offerFrequencyType.comment: This relates to how often something starts.
ceterms:offerFrequencyType.usageNote: For information relating to the frequency of events associated with a resource when it is running, use ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.

ceterms:offeredIn.label: Offered In
ceterms:offeredIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale where the credential, learning resource or assessment is offered.

ceterms:offers.label: Offers
ceterms:offers.definition: Resource offered or conferred by the organization or person.

ceterms:offersFinancialAssistance.label: Offers Financial Assistance
ceterms:offersFinancialAssistance.definition: Description of financial assistance offered by this organization.

ceterms:opeID.label: OPE ID
ceterms:opeID.definition: OPE ID number (U.S. Office of Postsecondary Education Identification), sometimes referred to as the Federal School Code.
ceterms:opeID.comment: Identification number used by the U.S. Department of Education's Office of Postsecondary Education (OPE) to identify schools that have Program Participation Agreements (PPA) so that its students are eligible to participate in Federal Student Financial Assistance (FAFSA) programs under Title IV regulations. This is a 6-digit number followed by a 2-digit suffix used to identify branches, additional locations, and other entities that are part of the eligible institution.

ceterms:ownedBy.label: Owned By
ceterms:ownedBy.definition: Agent with an enforceable claim or legal title to the resource.
ceterms:ownedBy.comment: Agent includes credentialing organizations, quality assurance organizations and persons. It does not not include credential holders.

ceterms:owns.label: Owns
ceterms:owns.definition: Resource over which the organization or person claims legal title.

ceterms:parentOrganization.label: Parent Organization
ceterms:parentOrganization.definition: Larger organization exercising authority over the organization being described.

ceterms:participant.label: Participant
ceterms:participant.definition: Co-agents that participated in the action indirectly.

ceterms:payBandType.label: Pay Band Type
ceterms:payBandType.definition: Type of pay band indicating a range or classification of monetary compensation associated with work; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:paymentPattern.label: Payment Pattern
ceterms:paymentPattern.definition: Applicable pattern for payments such as "per semester" and "every three months".

ceterms:paymentPatternType.label: Payment Pattern Type
ceterms:paymentPatternType.definition: Type of pattern for payments, indicating how often a payment is made; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:paymentPatternType.comment: Common examples indicate that a worker is paid weekly, monthly, on demand.

ceterms:performanceLevelType.label: Performance Level Type
ceterms:performanceLevelType.definition: Type of required or expected human performance level; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:physicalCapabilityType.label: Physical Capability Type
ceterms:physicalCapabilityType.definition: Type of physical activity required or expected in performance; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:physicalCapabilityType.comment: Such types may include fine motor activity, repetitive actions, climbing, kneeling, crawling, lifting heavy objects, and so on.

ceterms:pointValue.label: Point Value
ceterms:pointValue.definition: Points associated with this resource, or points possible.

ceterms:postOfficeBoxNumber.label: Post Office Box Number
ceterms:postOfficeBoxNumber.definition: Post office box number for post office addresses.

ceterms:postReceiptMonths.label: Post Receipt Months
ceterms:postReceiptMonths.definition: Number of months after earning a credential when employment and earnings data is collected.
ceterms:postReceiptMonths.comment: Number of months usually range between 3 months (one quarter) to ten years.

ceterms:precededBy.label: Preceded By
ceterms:precededBy.definition: Resource that logically comes before this resource.

ceterms:precedes.label: Precedes
ceterms:precedes.definition: Resource that logically comes after this resource.
ceterms:precedes.comment: The ceterms:precedes property indicates a simple or suggested ordering of resources.

ceterms:preparationFrom.label: Preparation From
ceterms:preparationFrom.definition: Indicates a resource that is useful in preparing for the resource being described.

ceterms:prerequisite.label: Prerequisite
ceterms:prerequisite.definition: Course that is required as a prior condition to this course.
ceterms:prerequisite.usageNote: Conditions of entry into Programs can be specified with entryCondition; requirements for Courses other than prerequisite Courses (e.g., Competencies) can be specified with requires.

ceterms:previousVersion.label: Previous Version
ceterms:previousVersion.definition: Version of the resource that immediately precedes this version.

ceterms:price.label: Price
ceterms:price.definition: Offer price of a credential, learning resource, assessment, related activity or resource.

ceterms:processMethod.label: Process Method
ceterms:processMethod.definition: Webpage or online document that describes the process methods.

ceterms:processMethodDescription.label: Process Method Description
ceterms:processMethodDescription.definition: Textual description of the process methods.

ceterms:processStandards.label: Process Standards
ceterms:processStandards.definition: Webpage or online document that describes the criteria, standards, and/or requirements used with a process.

ceterms:processStandardsDescription.label: Process Standards Description
ceterms:processStandardsDescription.definition: Textual description of the criteria, standards, and/or requirements used with a process.

ceterms:processingAgent.label: Processing Agent
ceterms:processingAgent.definition: Organization or person performing the process.

ceterms:programTerm.label: Program Term
ceterms:programTerm.definition: Categorization of a term sequence based on the normative time between entry into a program of study and its completion such as "1st quarter", "2nd quarter"..."5th quarter".

ceterms:providesTransferValueFor.label: Provides Transfer Value For
ceterms:providesTransferValueFor.definition: This resource provides transfer value for the referenced Transfer Value Profile.
ceterms:providesTransferValueFor.comment: Refer to the referenced Transfer Value Profile for more information. Other resources may be included for the full value.

ceterms:proxyFor.label: Proxy For
ceterms:proxyFor.definition: Indicates the resource for which a pathway component or similar proxy resource is a stand-in.
ceterms:proxyFor.comment: The subject for this property will be acting as proxy in a context such as a pathway for the resource that is its object, so that assertions can be made about relationships between things in that context that are not universally true of the resources for which they are proxies.

ceterms:proxyForItems.label: Proxy For Items
ceterms:proxyForItems.definition: Indicates the multiple resources for which a MultiComponent proxy resource is a stand-in.
ceterms:proxyForItems.comment: The subject for this property will be acting as proxy in a context such as a pathway for the resources that are its objects, so that assertions can be made about relationships between things in that context that are not universally true of the resources for which they are proxies.

ceterms:qualityAssuranceTargetType.label: Quality Assurance Target Type
ceterms:qualityAssuranceTargetType.definition: Types of entities that the agent accredits, endorses, approves, or recognizes; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:receivesTransferValueFrom.label: Receives Transfer Value From
ceterms:receivesTransferValueFrom.definition: This resource receives transfer value from the referenced Transfer Value Profile.
ceterms:receivesTransferValueFrom.comment: Refer to the referenced Transfer Value Profile for more information. Other resources may be included for the full value.

ceterms:receivingDepartment.label: Receiving Department
ceterms:receivingDepartment.definition: Department (or other subdivision of an organization) to which students transfer under the provisions of an agreement.

ceterms:receivingOrganization.label: Receiving Organization
ceterms:receivingOrganization.definition: Organization to which students transfer under the provisions of an agreement.

ceterms:receivingProgram.label: Receiving Program
ceterms:receivingProgram.definition: Program to which students transfer under the provisions of an agreement.

ceterms:recognizedBy.label: Recognized By
ceterms:recognizedBy.definition: Agent that acknowledges the validity of the resource.

ceterms:recognizedForIndustry.label: Recognized For Industry
ceterms:recognizedForIndustry.definition: Industry for which this resource is acknowledged to be valid.

ceterms:recognizedIn.label: Recognized In
ceterms:recognizedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the resource has been publicly recommended, acknowledged or endorsed..

ceterms:recognizedOfferers.label: Recognized Offerers
ceterms:recognizedOfferers.definition: Organizations that have permission to offer credentials of a specific CredentialType.
ceterms:recognizedOfferers.usageNote: The value of this property should be a ceterms:Collection of ceterms:CredentialOrganizations (or similar).

ceterms:recognizes.label: Recognizes
ceterms:recognizes.definition: Resource that the agent recommends, endorses, indicates preference for, or otherwise provides a positive judgment.
ceterms:recognizes.usageNote: The agent being described may or may not use a set of formal recognition criteria.

ceterms:recommends.label: Recommends
ceterms:recommends.definition: Indicates a resource that it is advisable to earn or complete before attempting the resource being described.

ceterms:region.label: Region
ceterms:region.definition: Entity that describes the longitude, latitude and other location details of an area.

ceterms:registeredBy.label: Registered By
ceterms:registeredBy.definition: Agent with which the resource is registered because it has been vetted, approved and validated to meet specific criteria.

ceterms:regulatedBy.label: Regulated By
ceterms:regulatedBy.definition: Organization that enforces the legal requirements related to the resource being described.

ceterms:regulatedIn.label: Regulated In
ceterms:regulatedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential, learning opportunity or resource is regulated.

ceterms:regulates.label: Regulates
ceterms:regulates.definition: Resource that this organization monitors, including enforcement of applicable legal requirements or standards.
ceterms:regulates.comment: Regulation of organizations includes authorization to act or operate.

ceterms:regulationType.label: Regulation Type
ceterms:regulationType.definition: Indicates the regulation or other legal requirement for which this data is provided.
ceterms:regulationType.comment: The value of this property will normally be a URI for a Concept that identifies the regulation.

ceterms:regulatoryInformationFor.label: Regulatory Information For
ceterms:regulatoryInformationFor.definition: Resource that this regulatory information is about.

ceterms:relevantPolicy.label: Relevant Policy
ceterms:relevantPolicy.definition: Policy that is important in some way to this resource.

ceterms:renewal.label: Renewal
ceterms:renewal.definition: Entity describing the constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements necessary to maintenance and renewal of an awarded credential.
ceterms:renewal.comment: Generally, renewal applies to certifications and licenses; however, it may occasionally apply to other types of credentials.

ceterms:renewalFrequency.label: Renewal Frequency
ceterms:renewalFrequency.definition: Frequency with which the credential needs to be renewed.

ceterms:renewedBy.label: Renewed By
ceterms:renewedBy.definition: Agent that handles the renewal of the credential.

ceterms:renewedIn.label: Renewed In
ceterms:renewedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential is renewable.

ceterms:renews.label: Renews
ceterms:renews.definition: Credential type that has its validity extended by the organization or person.
ceterms:renews.comment: The value of ceterms:renews should be one of the specific subclasses of ceterms:Credential.

ceterms:requiredConstraints.label: Required Constraints
ceterms:requiredConstraints.definition: Number of hasConstraint objects that must be fulfilled in order to satisfy the ComponentCondition.

ceterms:requiredNumber.label: Required Number
ceterms:requiredNumber.definition: Number of targetComponent or hasCondition objects that must be fulfilled in order to satisfy the ComponentCondition.

ceterms:requires.label: Requires
ceterms:requires.definition: Requirement or set of requirements for this resource.
ceterms:requires.usageNote: Consider using the more specific subproperties of requires such as prerequisite, coPrerequisite, entryCondition, and corequisite, where appropriate.

ceterms:residencyType.label: Residency Type
ceterms:residencyType.definition: Type of legal residency status of a person; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:residencyType.comment: Residency defines the duration of stay required by national, state, provincial or local laws that entitles a person to the legal protection and benefits provided to the applicable type.
ceterms:residencyType.usageNote: Best practice for U.S. credentials and for submission to the Credential Engine Registry, is to use concepts from the ceterms:Residency vocabulary.

ceterms:residentOf.label: Resident Of
ceterms:residentOf.definition: Geographic or political region of which a person must be a legal resident or citizen in order to be eligible for the credential.
ceterms:residentOf.comment: Residency defines the duration of stay required by national, state, provincial or local laws that entitles a person to the legal protection and benefits provided to the applicable type.

ceterms:resultingAward.label: Resulting Award
ceterms:resultingAward.definition: Awarded credential resulting from an action.
ceterms:resultingAward.comment: An awarded credential is of the type ceterms:CredentialAssertion.

ceterms:resultsInCredential.label: Results In Credential
ceterms:resultsInCredential.definition: Credential awarded as the result of successful completion of the resource being described.
ceterms:resultsInCredential.usageNote: Use when completion of the resource being described is the only requirement for the award of the Credential; otherwise use one of ceterms:isPreparationFor, ceterms:isRecommendedFor, ceterms:isRequiredFor.

ceterms:reviewProcess.label: Review Process
ceterms:reviewProcess.definition: Description of a process by which a resource is reviewed.

ceterms:revocation.label: Revocation
ceterms:revocation.definition: Entity that describes the processes and criteria for ending (revoking) the validity or operation of an awarded credential.
ceterms:revocation.comment: Generally, revocation applies to certifications and licenses; however, it may also apply to other types of credential under extraordinary circumstances.

ceterms:revocationCriteria.label: Revocation Criteria
ceterms:revocationCriteria.definition: Webpage or online document that provides information about the removal criteria for an awarded credential.

ceterms:revocationCriteriaDescription.label: Revocation Criteria
ceterms:revocationCriteriaDescription.definition: Textual description providing information about the removal criteria for an awarded credential.

ceterms:revocationProcess.label: Revocation Process
ceterms:revocationProcess.definition: Entity describing the process by which the credential is revoked.

ceterms:revokedBy.label: Revoked By
ceterms:revokedBy.definition: Agent that handles revocation of an awarded credential due to violations or failure to renew.

ceterms:revokedIn.label: Revoked In
ceterms:revokedIn.definition: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential can be revoked.

ceterms:revokes.label: Revokes
ceterms:revokes.definition: Credential type that can be invalidated or retracted by the awarding agent.
ceterms:revokes.comment: The value of ceterms:revokes should be one of the specific subclasses of ceterms:Credential.

ceterms:rightAction.label: Right Action
ceterms:rightAction.definition: Action performed on the right source; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:rightSource.label: Right Source
ceterms:rightSource.definition: Right hand parameter of a constraint.

ceterms:sameAs.label: Same As
ceterms:sameAs.definition: Another source of information about the entity being described.
ceterms:sameAs.comment: Other sources may include descriptions of entities in open databases such as DBpedia, Wikidata, the Credential Engine Registry, or other platforms.

ceterms:sced.label: SCED
ceterms:sced.definition: School Courses for the Exchange of Data code for a course.
ceterms:sced.usageNote: It is preferable to record the whole 12 character alphanumeric code, however it is also valid to record just the five digit subject code + course number.

ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.label: Schedule Frequency Type
ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.definition: Type of frequency indicating the cadence at which events associated with a resource typically occur; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.comment: This relates to the frequency of events associated with a resource once it is running.
ceterms:scheduleFrequencyType.usageNote: For information relating to how often something starts, use ceterms:offerFrequencyType.

ceterms:scheduleTimingType.label: Schedule Timing Type
ceterms:scheduleTimingType.definition: Type of time at which events typically occur; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:scoringMethodDescription.label: Scoring Method Description
ceterms:scoringMethodDescription.definition: Textual description of the method used to score the assessment.

ceterms:scoringMethodExample.label: Scoring Method Example
ceterms:scoringMethodExample.definition: Webpage or online document providing an example of the method or tool used to score the assessment.

ceterms:scoringMethodExampleDescription.label: Scoring Method Example Description
ceterms:scoringMethodExampleDescription.definition: Textual example of the method or tool used to score the assessment.

ceterms:scoringMethodType.label: Scoring Method Type
ceterms:scoringMethodType.definition: Type of method used to score the assessment; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:scoringMethodType.usageNote: Best practice for U.S. credentials and for submission to the Credential Engine Registry, is to use concepts from the ceterms:ScoringMethod vocabulary.

ceterms:sendingDepartment.label: Sending Department
ceterms:sendingDepartment.definition: Department (or other subdivision of an organization) from which students transfer under the provisions of an agreement.

ceterms:sendingOrganization.label: Sending Organization
ceterms:sendingOrganization.definition: Organization from which students transfer under the provisions of an agreement.

ceterms:sendingProgram.label: Sending Program
ceterms:sendingProgram.definition: Program from which students transfer under the provisions of an agreement.

ceterms:sensoryCapabilityType.label: Sensory Capability Type
ceterms:sensoryCapabilityType.definition: Type of required or expected sensory capability; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:sensoryCapabilityType.comment: Such types may include smell, color discrimination, depth perception, and so on.

ceterms:serviceType.label: Service Type
ceterms:serviceType.definition: Type of service offered by the agent being described; select from an existing enumeration of such terms.
ceterms:serviceType.usageNote: Recommended best practice for credentials in the Credential Engine Registry is to use concepts from the ceterms:AgentServiceType vocabulary.

ceterms:socialMedia.label: Social Media
ceterms:socialMedia.definition: Social media access point for an agent or an agent's contact point.

ceterms:source.label: Source URL
ceterms:source.definition: Authoritative source of an entity's information.
ceterms:source.comment: Citation or description of an authoritative source from which information or description has been derived.

ceterms:sourceData.label: Source Data
ceterms:sourceData.comment: The preferred data serialization is JSON-LD or some other serialization of RDF.

ceterms:sourceNode.label: Source Node
ceterms:sourceNode.definition: Individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the source of an alignment.
ceterms:sourceNode.comment: This is the node to which the target node is being compared. It is the subject of the property used as the alignment type.
ceterms:sourceNode.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.label: Source Node Description
ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.definition: Textual description of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the source of an alignment.
ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.comment: This relates to the node to which the target node is being compared, that is the subject of the property used as the alignment type.
ceterms:sourceNodeDescription.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:sourceNodeName.label: Source Node Name
ceterms:sourceNodeName.definition: Name of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the source of an alignment.
ceterms:sourceNodeName.comment: This relates to the node to which the target node is being compared, that is the subject of the property used as the alignment type.
ceterms:sourceNodeName.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:spatialCoverage.label: Spatial Coverage
ceterms:spatialCoverage.definition: Spatial coverage of an entity indicates the place(s) to which its content applies or in which it occurs.
ceterms:spatialCoverage.comment: In the CTDL, the ceterms:spatialCoverage property serves as a super-property for an array of sub-properties defining location-dependent or area-dependent aspects of a resource.

ceterms:startDate.label: Start Date
ceterms:startDate.definition: Date the validity or usefulness of the information in this resource begins.
ceterms:startDate.usageNote: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateStartDate instead.

ceterms:startTime.label: Start Time
ceterms:startTime.definition: Start time of an event or activity.

ceterms:statementText.label: Statement Text
ceterms:statementText.definition: Verbatim unformatted text of a statement, typically one made in a larger document.
ceterms:statementText.usageNote: Use ceterms:description if the data provided is a summary of the content, e.g. when linking to the statement.

ceterms:statementType.label: Statement Type
ceterms:statementType.definition: Indicates the topic or nature of the statement within the context of the document being represented.
ceterms:statementType.usageNote: Best practice is to draw from an existing concept scheme such as ceterms:StatementCategory, which may be supplemented by more precise terms from a locally defined concept scheme if required.

ceterms:subOrganization.label: Sub-Organization
ceterms:subOrganization.definition: Organization in a subordinate or lower position than a parent organization.

ceterms:subRegion.label: Sub-region
ceterms:subRegion.definition: An administrative subdivision within a country that is intermediate between a region and a locality.
ceterms:subRegion.comment: This may be referred to as a county in the United States, a département in France, a district in India, a raion in Russia, a municipio in Mexico, or equivalent terms in other jurisdictions.

ceterms:subclassOf.label: Subclass Of
