ceterms:subclassOf.definition: Indicates a broader type or class than the one being described.
ceterms:subclassOf.comment: Similar to rdfs:subClassOf, this property means that all examples of the type of resource being described are also instances of the class indicated, however it does not imply that the subject is an rdfs:Class.
ceterms:subclassOf.usageNote: Used in CTDL to indicate the Credential Class (i.e. subclass of ceterms:Credential) that encompasses this type of credential.

ceterms:subject.label: Subject
ceterms:subject.definition: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.
ceterms:subject.usageNote: Use the subject property to reference a concept in a controlled vocabulary. Free text subjects should use the keyword property.

ceterms:subjectWebpage.label: Subject Webpage
ceterms:subjectWebpage.comment: The web page being referenced describes the entity. The value of subjectWebpage is an authoritative location for information about the subject but should not be assumed to be a persistent identifier of the subject.

ceterms:submissionOf.label: Submission Of
ceterms:submissionOf.definition: Artifact to be submitted such as a transcript, portfolio, or an affidavit.

ceterms:submissionOfDescription.label: Submission Of Description
ceterms:submissionOfDescription.definition: Name, label, or description of an artifact to be submitted such as a transcript, portfolio, or an affidavit.

ceterms:supersededBy.label: Superseded By
ceterms:supersededBy.comment: For example, a credential that outright replaces the credential being described, and is not simply a newer version of the same credential (the two credentials have different CTIDs).

ceterms:supersedes.label: Supersedes
ceterms:supersedes.comment: For example, the credential that is outright replaced by the credential being described, and is not simply an older version of the same credential (the two credentials have different CTIDs).

ceterms:supportServiceCondition.label: Support Service Condition
ceterms:supportServiceCondition.definition: Requirements to qualify for  a support service.

ceterms:supportServiceFor.label: Support Service For
ceterms:supportServiceFor.definition: Resource to which this support service is applicable.

ceterms:supportServiceStatement.label: Support Service Statement
ceterms:supportServiceStatement.definition: Webpage or online document that defines or explains the nature of support services offered by the organization.

ceterms:supportServiceStatementDescripti.label: Support Service Statement Description
ceterms:supportServiceStatementDescripti.definition: Description of the nature of support services offered by the organization.

ceterms:supportServiceType.label: Support Service Type
ceterms:supportServiceType.definition: Types of support services offered by an agent; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms:targetAssessment.label: Target Assessment
ceterms:targetAssessment.definition: Assessment that provides direct, indirect, formative or summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality for an entity.

ceterms:targetCompetency.label: Target Competency
ceterms:targetCompetency.definition: A competency relevant to the resource being described.

ceterms:targetCompetencyFramework.label: Target Competency Framework
ceterms:targetCompetencyFramework.definition: Competency framework relevant to the process being described.

ceterms:targetCompetencyOf.label: Target Competency Of
ceterms:targetCompetencyOf.definition: Resource that targets this Competency for a particular purpose.

ceterms:targetContactPoint.label: Target Contact Point
ceterms:targetContactPoint.definition: Options for contacting the organization or person.

ceterms:targetCredential.label: Target Credential
ceterms:targetCredential.definition: Credential that is a focus or target of the condition, process or verification service.

ceterms:targetJob.label: Target Job
ceterms:targetJob.definition: Job that is the focus or target of this resource.

ceterms:targetLearningOpportunity.label: Target Learning Opportunity
ceterms:targetLearningOpportunity.definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.

ceterms:targetLearningResource.label: Target Learning Resource
ceterms:targetLearningResource.definition: Learning object or resource that is used as part of a learning activity.
ceterms:targetLearningResource.comment: Examples include a textbook or lesson plan that describes or records the educational activity (e.g. an audio- or video-recording of a lesson).

ceterms:targetMetric.label: Target Metric
ceterms:targetMetric.definition: Metric used to assess whether a condition has been met.

ceterms:targetNode.label: Target Node
ceterms:targetNode.definition: Individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the target of an alignment.
ceterms:targetNode.comment: The target node returned must be the exact competency or concept being described and no other competency or concept. References to data or a document that returns all of the competencies or concepts in the framework to which the target node belongs should use the ceterms:framework property.
ceterms:targetNode.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:targetNodeDescription.label: Target Description
ceterms:targetNodeDescription.definition: Textual description of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the target of an alignment.
ceterms:targetNodeDescription.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:targetNodeName.label: Target Node Name
ceterms:targetNodeName.definition: Name of an individual entry in a formally defined framework that is the target of an alignment.
ceterms:targetNodeName.usageNote: "Framework" may be interpreted broadly to include any scheme or schema for organizing and referencing resources.

ceterms:targetOccupation.label: Target Occupation
ceterms:targetOccupation.definition: Occupation that is the focus or target of this resource.

ceterms:targetPathway.label: Target Pathway
ceterms:targetPathway.definition: Pathway in which this resource is a potential component.

ceterms:targetTask.label: Target Task
ceterms:targetTask.definition: Task that is the focus or target of this resource.

ceterms:teaches.label: Teaches
ceterms:teaches.definition: Competency that the learning opportunity is intended to teach.

ceterms:temporalCoverage.label: Temporal Coverage
ceterms:temporalCoverage.definition: Indicates the time period to which the entity's content applies or during which it occurres.
ceterms:temporalCoverage.comment: In the CTDL, the ceterms:temporalCoverage property serves as a super-property for an array of sub-properties defining time-dependent aspects of a resource.

ceterms:timeRequired.label: Time Required
ceterms:timeRequired.definition: Total engaged or participating time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
ceterms:timeRequired.comment: This is intended to indicate only the sum of the individual amounts of time which are spent actively engaged in pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource, regardless of the overall time span required to complete it.
ceterms:timeRequired.usageNote: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 50 hours as PT50H.

ceterms:transferValue.label: Transfer Value
ceterms:transferValue.comment: For example, this may be the credit value earned in one context that may be applied to another, but other forms of recognition of prior learning are also relevant.

ceterms:transferValueFor.label: Transfer Value For
ceterms:transferValueFor.definition: Resource for which the described transfer value is applicable.
ceterms:transferValueFor.comment: When this property references multiple resources, those resources should be treated as a set for which, collectively, the transfer value is applicable.

ceterms:transferValueFrom.label: Transfer Value From
ceterms:transferValueFrom.definition: Resource from which the described transfer value originates.
ceterms:transferValueFrom.comment: When this property references multiple resources, those resources should be treated as a set from which, collectively, the transfer value originates.

ceterms:transferValueStatement.label: Transfer Value Statement
ceterms:transferValueStatement.definition: Webpage or online document that defines or explains the nature of transfer value handled by the organization.

ceterms:transferValueStatementDescriptio.label: Transfer Value Statement Description
ceterms:transferValueStatementDescriptio.definition: Description of the nature of transfer value handled by the organization.

ceterms:usesVerificationService.label: Uses Verification Service
ceterms:usesVerificationService.definition: Reference to a service that is used to verify this Credential or type of credential.

ceterms:verificationDirectory.label: Verification Directory
ceterms:verificationDirectory.definition: Directory of credential holders and their current statuses.

ceterms:verificationMethodDescription.label: Verification Method Description
ceterms:verificationMethodDescription.definition: Textual description of the methods used to evaluate an assessment, learning opportunity, process or verificaiton service for validity or reliability.

ceterms:verificationService.label: Verification Service URL
ceterms:verificationService.definition: Direct access to the verification service.
ceterms:verificationService.comment: This property identifies machine-accessible services, such as API endpoints, that provide direct access to the verification service being described.
ceterms:verificationService.usageNote: For general webpages describing the service, use the subjectWebpage property.

ceterms:verifiedClaimType.label: Verified Claim Type
ceterms:verifiedClaimType.definition: Type of claim provided through a verification service; select from an existing enumeration of such types.
ceterms:verifiedClaimType.usageNote: Best practice for developing credential descriptions for the Credential Engine Registry is to use the ceterms:ClaimType vocabulary.

ceterms:versionCode.label: Version Code
ceterms:versionCode.definition: Alphanumeric identifier of the version of the resource that is unique within the organizational context of its owner and which does not need the context of other information in order to be interpreted.
ceterms:versionCode.usageNote: Intended for simple string and/or numeric version codes or identifiers, such as "10" or "3B.1" or "2024 Release". For version identifiers that need to reference additional information, such as a type of version or framework for versioning, use versionIdentifier.

ceterms:versionIdentifier.label: Version Identifier
ceterms:versionIdentifier.definition: Alphanumeric identifier of the version of the resource and information about the identifier's originating context or scheme.
ceterms:versionIdentifier.usageNote: Use versionCode for any local identifier of the version of the resource that come from the organizational context its owner and which do not need the context of other information in order to be interpreted.

ceterms:weight.label: Weight
ceterms:weight.definition: Measurement of the weight, degree, percent, or strength of a recommendation, requirement, or comparison.
ceterms:weight.usageNote: Best practice is to assign a decimal value weight between 0 and 1 that indicates the strength of the assertion, with 0 being weakest and 1 being strongest.

ceterms:yearsOfExperience.label: Years of Experience
ceterms:yearsOfExperience.usageNote: Non-integer year values may be expressed as point value, for example, 0.25, 1.5, etc.

claimType:BadgeClaim.label: Badge Claim
claimType:BadgeClaim.definition: Verifiable visual representation that can be shared, embedded, linked, or otherwise used to publicly indicate that an individual has the represented credential.

claimType:TranscriptClaim.label: Transcript Claim
claimType:TranscriptClaim.definition: Verifiable representation of postsecondary courses and degrees completed.

claimType:VerifiedClaim.label: Verified Claim
claimType:VerifiedClaim.definition: Verifiable representation of the credential holder's achievement.

collectionCategory:Competency.label: Competency
collectionCategory:Competency.usageNote: Use ceasn:CompetencyFramework for aggregations of competencies that are logically related.

collectionCategory:ETPL.label: Eligible Training Providers List
collectionCategory:ETPL.definition: Training providers meeting the requirements stipulated in the U.S. Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act per the promulgating body.
collectionCategory:ETPL.comment: This list includes the Learning Opportunities and Credentials offered by training providers that have met requirements.

collectionCategory:GIBill.label: GI Bill
collectionCategory:GIBill.definition: Education and training programs qualifying for the U.S. GI Bill per the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:HighSkill.label: High Skill
collectionCategory:HighSkill.definition: Occupations, Jobs, Work Roles, or Tasks meeting skill level criteria based on labor market data per the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:HighWage.label: High Wage
collectionCategory:HighWage.definition: Occupations and Jobs meeting earnings threshold criteria based on labor market data per the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:InDemand.label: In Demand
collectionCategory:InDemand.definition: Resources meeting workforce demand criteria based on labor market data per the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:IndustryRecognized.label: Industry Recognized
collectionCategory:IndustryRecognized.definition: Learning Opportunities, Learning Programs, Courses, Assessments or Credentials recognized in one or more industries based on factors such as job market demand per the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:Perkins.label: Perkins
collectionCategory:Perkins.definition: Credentials approved for funding under the U.S. Strengthening Career and Technical Education for the 21st Century Act (Perkins V) per the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:PromiseScholarship.label: Promise Scholarship
collectionCategory:PromiseScholarship.definition: Specified programs in eligible postsecondary educational institutions for which qualified students may receive a Promise Scholarship.

collectionCategory:Quality.label: Quality
collectionCategory:Quality.definition: Learning Opportunities, Learning Programs, Courses, Assessments or Credentials that meet criteria for quality as determined by the promulgating body.

collectionCategory:StateApprovedPostseco.label: State Approved Postsecondary Programs
collectionCategory:StateApprovedPostseco.definition: Learning Opportunities, Learning Programs, Courses, Assessments or Credentials approved by a state agency to be offered within that state’s jurisdiction by postsecondary institutions.

compare:EQ.label: Equal To
compare:EQ.definition: The value of the left is equal to the value of the right.

compare:GT.label: Greater Than
compare:GT.definition: The value of the left is greater than the value of the right.

compare:GTEQ.label: Greater Than or Equal To
compare:GTEQ.definition: The value of the left is greater than or equal to the value of the right.

compare:LT.label: Less Than
compare:LT.definition: The value of the left is less than the value of the right.

compare:LTEQ.label: Less Than or Equal To
compare:LTEQ.definition: The value of the left is less than or equal to the value of the right.

compare:NEQ.label: Not Equal To
compare:NEQ.definition: The value of the left is not equal to the value of the right.

costType:Application.label: Application
costType:Application.definition: Cost of applying for the resource being described.

costType:Childcare.label: Childcare
costType:Childcare.definition: Financial aid towards paying for supervision, care, and activities for children.

costType:Consumables.label: Consumables
costType:Consumables.definition: Cost for supplies or materials that are depleted or replaced.
costType:Consumables.usageNote: For resources such as textbooks use costType:LearningResource.

costType:EnrollmentFee.label: Enrollment Fee
costType:EnrollmentFee.definition: Cost to enroll in the learning opportunity being described.

costType:Equipment.label: Equipment
costType:Equipment.definition: Cost for durable tools, instruments or machines.
costType:Equipment.usageNote: For resources such as textbooks use costType:LearningResource.

costType:LearningResource.label: Learning Resource
costType:LearningResource.definition: Cost for one or more learning resources.
costType:LearningResource.comment: Examples include resources such as textbooks, workbooks, laboratory supplies, and other related supplies.

costType:Meals.label: Meals
costType:Meals.definition: Cost for meals while participating in the learning opportunity.

costType:MixedFees.label: Mixed Fees
costType:MixedFees.definition: The sum of fees that are not identified individually.

costType:OptionalCharges.label: Optional Charges
costType:OptionalCharges.definition: Cost for additional fees, other services, equipment, or facilities that are not required.

costType:PersonalExpenses.label: Personal Expenses
costType:PersonalExpenses.definition: Cost for personal living or incidental expenses.
costType:PersonalExpenses.usageNote: Where possible use a more specific Cost Type, such as costType:Travel or costType:Meals.

costType:ProcessingFee.label: Processing Fee
costType:ProcessingFee.definition: Cost for processing or expediting information related to the resource being described.

costType:ProgramSpecificFee.label: Program Specific Fee
costType:ProgramSpecificFee.definition: Additional cost for participation with a specific program or course of study such as engineering, business, and nursing.

costType:ReexaminationFee.label: Reexamination Fee
costType:ReexaminationFee.definition: Cost for retaking an instance of the resource being described.

costType:RenewalFee.label: Maintenance Fee
costType:RenewalFee.definition: Cost for maintenance or renewal of the resource being described.

costType:ReschedulingFee.label: Rescheduling Fee
costType:ReschedulingFee.definition: Cost for rescheduling an instance of the resource being described.

costType:RoomOrResidency.label: Room or Residence
costType:RoomOrResidency.definition: Cost for room, residence or boarding.

costType:ScoringFee.label: Scoring Fee
costType:ScoringFee.definition: Cost for scoring the resource being described.

costType:SpecialHardship.label: Special Hardship
costType:SpecialHardship.definition: Financial aid towards covering hardship arising from unforeseen circumstances.

costType:SpecialNeeds.label: Special Needs
costType:SpecialNeeds.definition: Financial aid towards paying for extra costs associated with accommodating a special need.

costType:StudentServicesFee.label: Student Services Fee
costType:StudentServicesFee.definition: Cost for student services related to the learning opportunity.

costType:TechnologyFee.label: Technology Fee
costType:TechnologyFee.definition: Cost for accessing technologies related to the learning opportunity or activity.

costType:Travel.label: Travel
costType:Travel.definition: Financial aid towards paying for travel costs.

credentialStat:Active.label: Active
credentialStat:Active.definition: Awards of the credential are ongoing.

credentialStat:Ceasing.label: Ceasing
credentialStat:Ceasing.definition: Resource is in the process of becoming no longer active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

credentialStat:Deprecated.label: Deprecated
credentialStat:Deprecated.definition: Awards of the credential have ceased.

credentialStat:Probationary.label: Probationary
credentialStat:Probationary.definition: Credential award is provisional or temporary; frequently pending further assessment of qualification.

credentialStat:Suspended.label: Suspended
credentialStat:Suspended.definition: Awards of the credential are not available, but may resume.

credentialStat:TeachOut.label: Teach Out
credentialStat:TeachOut.definition: Arrangement by which an educational institution provides its current students with the opportunity to complete the credential when the program, institution or location offering access closes.

creditUnit:AcademicYear.label: Academic Year
creditUnit:AcademicYear.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted as being related to one or more academic years.

creditUnit:CarnegieUnit.label: Carnegie Unit
creditUnit:CarnegieUnit.definition: Credit that is based on 120 hours of contact time or class time with an instructor.

creditUnit:CertificateCredit.label: Certificate Credit
creditUnit:CertificateCredit.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for certificates.
creditUnit:CertificateCredit.comment: Includes credits earned while enrolled in a certificate program.

creditUnit:ClockHour.label: Clock Hour
creditUnit:ClockHour.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted as being related to one or more temporal hours.

creditUnit:CompetencyCredit.label: Competency Credit
creditUnit:CompetencyCredit.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for a particular competency or set of competencies.

creditUnit:ContactHour.label: Contact Hour
creditUnit:ContactHour.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted as being related to one or more temporal hours of instruction presented to students.

creditUnit:ContinuingEducationUnit.label: Continuing Education Unit
creditUnit:ContinuingEducationUnit.definition: Credit that is issued or is accepted as education units for meeting professional development requirements.
creditUnit:ContinuingEducationUnit.comment: Based on international standards, continuing education units are based on contact hours that may be converted to other units of measurement, such as professional development hours (PDH), continuing education credits (CEU), and continuing professional credits (CPC).

creditUnit:DegreeCredit.label: Degree Credit
creditUnit:DegreeCredit.definition: Credit that is issued or is accepted as credit for earning a college-level degree.
creditUnit:DegreeCredit.comment: Includes credits earned while enrolled in a postsecondary program for a college-level degree.

creditUnit:DualCredit.label: Dual Credit
creditUnit:DualCredit.definition: Credit that is applicable to two different educational levels.

creditUnit:QuarterHour.label: Quarter Hour
creditUnit:QuarterHour.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted at an academic quarter level.

creditUnit:RequirementCredit.label: Requirement Credit
creditUnit:RequirementCredit.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for some type of requirement.

creditUnit:SecondaryDiplomaCredit.label: Secondary Diploma Credit
creditUnit:SecondaryDiplomaCredit.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted for a secondary diploma.
creditUnit:SecondaryDiplomaCredit.comment: Includes credits earned while enrolled in a secondary diploma program that meet graduation requirements.

creditUnit:SemesterHour.label: Semester Hour
creditUnit:SemesterHour.definition: Credit that is issued or accepted at a semester level.

creditUnit:TimeBasedCredit.label: Time-Based Credit
creditUnit:TimeBasedCredit.definition: Credit with a unit of measurement based on time, either figuratively or literally.

creditUnit:TypeBasedCredit.label: Type-Based Credit
creditUnit:TypeBasedCredit.definition: Credit with a unit of measurement based on the type of credit.

deliveryType:BlendedDelivery.label: Blended Delivery
deliveryType:BlendedDelivery.definition: Delivery includes significant levels of both in person and online.

deliveryType:OnlineOnly.label: Online Only
deliveryType:OnlineOnly.definition: Delivery is only via the Internet.

deliveryType:VariableSite.label: Variable Site
deliveryType:VariableSite.definition: Delivery is not tied to a specific site.
deliveryType:VariableSite.comment: Includes physical/in-person delivery to a range of locations, whether predetermined or customized to a specific need. Examples include equipment for dispensing information to mobile devices in locations with limited/no connection.

financialAid:AcademicAssistantship.label: Academic Assistantship
financialAid:AcademicAssistantship.definition: Paid employment in which students receive tuition or other reimbursement for the tasks they perform for faculty members, departments, and/or educational institutions.

financialAid:Apprenticeship.label: Apprenticeship
financialAid:Apprenticeship.definition: Combination of on-the-job training and related instruction that meets standards in which workers learn the practical and theoretical aspects of a skilled occupation.

financialAid:CoOperative.label: Co-Operative
financialAid:CoOperative.definition: Paid work experience utilized by approved career and technical education programs to combine classroom and on-the-job training and education which provides academic credit for structured job experience.

financialAid:DoDTuitionAssistance.label: Department of Defense Tuition Assistance
financialAid:DoDTuitionAssistance.definition: Financial assistance provided to qualified active duty service members and their families for voluntary off-duty educational programs in support of professional and personal self-development goals.

financialAid:FederalGrant.label: Federal Grant
financialAid:FederalGrant.definition: Financial subsidy, which doesn’t require repayment, based on meeting requirements determined by the Federal Government.

financialAid:FederalScholarship.label: Federal Scholarship
financialAid:FederalScholarship.definition: Financial aid award, which doesn’t require repayment, from the Federal Government based on student achievement and other criteria for education.

financialAid:FederalSubsidizedLoan.label: Federal Subsidized Loan
financialAid:FederalSubsidizedLoan.definition: Loan from the Federal Government that is based on financial needs of the student and is intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:FederalUnsubsidizedLoan.label: Federal Unsubsidized Loan
financialAid:FederalUnsubsidizedLoan.definition: Loan from the Federal Government that does not require evidence of the financial needs of the student, and is intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:FederalWorkStudy.label: Federal Work Study
financialAid:FederalWorkStudy.definition: Program funded by the Federal Government designed to provide part-time jobs for students to offset educational expenses.

financialAid:General.label: General Financial Assistance
financialAid:General.definition: Types of financial assistance for students towards education, training, or related costs of pursuing a credential, program, or other resource.

financialAid:Grant.label: Grant
financialAid:Grant.definition: Financial subsidy, which doesn’t require repayment, based on meeting requirements determined by the grantor.

financialAid:InstitutionalGrant.label: Institutional Grant
financialAid:InstitutionalGrant.definition: Financial subsidy, including free or discounted tuition or other fees, which doesn’t require repayment, based on meeting requirements determined by an educational institution.

financialAid:InstitutionalLoan.label: Institutional Loan
financialAid:InstitutionalLoan.definition: Loan from an educational institution that is intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:InstitutionalScholarship.label: Institutional Scholarship
financialAid:InstitutionalScholarship.definition: Financial aid award, which doesn’t require repayment, from an educational institution based on student achievement and other criteria for education.

financialAid:Internship.label: Internship
financialAid:Internship.definition: Time-limited work offered by an organization approved by a qualified institution to gain experience or satisfy requirements for another resource.

financialAid:Loan.label: Loan
financialAid:Loan.definition: Financial aid that requires repayment with terms determined by the entity providing the loan.

financialAid:LoanForgivenessProgram.label: Loan Forgiveness Program
financialAid:LoanForgivenessProgram.definition: Program that forgives the remaining balance on a loan after meeting certain requirements.

financialAid:Military.label: Military
financialAid:Military.definition: Financial aid available to active duty service members, veterans, and/or their qualified family members.

financialAid:OtherGrant.label: Other Grant
financialAid:OtherGrant.definition: Financial subsidy based on meeting requirements from one or more other sources.

financialAid:OtherLoan.label: Other Loan
financialAid:OtherLoan.definition: Loan from one or more other sources that is intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:OtherOnCampusWork.label: Other On-Campus Work
financialAid:OtherOnCampusWork.definition: Paid non-academic employment available for students on an educational institution’s campus.

financialAid:OtherScholarship.label: Other Scholarship
financialAid:OtherScholarship.definition: Financial aid award, which doesn’t require repayment, from one or more other sources based on student achievement and other criteria.

financialAid:ParentPLUSLoan.label: Parent PLUS Loan
financialAid:ParentPLUSLoan.definition: Loan from the Federal Government available to the parents of dependent students.

financialAid:PellGrant.label: Pell Grant
financialAid:PellGrant.definition: Financial subsidy, which doesn’t require repayment, that the Federal Government provides based on the financial needs of the student.

financialAid:Post911GIBill.label: Post 9-11 GI Bill
financialAid:Post911GIBill.definition: Financial assistance provided to qualified active duty service members, veterans, and qualified family members that is based on military service and intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:PrivateGrant.label: Private Grant
financialAid:PrivateGrant.definition: Financial subsidy, which doesn’t require repayment, based on meeting requirements determined by a private entity, including employers.

financialAid:PrivateLoan.label: Private Loan
financialAid:PrivateLoan.definition: Loan from a private entity, including employers, that is intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:PrivateScholarship.label: Private Scholarship
financialAid:PrivateScholarship.definition: Financial aid award, which doesn’t require repayment, from a private entity, including employers, based on student achievement and other criteria for education.

financialAid:PromiseProgram.label: Promise Program
financialAid:PromiseProgram.definition: Program for students in a given area, with minimal requirements, that pays for tuition without requiring repayment.

financialAid:Scholarship.label: Scholarship
financialAid:Scholarship.definition: Financial aid award based on student achievement and other criteria for education that doesn’t require repayment.

financialAid:StateLocalGrant.label: State or Local Grant
financialAid:StateLocalGrant.definition: Financial subsidy, which doesn’t require repayment, based on meeting requirements determined by a state, province, region, and/or local government.

financialAid:StateLocalLoan.label: State or Local Loan
financialAid:StateLocalLoan.definition: Loan from a state, province, region, and/or local government that is intended to offset costs related to education, living, and resources.

financialAid:StateLocalMilitaryAssistanc.label: State or Local Military Assistance
financialAid:StateLocalMilitaryAssistanc.definition: Financial aid provided by a state or local government to active duty service members, veterans, and/or qualified family members.

financialAid:StateLocalScholarship.label: State or Local Scholarship
financialAid:StateLocalScholarship.definition: Financial aid award, which doesn’t require repayment, from a state, province, region, and/or local government based on student achievement and other criteria for education.

financialAid:StateLocalWork.label: State or Local Work
financialAid:StateLocalWork.definition: Program funded by a state, province, region, and/or local government designed to provide work for students to offset educational expenses.

financialAid:Stipend.label: Stipend
financialAid:Stipend.definition: A fixed sum of money paid for services or to defray expenses incurred through specific activities, which is typically distinct from wages or a salary.

financialAid:VEAP.label: Veteran Educational Assistance Program
financialAid:VEAP.definition: Financial assistance provided to qualified active duty service members and veterans as a matching program that is intended to offset educational expenses.

financialAid:VocationalRehabilitation.label: Vocational Rehabilitation
financialAid:VocationalRehabilitation.definition: Financial for veterans with a qualifying service-connected disability rating for training or education related to pursuit of a career or career-related resource.

financialAid:WIOA.label: Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA)
financialAid:WIOA.definition: Financial aid established on behalf of a qualified participant with a training provider that is on the state's Eligible Training Provider List (ETPL).

financialAid:WorkBased.label: Work-Based
financialAid:WorkBased.definition: Financial compensation for participating in work-based learning opportunities.

inputType:ArtificialIntelligence.label: Artificial Intelligence
inputType:ArtificialIntelligence.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations based on, or provided by any form of AI.

inputType:Associations.label: Professional Associations
inputType:Associations.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by professional associations.

inputType:Business.label: Business
inputType:Business.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by business.

inputType:BusinessAssociation.label: Business or Industry Association
inputType:BusinessAssociation.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by business or industry association.

inputType:Committee.label: Committee
inputType:Committee.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by a group of individuals convened to represent a larger group or range of stakeholders.

inputType:Consumers.label: Consumers
inputType:Consumers.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by consumers.

inputType:EducationAdministrators.label: Education Administrators
inputType:EducationAdministrators.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by education administrators.

inputType:Educators.label: Educators
inputType:Educators.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by education instructors or faculty.

inputType:Experts.label: Subject Matter Experts
inputType:Experts.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by subject matter experts.

inputType:Governments.label: Governments
inputType:Governments.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by government.
inputType:Governments.comment: May include local, state or provincial, and federal or national government.

inputType:Guardians.label: Guardians
inputType:Guardians.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by parents or guardians.

inputType:InternationalBodies.label: International Bodies
inputType:InternationalBodies.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by international bodies.

inputType:Practitioners.label: Practitioners
inputType:Practitioners.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by practitioners.

inputType:Public.label: Public
inputType:Public.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by community members and the general public.

inputType:Students.label: Students
inputType:Students.definition: External stakeholder review, guidance or recommendations by all types of learners.

learnMethod:Applied.label: Applied Instruction
learnMethod:Applied.definition: Provides learning opportunities in the context of real world examples, cases, and applications.
learnMethod:Applied.comment: Applies to methods such as contextual learning, applied academics, academic-technical integration, problem-based learning, project-based learning, and case methods.

learnMethod:Apprenticeship.label: Apprenticeship
learnMethod:Apprenticeship.definition: Learning through work that leads to a credential that is recognized by a relevant authority and is deliberately structured and supported to provide a progression of learning experiences.

learnMethod:AugmentedReality.label: Augmented Reality
learnMethod:AugmentedReality.definition: Provides interactive learning experience through technology that superimposes a computer-generated image on a user's view of the real world, thus providing a composite view.

learnMethod:ClinicalRotation.label: Clinical Rotation
learnMethod:ClinicalRotation.definition: Learning through real-world work experience in a medical context under the direct supervision of a qualified practitioner.

learnMethod:CocurricularLearning.label: Cocurricular Learning
learnMethod:CocurricularLearning.definition: Learning opportunity that supplements or complements the curriculum.
learnMethod:CocurricularLearning.usageNote: Use for activities that are not part of a formal curriculum.

learnMethod:CohortBased.label: Cohort-Based
learnMethod:CohortBased.definition: Format in which people  progress as a group.

learnMethod:CompetencyBased.label: Competency Based
learnMethod:CompetencyBased.definition: Method that focuses on learners demonstrating the knowledge, skills and/or attitudes in highly specific units regardless of time, place, or pace of learning, usually in authentic contexts.
learnMethod:CompetencyBased.comment: This definition is based on Commonwealth of Learning (COL) "Open and Distance Learning: Key Terms and Definitions" (May 2023) http://hdl.handle.net/11599/3558

learnMethod:Gaming.label: Gaming
learnMethod:Gaming.definition: Provides interactive educational experiences which demonstrate concepts in a way that promotes critical thinking, overcoming challenges within prescribed rule sets, problem solving, and in some cases, teamwork and/or competition.
learnMethod:Gaming.comment: Individual or group games that have cognitive, social, behavioral, and/or emotional dimensions which are related to educational objectives.

learnMethod:Internship.label: Internship
learnMethod:Internship.definition: Work position that is intended to provide a learner with an opportunity to gain experience but that is not structured around learning and does not itself lead to a credential recognized by a relevant authority.

learnMethod:Laboratory.label: Laboratory
learnMethod:Laboratory.definition: Hands-on individual or group experiences for applied learning concepts and methods, procedures and protocols with equipment and technologies.
learnMethod:Laboratory.comment: Applies to clinical practice and methods such as physical and/or virtual simulation or participation, whether direct or indirect.

learnMethod:Lecture.label: Lecture
learnMethod:Lecture.definition: Primary method is presentation by an instructor of learning material and may include student discussion.
learnMethod:Lecture.comment: Lecture courses may involve student questions and answers, but the role of the instructor is clearly differentiated from that of the students.

learnMethod:MedicalResidency.label: Medical Residency
learnMethod:MedicalResidency.definition: Learning through real-world work experience at the graduate level in a medical context where a qualified participant works under the direct supervision of a senior practicioner.

learnMethod:Prerecorded.label: Prerecorded
learnMethod:Prerecorded.definition: Learning by using video, audio, or other prerecorded content.

learnMethod:SelfPaced.label: Self Paced
learnMethod:SelfPaced.definition: Provides for personalization and flexibility in the timing and progression of learning for individual learners based on their preferences and needs, prior learning experiences, and ability to progress through learning opportunities.
learnMethod:SelfPaced.comment: Applies to methods such as competency-based education, open-entry/open exit, independent study, private study, and correspondence.

learnMethod:Seminar.label: Seminar
learnMethod:Seminar.definition: Primary method is active student discussion leading to advancement of the topic and facilitated by an instructor.
learnMethod:Seminar.comment: Seminars typically involve small groups to facilitate equal opportunity with the instructor and colleagues to be engaged and occasionally may include students leading discussions.

learnMethod:Simulation.label: Simulation
learnMethod:Simulation.definition: Provides interactive learning experience through imitation of a situation or process.

learnMethod:WorkBased.label: Work Based
learnMethod:WorkBased.definition: Provides real-world work experiences that may be paid or unpaid and provided in group or individual formats normally outside the classroom.
learnMethod:WorkBased.comment: Applies to methods such as apprenticeships, internships, externships, work study, clinical rotations, residencies, practicums, field study, team projects, and cooperative education.

lifeCycle:Active.label: Active
lifeCycle:Active.definition: Resource is active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

lifeCycle:Ceased.label: Ceased
lifeCycle:Ceased.definition: Resource is permanently no longer active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

lifeCycle:Ceasing.label: Ceasing
lifeCycle:Ceasing.definition: Resource is in the process of becoming no longer active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

lifeCycle:Developing.label: Developing
lifeCycle:Developing.definition: Resource is under development and may or may not become active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

lifeCycle:Suspended.label: Suspended
lifeCycle:Suspended.definition: Resource is temporarily not active, current, ongoing, offered, operational, or available.

lifeCycle:TeachOut.label: Teach Out
lifeCycle:TeachOut.definition: Arrangement by which an educational institution provides its current students with the opportunity to complete their course of study when the program, institution or location offering access closes.

logic:And.label: And
logic:And.definition: Relation is satisfied when all of the conditions and constraints are satisfied.
logic:And.usageNote: When used in a Component Condition, this applies to the combination of all immediately subordinate Component Conditions and Constraints.

logic:OnlyOne.label: Only One
logic:OnlyOne.definition: Relation is satisfied when exactly one, and not more, of the conditions or constraints is satisfied.
logic:OnlyOne.usageNote: When used in a Component Condition, this applies to the combination of all immediately subordinate Component Conditions and Constraints.

logic:Or.label: Or
logic:Or.definition: Relation is satisfied when at least one of the conditions or constraints is satisfied.
logic:Or.usageNote: When used in a Component Condition, this applies to the combination of all immediately subordinate Component Conditions and Constraints.

lrEvidence:AssessmentScore.label: Assessment Score
lrEvidence:AssessmentScore.definition: Official documentation of a person’s assessment results.

lrEvidence:CompletionRecord.label: Completion Record
lrEvidence:CompletionRecord.definition: Document verifying successful completion of structured training with an identifiable provider.
lrEvidence:CompletionRecord.comment: Applies to employer, community-based, military, or continuing education training.

lrEvidence:Credential.label: Credential
lrEvidence:Credential.definition: Representation of a credential, digital or non-digital, attesting to a person’s achievements.

lrEvidence:CreditRecommendation.label: Credit Recommendation
lrEvidence:CreditRecommendation.definition: Recommendation for credit or competency value issued by an authoritative evaluating body, including amount, level, and conditions for specified learning.
lrEvidence:CreditRecommendation.comment: In the U.S., common sources include ACE credit recommendations.

lrEvidence:EmployerAttestation.label: Employer Attestation
lrEvidence:EmployerAttestation.definition: Formal statement from an employer verifying duties, scope of work, and performance relevant to claimed learning.

lrEvidence:HoursVerification.label: Hours Verification
lrEvidence:HoursVerification.definition: Record confirming supervised practice, clinical hours, or comparable time-based experience.
lrEvidence:HoursVerification.comment: Common in clinical, practicum, apprenticeship, or licensure contexts.

lrEvidence:JobVerification.label: Job Verification
lrEvidence:JobVerification.definition: Official role description with verification of incumbency and dates.

lrEvidence:MilitaryTranscript.label: Military Transcript
lrEvidence:MilitaryTranscript.definition: Official record of a person’s military education, training, occupations, and related evaluations.

lrEvidence:Portfolio.label: Portfolio
lrEvidence:Portfolio.definition: Curated collection of artifacts evidencing learning typically aligned to defined outcomes.

lrEvidence:ReflectiveNarrative.label: Reflective Narrative
lrEvidence:ReflectiveNarrative.definition: Structured reflection connecting prior experience to defined competencies or outcomes.
lrEvidence:ReflectiveNarrative.comment: Often required in portfolio submissions. There may be a requirement for commentary or analysis in the narrative.

lrEvidence:ResumeVerification.label: Résumé Verification
lrEvidence:ResumeVerification.definition: Structured record of experience and education accompanied by sufficient validation for evaluation.
lrEvidence:ResumeVerification.comment: Validation may include references, verification letters, or linked evidence.

lrEvidence:SkillProfile.label: Skill Profile
lrEvidence:SkillProfile.definition: Document that maps a person’s work artifacts or experiences to specified competencies, learning outcomes, or course requirements.

lrEvidence:Syllabus.label: Syllabus
lrEvidence:Syllabus.definition: Document outlining objectives, content, requirements, schedule, and assessment for a specific course.

lrEvidence:Transcript.label: Transcript
lrEvidence:Transcript.definition: Official academic record of a person’s achievements issued by the record holder.
lrEvidence:Transcript.comment: May be issued by the originating institution or a recognized clearinghouse.

lrEvidence:WorkProduct.label: Work Product
lrEvidence:WorkProduct.definition: Substantive work product demonstrating applied knowledge aligned to defined outcomes.
lrEvidence:WorkProduct.comment: May include reports, designs, code, media, or presentations.

lrEvidence:WorkplaceLearningRecord.label: Workplace Learning Record
lrEvidence:WorkplaceLearningRecord.definition: Documentation of a person's on the job learning.

lrMethod:CreditRecommendationReview.label: Credit Recommendation Review
lrMethod:CreditRecommendationReview.definition: An evaluation method that uses an authoritative body’s credit recommendation to determine credit awards.
lrMethod:CreditRecommendationReview.comment: In the U.S., examples include American Council on Education (ACE) credit recommendations.

lrMethod:ExternalTrainingEvaluation.label: External Training Evaluation
lrMethod:ExternalTrainingEvaluation.definition: An evaluation method in which structured, external non-academic training is reviewed to award credit or standing.
lrMethod:ExternalTrainingEvaluation.comment: May be conducted by employer, third-party, vendor, or external credentialing organization.

lrMethod:FacultyDevelopedExamination.label: Faculty-Developed Examination
lrMethod:FacultyDevelopedExamination.definition: A method in which learning is assessed by a course-specific exam created and administered by faculty.
lrMethod:FacultyDevelopedExamination.comment: In the United States, examples include challenge exams.

lrMethod:FacultyTransferEvaluation.label: Faculty Transfer Evaluation
lrMethod:FacultyTransferEvaluation.definition: An evaluation method in which faculty subject-matter experts judge whether prior learning meets course outcomes.

lrMethod:IndividualizedPriorLearningAsse.label: Individualized Prior Learning Assessment
lrMethod:IndividualizedPriorLearningAsse.definition: An evaluation method that uses personalized approaches to assess learning.
lrMethod:IndividualizedPriorLearningAsse.comment: Examples include portfolio review, simulation, and interview.

lrMethod:InstitutionDevelopedAssessment.label: Institution-Developed Assessment
lrMethod:InstitutionDevelopedAssessment.definition: A method in which institution-created assessments are used to determine credit for prior learning.
lrMethod:InstitutionDevelopedAssessment.comment: Examples include challenge exams, projects, and labs.

lrMethod:InternationalCreditEvaluation.label: International Credit Evaluation
lrMethod:InternationalCreditEvaluation.definition: An evaluation method in which learning or credit earned from organizations in other countries is reviewed for recognition.

lrMethod:PortfolioAssessment.label: Portfolio Assessment
lrMethod:PortfolioAssessment.definition: A method in which a learner-developed portfolio is assessed to evidence prior learning aligned to defined outcomes.
lrMethod:PortfolioAssessment.comment: Examples include documentation, work products, and artifacts mapped to competencies or requirements.

lrMethod:PriorLearningAssessment.label: Prior Learning Assessment
lrMethod:PriorLearningAssessment.definition: A structured method used to evaluate an individual's prior learning and its applicability to requirements.

lrMethod:ProficiencyExamination.label: Proficiency Examination
lrMethod:ProficiencyExamination.definition: A method in which learning is assessed by an exam used to demonstrate subject mastery for placement or credit.
lrMethod:ProficiencyExamination.comment: May be internal or external; use Standardized Examination when using recognized national/international exams.

lrMethod:StandardizedExamination.label: Standardized Examination
lrMethod:StandardizedExamination.definition: A method in which learning is assessed by a recognized standardized exam administered by an authoritative body.
lrMethod:StandardizedExamination.comment: In the United States, examples include AP, CLEP, DLPT.

lrMethod:TranscriptEvaluation.label: Transcript Evaluation
lrMethod:TranscriptEvaluation.definition: An evaluation method in which prior records are reviewed to determine applicability.

lrMethod:TransferCreditEvaluation.label: Transfer Credit Evaluation
lrMethod:TransferCreditEvaluation.definition: An evaluation method that provides a preliminary determination of transferability using supplied records before matriculation.

lrOutcome:AdvancedStanding.label: Advanced Standing
lrOutcome:AdvancedStanding.definition: An outcome in which standing toward a program or qualification is granted, which may or may not carry transcripted credit.

lrOutcome:CreditAwarded.label: Credit Awarded
lrOutcome:CreditAwarded.definition: An outcome in which learning results in transcripted credit.

lrOutcome:CreditEquivalency.label: Credit Equivalency
lrOutcome:CreditEquivalency.definition: An outcome in which learning fulfills a credit requirement.

lrOutcome:EligibilityMet.label: Eligibility Met
lrOutcome:EligibilityMet.definition: An outcome in which a prerequisite, admission, or other eligibility requirement is satisfied by recognized learning.

lrOutcome:ExemptionWaiver.label: Exemption Waiver
lrOutcome:ExemptionWaiver.definition: An outcome in which a requirement is waived.

lrOutcome:NotRecognized.label: Not Recognized
lrOutcome:NotRecognized.definition: An outcome in which an evaluation is completed but no recognition is granted.

lrOutcome:Placement.label: Placement
lrOutcome:Placement.definition: An outcome in which a person is placed into a program, hired or promoted.

lrOutcome:RecognitionOnly.label: Recognition Only
lrOutcome:RecognitionOnly.definition: An outcome in which learning is acknowledged for placement, exemption, or eligibility without awarding credit.

lrSource:Apprenticeship.label: Apprenticeship
lrSource:Apprenticeship.definition: Learning completed in a registered apprenticeship program.

lrSource:ClinicalPracticum.label: Clinical Practicum
lrSource:ClinicalPracticum.definition: Learning acquired through supervised clinical or practicum experiences in applied professional settings aligned to program or licensure standards.

lrSource:CommunityBasedOrganizationTrain.label: Community-Based Organization Training
lrSource:CommunityBasedOrganizationTrain.definition: Learning completed through structured training delivered by a community-based organization.

lrSource:CommunityService.label: Community Service
lrSource:CommunityService.definition: Learning acquired through unpaid service activities performed for the benefit of a community or organization outside a formal curriculum or assessed program.

lrSource:ContinuingEducation.label: Continuing Education
lrSource:ContinuingEducation.definition: Learning completed through structured, non-degree continuing education coursework.

lrSource:CooperativeEducation.label: Cooperative Education
lrSource:CooperativeEducation.definition: Learning acquired through extended, alternating work–study placements integrated with an academic program.

lrSource:Course.label: Course
lrSource:Course.definition: Learning completed in a course, a structured sequence of educational activities designed to develop prescribed competencies.

lrSource:CustodialEducation.label: Custodial Education
lrSource:CustodialEducation.definition: Learning completed in educational programs while an individual is incarcerated or in custody.

lrSource:Degree.label: Degree
lrSource:Degree.definition: Learning recognized on the basis of a previously awarded academic degree.

lrSource:DualEnrollment.label: Dual Enrollment
lrSource:DualEnrollment.definition: Learning completed in college-level coursework taken concurrently with secondary enrollment.

lrSource:EmploymentBasedTraining.label: Employment-Based Training
lrSource:EmploymentBasedTraining.definition: Learning completed through formal training provided by an employer or workforce development program.

lrSource:Exam.label: Exam
lrSource:Exam.definition: Learning demonstrated via a recognized examination administered by a national, international, or military body.

lrSource:ExperientialLearning.label: Experiential Learning
lrSource:ExperientialLearning.definition: Learning acquired through direct, hands-on experience with guided reflection in real or simulated settings.

orgType:AccreditationBody.label: Accreditation Body
orgType:AccreditationBody.definition: Organization that evaluates other resources such as organizations, learning opportunities, credentials, and/or individuals to issue third-party validation that the resource meets certain standards of quality, competency, and integrity.

orgType:AssessmentBody.label: Assessment Body
orgType:AssessmentBody.definition: Primarily offers assessments for credentials as a service.

orgType:Business.label: Business
orgType:Business.definition: Organization that primarily sells products or services and employs one or more individuals.

orgType:BusinessAssociation.label: Business or Industry Association
orgType:BusinessAssociation.definition: Membership organization primarily engaged in promoting the interests of their business members and providing them with services that may involve the provision of education and credentialing services.

orgType:CertificationBody.label: Certification Body
orgType:CertificationBody.definition: Independent, third-party organization that operates a certification program. A certification body may or may not be governmental, and may or may not have regulatory authority.

orgType:Collaborative.label: Collaborative
orgType:Collaborative.definition: Organized group of entities in the public, private, government sectors that collaborates to achieve a common set of goals.

orgType:CoordinatingBody.label: Coordinating Body
orgType:CoordinatingBody.definition: An organization that organizes multiple stakeholders around a common goal.

orgType:FourYear.label: Four-Year College
orgType:FourYear.definition: Authorized postsecondary institution that primarily offers bachelor or higher degrees, but may also award associate degrees.
orgType:FourYear.comment: Includes free-standing medical, law or other first-professional schools, schools that offer postbaccalaureate certificates only, those that offer graduate programs only, etc.

orgType:Government.label: Government Agency
orgType:Government.definition: Organization in the public sector at the federal, state or local levels.
orgType:Government.comment: Includes quasi-governmental organizations, special districts (e.g., libraries), corrections organizations, etc., except college and school districts. Is also responsible for the oversight and administration of specific functions other than the military services.

orgType:HighSchool.label: High School
orgType:HighSchool.definition: Secondary school providing instruction and educational services that do not focus primarily on career and technical education or alternative education.

orgType:LaborUnion.label: Labor Union
orgType:LaborUnion.definition: Membership organization of workers formed for the purpose of advancing its members' interests in respect to wages, benefits, and working conditions.

orgType:LowerSecondarySchool.label: Lower Secondary School
orgType:LowerSecondarySchool.definition: School primarily offering programs at the first stage of secondary education building on primary education, typically with a more subject-oriented curriculum.

orgType:Magnet.label: Magnet/Competitive Admissions School
orgType:Magnet.definition: Public school offering special instruction and programs not available elsewhere, designed to attract a more diverse student body from throughout a school district.

orgType:Military.label: Military
orgType:Military.definition: Armed services of a government entity.

orgType:NonTraditional.label: Alternative/Non-Traditional School
orgType:NonTraditional.definition: Secondary (i.e., high school) that: 1) addresses needs of students which cannot typically be met in a regular school; 2) provides nontraditional education; 3) falls outside of the categories of regular, magnet/special program emphasis, or career and technical education.

orgType:Postsecondary.label: Postsecondary Educational Institution
orgType:Postsecondary.definition: Organization such as a college or university.
orgType:Postsecondary.comment: Organization with the authority to award degrees, and whose primary purpose is to provide postsecondary (tertiary or non-tertiary) education including programs whose purpose is providing academic, vocational, and continuing professional education.

orgType:PrimarySchool.label: Primary School
orgType:PrimarySchool.definition: School primarily offering programs designed to provide students with fundamental skills in reading, writing and mathematics and to establish a solid foundation for learning.

orgType:ProfessionalAssociation.label: Professional Association
orgType:ProfessionalAssociation.definition: Membership organization primarily engaged in promoting the interests of a particular profession, the interests of individuals engaged in that profession, and providing them with services that may involve the provision of education and credentialing services.

orgType:QualityAssurance.label: Quality Assurance Body
orgType:QualityAssurance.definition: External body that performs accreditation, endorsement, approval, and/or recognition of a credential issuer.

orgType:Regulator.label: Regulator
orgType:Regulator.definition: Organization that regulates other resources such as organizations, learning opportunities, credentials, and/or individuals against established standards and criteria.

orgType:SecondarySchool.label: Secondary School
orgType:SecondarySchool.definition: School offering programs at all levels of secondary education, building on primary education through to preparing for tertiary education or providing skills relevant to employment.
orgType:SecondarySchool.usageNote: Use for schools that cover both Lower and Upper Secondary levels.

orgType:Technical.label: Career and Technical School
orgType:Technical.definition: Secondary school that focuses primarily on providing formal preparation for skilled, technical or professional occupations or careers.

orgType:TrainingProvider.label: Education and Training Provider
orgType:TrainingProvider.definition: Organization whose major purpose is to provide education and training services but is not a postsecondary education institution with the authority to award degrees.
orgType:TrainingProvider.comment: Includes community-based organizations, non-degree granting proprietary schools which are education and training providers that are recognized by states as schools.
orgType:TrainingProvider.usageNote: In the U.S., use for Title IV eligible organizations that do not award degrees.

orgType:TwoYear.label: Two-Year College
orgType:TwoYear.definition: Authorized postsecondary institution that primarily offers associate degrees and certificates, and, if authorized, may also award higher degrees.
orgType:TwoYear.comment: Includes occupational and vocational schools with programs of at least 1800 hours, academic institutions with programs of less than 4 years, etc.

orgType:UpperSecondarySchool.label: Upper Secondary School
orgType:UpperSecondarySchool.definition: School primarily offering programs at the final stage of secondary education preparing for tertiary education or providing skills relevant to employment, usually with an increased range of subject options and streams.

orgType:Vendor.label: Vendor
orgType:Vendor.definition: Sells, maintains, and issues credentials for its own products and services for public access and use.

owl:sameAs.label: Same As
owl:sameAs.definition: Links an individual to an individual; such an owl:sameAs statement indicates that two URI references actually refer to the same thing: the individuals have the same "identity".

qdata:dataCollectionMethodType.label: Data Collection Method Type
qdata:dataCollectionMethodType.definition: Type of method by which the data was collected.

qdata:dataProvider.label: Data Provider
qdata:dataProvider.definition: Credentialing organization or a third party providing the data.

qdata:percentage.label: Percentage
qdata:percentage.definition: Quotient of two values of the data set, expressed as a percentage.
qdata:percentage.usageNote: Best practice is to treat the value of this property as a verbatim percentage; for example, a value of 1.5 should be interpreted as 1.5%

qdata:relevantDataSet.label: Relevant Data Set
qdata:relevantDataSet.definition: Data Set on which earnings or employment data is based.

residency:InState.label: In-State
residency:InState.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is the state or province of the relevant activity.

residency:International.label: Foreign/International
residency:International.definition: Legal residency, domicile, or citizen status of the agent is as a foreign national.

residency:Local.label: Local
residency:Local.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is local.

residency:OutOfState.label: Out-of-State
residency:OutOfState.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is a state or province different from the state or provincial locus of the relevant activity.

residency:Regional.label: Regional
residency:Regional.definition: Legal residency or domicile status of the agent is the same geographic or political region as that of the relevant activity.

scheduleFrequency:Annually.label: Annually
scheduleFrequency:Annually.definition: Schedule is on an annual basis, typically occurring once per year.

scheduleFrequency:BiMonthly.label: Bi-Monthly
scheduleFrequency:BiMonthly.definition: Schedule is on a bi-monthly basis, typically occurring every other month.

scheduleFrequency:BiWeekly.label: Bi-Weekly
scheduleFrequency:BiWeekly.definition: Schedule is on a bi-weekly basis, typically occurring every other week.

scheduleFrequency:Daily.label: Daily
scheduleFrequency:Daily.definition: Schedule is on a daily basis, typically occurring once per day.

scheduleFrequency:EventBased.label: Event-Based
scheduleFrequency:EventBased.definition: Schedule is determined or triggered by other events, such as completion of activities, completion of the resource, events external to the resource, or other events; refer to the resource's information for details.

scheduleFrequency:Hourly.label: Hourly
scheduleFrequency:Hourly.definition: Schedule is on a hourly basis, typically occurring once per hour.

scheduleFrequency:Monthly.label: Monthly
scheduleFrequency:Monthly.definition: Schedule is on a monthly basis, typically occurring once per month.

scheduleFrequency:MultiplePerWeek.label: Multiple Per Week
scheduleFrequency:MultiplePerWeek.definition: Schedule is more frequent than a weekly basis.

scheduleFrequency:OnDemand.label: On-Demand
scheduleFrequency:OnDemand.definition: Schedule allows the participant to choose when the resource begins.

scheduleFrequency:OpenEntryExit.label: Open Entry/Exit
scheduleFrequency:OpenEntryExit.definition: Schedule allows for the participant to enter, participate with, and complete the resource during any period of the resource's run time.

scheduleFrequency:Quarterly.label: Quarterly
scheduleFrequency:Quarterly.definition: Schedule is on an quarterly basis, typically occurring three or four times per year.

scheduleFrequency:SelfPaced.label: Self-Paced
scheduleFrequency:SelfPaced.definition: Schedule allows for participation at a self-determined pace, though some specific dates and deadlines may be involved.

scheduleFrequency:SemiAnnually.label: Semi-Annually
scheduleFrequency:SemiAnnually.definition: Schedule is on an semi-annual basis, typically occurring twice per year.

scheduleFrequency:SemiMonthly.label: Semi-Monthly
scheduleFrequency:SemiMonthly.definition: Schedule is on a semi-monthly basis, typically occurring twice per month.

scheduleFrequency:SingleInstance.label: Single Instance
scheduleFrequency:SingleInstance.definition: Schedule is a single instance of this event.

scheduleFrequency:Weekly.label: Weekly
scheduleFrequency:Weekly.definition: Schedule is on a weekly basis, typically occurring once per week.

scheduleTiming:Daytime.label: Daytime
scheduleTiming:Daytime.definition: Schedule is typically during daytime hours.

scheduleTiming:Evening.label: Evening
scheduleTiming:Evening.definition: Schedule is typically during evening hours.

scheduleTiming:Weekdays.label: Weekdays
scheduleTiming:Weekdays.definition: Schedule is Monday through Friday, consecutively or non-consecutively.

scheduleTiming:Weekends.label: Weekends
scheduleTiming:Weekends.definition: Schedule is on a weekly basis, Saturday and/or Sunday.

schema:QuantitativeValue.label: Quantitative Value
schema:QuantitativeValue.definition: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes.
schema:QuantitativeValue.usageNote: Use in CTDL to describe quantitative values such as minimum and maximum credits or credit hours, etc.

schema:maxValue.label: Maximum Value
schema:maxValue.definition: The upper value of some characteristic or property.
schema:maxValue.usageNote: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

schema:minValue.label: Minimum Value
schema:minValue.definition: The lower value of some characteristic or property.
schema:minValue.usageNote: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

schema:subjectOf.label: Subject Of
schema:subjectOf.definition: A CreativeWork or Event about this Thing.

schema:unitText.label: Unit Text
schema:unitText.definition: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement.

schema:value.label: Value
schema:value.definition: The value of the property value node.
schema:value.usageNote: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

score:CriterionReferenced.label: Criterion-Referenced
score:CriterionReferenced.definition: Scored based on a comparison to defined criteria and levels of performance.

score:NormReferenced.label: Norm-Referenced
score:NormReferenced.definition: Scored based on a comparison to a distribution of performance in a reference population.

serviceType:AccreditService.label: Accredit Service
serviceType:AccreditService.definition: Agent service provides official authorization to, or approval of, a credential, organization or program based on prescribed standards or criteria.

serviceType:ApproveService.label: Approve Service
serviceType:ApproveService.definition: Agent service official accepts a credential or authorizes an organization to act or operate.

serviceType:OfferService.label: Offer Service
serviceType:OfferService.definition: Agent service offers resources such as credentials, assessments, or learning opportunities.

serviceType:RecognizeService.label: Recognize Service
serviceType:RecognizeService.definition: Agent service recommends, endorses, indicates preference for, or otherwise provides a positive judgment.

serviceType:RegulateService.label: Regulate Service
serviceType:RegulateService.definition: Agent service monitors and enforces legal requirements or standards.

serviceType:RenewService.label: Renew Service
serviceType:RenewService.definition: Agent provides service to extend (renew) the validity of a credential.

serviceType:RevokeService.label: Revoke Service
serviceType:RevokeService.definition: Agent provides service to end (revoke) the validity or operation of an awarded credential.

statementCat:DevelopmentRelated.label: Development Related
statementCat:DevelopmentRelated.definition: Statement that defines commitments to joint development or future collaboration.
statementCat:DevelopmentRelated.comment: May include curriculum alignment, program expansion, or new partnerships.

statementCat:EquivalencyRequestRelated.label: Equivalency Request Related
statementCat:EquivalencyRequestRelated.definition: Statement that defines how a person requests determination of equivalency between an external academic resource and a receiving institution’s resource.
statementCat:EquivalencyRequestRelated.comment: Covers process for course, credential, or program equivalency review.

statementCat:Guarantee.label: Guarantee
statementCat:Guarantee.definition: Statement that assures a condition, right, or outcome within the agreement.
statementCat:Guarantee.comment: May include guarantees of credit acceptance, recognition, or services.

statementCat:LearningRecognitionEvidence.label: Learning Recognition Evidence Related
statementCat:LearningRecognitionEvidence.definition: Statement that defines how evidence of prior learning evidence is accepted for evaluation.

statementCat:LearningRecognitionMethodRe.label: Learning Recognition Method Related
statementCat:LearningRecognitionMethodRe.definition: Statement that defines the method(s) used to evaluate and recognize prior learning.

statementCat:LearningRecognitionOutcomeR.label: Learning Recognition Outcome Related
statementCat:LearningRecognitionOutcomeR.definition: Statement that defines the outcomes that are possible after evaluation of evidence of prior learning.

statementCat:LearningRecognitionRequestR.label: Learning Recognition Request Related
statementCat:LearningRecognitionRequestR.definition: Statement that defines how a person submits a request for recognition of prior learning.
statementCat:LearningRecognitionRequestR.comment: Covers submission steps, forms or portals, timelines, fees, and evidence requirements.

statementCat:LearningRecognitionSourceRe.label: Learning Recognition Source Related
statementCat:LearningRecognitionSourceRe.definition: Statement that defines the context from which prior learning may be recognized.

statementCat:Limitation.label: Limitation
statementCat:Limitation.definition: Statement that specifies a restriction or boundary on applicability.
statementCat:Limitation.comment: Defines conditions under which transfer or recognition does not apply.

statementCat:MarketingRelated.label: Marketing Related
statementCat:MarketingRelated.definition: Statement that defines provisions for promoting the agreement.
statementCat:MarketingRelated.comment: Covers branding, logos, co-marketing, and public announcements.

statementCat:MetricRelated.label: Metric Related
statementCat:MetricRelated.definition: Statement that defines measures or performance indicators relevant to the agreement.
statementCat:MetricRelated.comment: May include success rates, persistence, or evaluation metrics.

statementCat:MutualObligation.label: Mutual Obligation
statementCat:MutualObligation.definition: Obligation that applies equally to all parties in the agreement.
statementCat:MutualObligation.comment: Often covers shared responsibilities such as maintaining accreditation.

statementCat:NoticePeriod.label: Notice Period
statementCat:NoticePeriod.definition: Statement that defines the time required for advance notice of actions such as termination or renewal.
statementCat:NoticePeriod.comment: Often expressed in days, months, or academic terms.

statementCat:Obligation.label: Obligation
statementCat:Obligation.definition: Statement that specifies a duty or responsibility under the agreement.
statementCat:Obligation.comment: Parent concept for mutual, sender, and receiver obligations.

statementCat:Overview.label: Overview
statementCat:Overview.definition: Statement that summarizes the scope or general provisions of the agreement.
statementCat:Overview.comment: Provides a high-level description without detailed terms.

statementCat:Purpose.label: Purpose
statementCat:Purpose.definition: Statement that explains the intent or rationale of the agreement.
statementCat:Purpose.comment: Clarifies why the agreement exists and what it seeks to achieve.

statementCat:ReceiverObligation.label: Receiver Obligation
statementCat:ReceiverObligation.definition: Obligation that applies to the receiving party in the agreement.
statementCat:ReceiverObligation.comment: May include evaluating equivalency, applying transfer credit, or notifying learners.

statementCat:SenderObligation.label: Sender Obligation
statementCat:SenderObligation.definition: Obligation that applies to the sending party in the agreement.
statementCat:SenderObligation.comment: May include providing transcripts, data, or verifying learning.

statementCat:TerminationTerms.label: Termination Terms
statementCat:TerminationTerms.definition: Statement that defines conditions for ending the agreement.
statementCat:TerminationTerms.comment: Includes triggers, procedures, and effective dates for termination.

support:AcademicAdvising.label: Academic Advising
support:AcademicAdvising.definition: Personalized process that assists people in achieving educational goals and navigating academic journeys.

support:AssistiveTechnologySupport.label: Assistive Technology Support
support:AssistiveTechnologySupport.definition: Service that directly assists an individual in the selection, acquisition, or use of assistive technology devices.

support:AudiologicalHealthCare.label: Audiological Health Care
support:AudiologicalHealthCare.definition: Health care and related services covering hearing loss or impairment.

support:BehavioralService.label: Behavioral Service
support:BehavioralService.definition: Personalized service focused on addressing problem behaviors and developing positive and adaptive behaviors.

support:BenefitsSupport.label: Benefits Support
support:BenefitsSupport.definition: Service that provides guidance and assistance to people in accessing and maintaining the financial and other benefits that can support their academic and career goals.
support:BenefitsSupport.comment: This can include support in understanding and maintaining eligibility, completing related forms, and navigating application and verification processes.

support:CareerAdvising.label: Career Advising
support:CareerAdvising.definition: Personalized process that helps individuals identify and pursue their professional goals, and how to develop the skills and strategies necessary to achieve them.

support:CareerAssessment.label: Career Assessment
support:CareerAssessment.definition: Personalized process that helps individuals to identify their interests, skills, values, and personality traits, and to explore how they relate to different career paths and job opportunities.

support:CareerExploration.label: Career Exploration
support:CareerExploration.definition: Service that provides opportunities or information to discover and learn about careers.
support:CareerExploration.comment: This service can offer information and experiences about job market trends, salary expectations, working conditions and other factors that can help people identify and pursue their career goals.

support:CaseManagement.label: Case Management
support:CaseManagement.definition: Long-term, client-centered service for delivering comprehensive health and human services that involves ongoing assessment, planning, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of a client's needs and services provided.

support:Chatbot.label: Chatbot
support:Chatbot.definition: An interactive digital service that answers questions.
support:Chatbot.comment: Format and technology neutral; may be embedded on web pages or portals, may be driven by AI or similar technology.

support:Childcare.label: Childcare
support:Childcare.definition: Provision of supervision, care, and activities for children in the absence of their parents or guardians.

support:ClothingAssistance.label: Clothing Assistance
support:ClothingAssistance.definition: Service that pays for or provides clothing to people who need appropriate attire.

support:ComputerHub.label: Computer Hub
support:ComputerHub.definition: Physical location for accessing computers and other technology resources.

support:Counseling.label: Counseling
support:Counseling.definition: Personalized process that helps individuals improve their mental health and well-being by exploring their emotions, behaviors, and relationships with the guidance of a trained professional.
support:Counseling.comment: Personalized service that provides guidance and support to individuals experiencing personal, work-related, or academic challenges.

support:CreditTransferTool.label: Credit Transfer Tool
support:CreditTransferTool.definition: Online tool that estimates how previously earned credits or other types of prior learning transfers.

support:CrisisSupport.label: Crisis Support
support:CrisisSupport.definition: Services that provide immediate assistance to people who are facing unexpected challenges or crises that may interfere with their ability to pursue their academic or career goals.
support:CrisisSupport.comment: These services can include financial assistance, housing assistance, crisis hotlines, and counseling services among others.

support:DiversityEquityInclusion.label: Diversity Equity Inclusion
