support:DiversityEquityInclusion.definition: Services, programs, and initiatives that promote a welcoming and inclusive environment for individuals of all backgrounds.

support:EquipmentProvision.label: Equipment Provision
support:EquipmentProvision.definition: Service that provides people with access to the equipment, tools, or other physical resources necessary for education, training, or work.

support:FinancialLiteracy.label: Financial Literacy
support:FinancialLiteracy.definition: Provides people with the knowledge, skills, and resources necessary to make informed decisions about managing their personal finances.

support:FrequentlyAskedQuestions.label: Frequently Asked Questions
support:FrequentlyAskedQuestions.definition: A curated support resource that provides answers to common questions.
support:FrequentlyAskedQuestions.comment: Format-neutral; may be web, print, or knowledge-base.

support:HealthCare.label: Health Care
support:HealthCare.definition: Programs whose primary purpose is to help individuals achieve and maintain physical well-being through the study, prevention, screening, evaluation and treatment of individuals who have illnesses, injuries, or disabilities.

support:ImmigrationAssistance.label: Immigration Assistance
support:ImmigrationAssistance.definition: Assistance for people in navigating legal and administrative procedures involved in immigrating to a new country.
support:ImmigrationAssistance.comment: Examples include assistance with visa applications, documentation requirements, and settlement services.

support:InternetAccess.label: Internet Access
support:InternetAccess.definition: Service where individuals can connect to the internet using their own devices.

support:JobPlacement.label: Job Placement
support:JobPlacement.definition: Assistance for individuals in finding suitable work.
support:JobPlacement.comment: Examples include providing job searching and matching resources, and facilitating the application, interview, and background check processes.

support:LearningResourceProvision.label: Learning Resource Provision
support:LearningResourceProvision.definition: Service that provides people with access to educational materials.
support:LearningResourceProvision.comment: Examples of support materials include textbooks, multimedia resources, research papers, journals, and online courses.
support:LearningResourceProvision.usageNote: Use for libraries and specialized resource centers.

support:LegalService.label: Legal Service
support:LegalService.definition: Service that provides people with advice, representation, and/or support in navigating the legal system.
support:LegalService.comment: Examples include the interpretation and application of laws and regulations, and advocating for the individual's legal rights and interests.

support:MentalHealthCounseling.label: Mental Health Counseling
support:MentalHealthCounseling.definition: Personalized service that provides therapeutic support to individuals experiencing mental health issues such as anxiety, depression, or trauma.
support:MentalHealthCounseling.comment: Examples of mental health issues include behavior problems, emotional disturbances, personality disorders, incipient illnesses, and/or other comparable conditions.

support:Mentoring.label: Mentoring
support:Mentoring.definition: Service that pairs individuals with people experienced in professions who can offer guidance and support as they pursue their academic or career goals.

support:Networking.label: Networking
support:Networking.definition: Service that connects people with employers and professional communities to expand their professional networks and gain access to new job opportunities and career pathways.
support:Networking.comment: Examples include providing opportunities to attend networking events and connect with professionals.

support:NeurodivergenceService.label: Neurodivergence Service
support:NeurodivergenceService.comment: Neurodivergence means relating to having a mind that functions in ways that are not considered typical according to societal norms.
support:NeurodivergenceService.usageNote: Use for services relating to autism, tics/Tourettes Syndrome, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), and other similar conditions.

support:NoteTakingAssistance.label: Note Taking Assistance
support:NoteTakingAssistance.definition: Service that assists individuals to make their own record of classes or lectures.

support:PeerService.label: Peer Service
support:PeerService.definition: Service that specializes in facilitating peer interaction.
support:PeerService.comment: Examples include peer interactions such as counseling, tutoring, and leadership activities.

support:PersonalAssistance.label: Personal Assistance
support:PersonalAssistance.definition: Personalized service to help and accompany an individual who would otherwise be unable to participate in education, training, and/or work.

support:PortfolioAdvising.label: Portfolio Advising
support:PortfolioAdvising.definition: A service that helps learners plan and prepare assessment-ready portfolios aligned to defined outcomes and institutional expectations.

support:PostalAddress.label: Postal Address
support:PostalAddress.definition: Service to provide people who do not have a suitable mailing address with a means to receive their mail.
support:PostalAddress.comment: This service is intended to help individuals receive documents and correspondence.

support:PriorLearningAssessmentAdvising.label: Prior Learning Assessment Advising
support:PriorLearningAssessmentAdvising.definition: A service that guides learners in selecting, documenting, and submitting evidence for recognition of prior learning.

support:PsychologicalService.label: Psychological Service
support:PsychologicalService.definition: Personalized service that provides assessment, diagnosis, and treatment for mental health disorders.

support:PublicBenefitsCaseManagement.label: Public Benefits Case Management
support:PublicBenefitsCaseManagement.definition: Specialized, long-term, and client-centered service for delivering comprehensive public benefits services that involves ongoing assessment, planning, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of a client's needs and services provided related to public assistance programs.

support:ReaderService.label: Reader Service
support:ReaderService.definition: Service for reading text or describing visual content.
support:ReaderService.usageNote: For pre-recorded formats such as audio books use the accommodationType property with the value "AlternativeFormats".

support:Rehabilitation.label: Rehabilitation
support:Rehabilitation.definition: Service that provides a combination of treatment and education designed to restore maximum functioning, independence,  and a sense of well-being for individuals who have temporary or permanent disabilities.

support:ResidentialLiving.label: Residential Living
support:ResidentialLiving.definition: Service that provides a therapeutic living environment in community-based residential facilities for individuals with special needs, including those with emotional and/or behavioral problems.

support:RespiteCare.label: Respite Care
support:RespiteCare.definition: Service that provides temporary care to relieve a caregiver.

support:SignLanguage.label: Sign Language
support:SignLanguage.definition: Service that provides sign language interpretation.

support:SkillMapping.label: Skill Mapping
support:SkillMapping.definition: Service that helps identify and assess an individual's specific skills and qualifications to determine any gaps or overlaps in their knowledge or experience as they relate to a career pathway.
support:SkillMapping.comment: This process can identify opportunities for advanced standing, transfer credit, or other forms of recognition for their skills, which can help people save time and money in pursuit of their education or career goals.

support:StudySkills.label: Study Skills
support:StudySkills.definition: Service that provides assistance for people who want to improve their study habits, test preparation skills and test-taking techniques.

support:SubstanceAbusePrevention.label: Substance Abuse Prevention
support:SubstanceAbusePrevention.definition: Service related to preventing the misuse or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances.

support:SupportCoordination.label: Support Coordination
support:SupportCoordination.definition: Service that involves coordinating and integrating various other services to provide comprehensive support to individuals.
support:SupportCoordination.comment: Support coordination emphasizes a holistic and personalized approach where services are delivered in a comprehensive manner, rather than in isolation.
support:SupportCoordination.usageNote: Use for services known as "wraparound services" in the U.S.

support:SupportedWork.label: Supported Work
support:SupportedWork.definition: Service that helps people with special needs find and retain paid work.
support:SupportedWork.comment: This can include advocacy and support services to address behaviors and basic skills required to stay employed.

support:TalentMarketplaceSignaling.label: Talent Marketplace Signaling
support:TalentMarketplaceSignaling.definition: Service that enables employers to provide information that helps education and training providers align their offerings to current and future job opportunities.

support:TechnologyLending.label: Technology Lending
support:TechnologyLending.definition: Service that loans out technology equipment such as laptops, tablets, and other devices.

support:TestAssistance.label: Test Assistance
support:TestAssistance.definition: Service that provides assistance for people who need help in reading or writing responses to test items.

support:TransferAdmission.label: Transfer Admission
support:TransferAdmission.definition: Service that provides information and support about the criteria and process for students applying as transfer candidates rather than first-time freshmen.

support:TransferAdvising.label: Transfer Advising
support:TransferAdvising.definition: A service that helps learners understand transfer options and applicability and plan efficient pathways to their goals.
support:TransferAdvising.comment: Covers guidance on policies, prerequisites, timelines, and required documentation.

support:TransferEquivalencyTool.label: Transfer Equivalency Tool
support:TransferEquivalencyTool.definition: Searchable system showing how courses from other institutions equate to local offerings.

support:TransferOutreachEvent.label: Transfer Outreach Event
support:TransferOutreachEvent.definition: An event-based support service that informs and engages prospective transfer learners about pathways, policies, and resources.
support:TransferOutreachEvent.comment: Includes fairs, info sessions, and campus visit programming.

support:TransferTimeline.label: Transfer Timeline
support:TransferTimeline.definition: A support resource that outlines recommended steps and deadlines for completing transfer and recognition processes.

support:Translation.label: Translation
support:Translation.definition: Service that provides spoken or written language translation.
support:Translation.usageNote: For sign language, use Sign Language Service

support:Transportation.label: Transportation
support:Transportation.definition: Service that provides or arranges  transportation for people.

support:Tutoring.label: Tutoring
support:Tutoring.usageNote: Tutoring as a support service is normally provided as a supplement to a regular teaching program.

support:VisionService.label: Vision Service
support:VisionService.definition: Health care and related services related to vision loss or impairment.

ceterms:AcademicCertificate.label: Academic Certificate
ceterms:AcademicCertificate.definition: Credential awarded for successful completion of a formal education program, demonstrating requisite knowledge and skills.

ceterms:AccreditAction.label: Accredit Action
ceterms:AccreditAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent that certifies an entity as meeting a prescribed set of standards.

ceterms:AdvancedStandingAction.label: Advanced Standing Action
ceterms:AdvancedStandingAction.definition: Claim by an agent asserting that the object credential of the action provides advanced standing for a credential under the asserting agent's authority.

ceterms:AlignmentMap.label: Alignment Map
ceterms:AlignmentMap.definition: Entity comprised of a set of alignment or mapping assertions between two existing entities.

ceterms:ApprenticeshipCertificate.label: Apprentice Certificate
ceterms:ApprenticeshipCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at the Apprentice level for successful completion of an apprenticeship program in industry trades and professions.

ceterms:ApproveAction.label: Approve Action
ceterms:ApproveAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent that pronounces a favorable judgment of a credential.

ceterms:AssessmentComponent.label: Assessment Component
ceterms:AssessmentComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a direct, indirect, formative, and summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality of a resource, performance, or outcome of an action.

ceterms:AssessmentProfile.label: Assessment Profile
ceterms:AssessmentProfile.definition: Entity that describes the key characteristics of an assessment for a credential.

ceterms:AssociateDegree.label: Associate Degree
ceterms:AssociateDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing the first two years of full-time postsecondary school education.

ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedArtsDegree.label: Associate of Applied Arts Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedArtsDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing two years of full-time postsecondary school education in a technical, professional, or vocational program with an emphasis on direct employment in the arts and social sciences fields.

ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedScienceDegree.label: Associate of Applied Science Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfAppliedScienceDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing two years of full-time postsecondary school education in a technical, professional, or vocational program with an emphasis on direct employment in applied scientific and technological fields.

ceterms:AssociateOfArtsDegree.label: Associate of Arts Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfArtsDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing the first two years of full-time postsecondary school education with an emphasis in the liberal arts and sciences such as the humanities and social science fields.

ceterms:AssociateOfScienceDegree.label: Associate of Science Degree
ceterms:AssociateOfScienceDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing the first two years of full-time postsecondary school education with an emphasis in scientific and technical fields and professional fields of study.

ceterms:BachelorDegree.label: Bachelor's Degree
ceterms:BachelorDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study.

ceterms:BachelorOfArtsDegree.label: Bachelor of Arts Degree
ceterms:BachelorOfArtsDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study, with an emphasis in the liberal arts and sciences such as the humanities and social science fields.

ceterms:BachelorOfScienceDegree.label: Bachelor of Science Degree
ceterms:BachelorOfScienceDegree.definition: College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study, with an emphasis in scientific and technical fields and professional fields of study.

ceterms:Badge.label: Badge
ceterms:Badge.definition: Recognition designed to be displayed as a marker of accomplishment, activity, achievement, skill, interest, association, or identity.

ceterms:BasicComponent.label: Basic Component
ceterms:BasicComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a resource not otherwise covered by the enumerated PathwayComponent subclasses.

ceterms:BasicTechnicalCertificate.label: Basic Technical Certificate
ceterms:BasicTechnicalCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is completed within one semester, demonstrating competencies within a specific occupational area, indicating job readiness.

ceterms:Certificate.label: Certificate
ceterms:Certificate.definition: Credential which designates participation in, completion of, or demonstration of requisite knowledge and skills for a formal academic or training program, an occupation, or non-formal learning.

ceterms:CertificateOfCompletion.label: Certificate of Completion
ceterms:CertificateOfCompletion.definition: Credential that acknowledges completion of an assignment, training or other activity.

ceterms:CertificateOfParticipation.label: Certificate of Participation
ceterms:CertificateOfParticipation.definition: Credential that acknowledges attendance and/or engagement in an activity.

ceterms:Certification.label: Certification
ceterms:Certification.definition: Time-limited, revocable, renewable credential awarded by an authoritative body for demonstrating the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform specific tasks or an occupation.

ceterms:CocurricularComponent.label: Cocurricular Component
ceterms:CocurricularComponent.definition: Resource that identifies an activity, program, or informal learning experience such as a civic or service activity that supplements and complements the curriculum.

ceterms:CollectionComponent.label: Collection Component
ceterms:CollectionComponent.definition: Resource that is a proxy for the entities contained in or referenced by an external Collection, Framework, or other such list, or for the list itself.

ceterms:CompetencyComponent.label: Competency Component
ceterms:CompetencyComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a measurable or observable knowledge, skill, or ability necessary to successful performance of a person in a given context.

ceterms:ConditionManifest.label: Condition Manifest
ceterms:ConditionManifest.definition: Set of constraints, prerequisites, entry conditions, or requirements maintained at the organizational and/or sub-organizational level.

ceterms:CostManifest.label: Cost Manifest
ceterms:CostManifest.definition: Entity that describes a set of costs maintained at, and applicable across the organizational and/or sub-organizational level.

ceterms:CourseComponent.label: Course Component
ceterms:CourseComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a structured sequence of one or more learning activities that aims to develop a prescribed set of knowledge, skill, or ability of learners.

ceterms:Credential.label: Credential
ceterms:Credential.definition: Qualification, achievement, personal or organizational quality, or aspect of an identity typically used to indicate suitability.

ceterms:CredentialComponent.label: Credential Component
ceterms:CredentialComponent.definition: Resource that identifies another resource that describes qualification, achievement, personal or organizational quality, or aspect of an identity typically used to indicate suitability.

ceterms:CredentialOrganization.label: Credential Organization
ceterms:CredentialOrganization.definition: Organization that plays one or more key roles in the lifecycle of a credential.

ceterms:CredentialType.label: Credential Type
ceterms:CredentialType.definition: Type of credential as defined by an authoritative body for use within an officially regulated qualification system.

ceterms:CredentialingAction.label: Credentialing Action
ceterms:CredentialingAction.definition: Action taken by an agent affecting the status of an object entity.

ceterms:Degree.label: Degree
ceterms:Degree.definition: Academic credential conferred upon completion of a program or course of study, typically over multiple years at a college or university.

ceterms:Diploma.label: Diploma
ceterms:Diploma.definition: Credential awarded by educational institutions for successful completion of a course of study or its equivalent.

ceterms:DoctoralDegree.label: Doctoral Degree
ceterms:DoctoralDegree.definition: Highest credential award for students who have completed both a bachelor's degree and a master's degree or their equivalent as well as independent research and/or a significant project or paper.

ceterms:ExtracurricularComponent.label: Extracurricular Component
ceterms:ExtracurricularComponent.definition: Resource that identifies an activity, program, or informal learning experience that may be offered or provided by a school, college, or other organization that is not connected to a curriculum.

ceterms:FinancialAssistanceProfile.label: Financial Assistance Profile
ceterms:FinancialAssistanceProfile.definition: Entity that describes financial assistance that is offered or available.

ceterms:GeneralEducationDevelopment.label: General Education Development (GED)
ceterms:GeneralEducationDevelopment.definition: Credential awarded by examination that demonstrates that an individual has acquired secondary school-level academic skills.

ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel1Certificat.label: General Education Level 1 Certificate
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel1Certificat.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of general education courses that cover a broad range of foundational academic skills and takes less than 1 year.

ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel2Certificat.label: General Education Level 2 Certificate
ceterms:GeneralEducationLevel2Certificat.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of general education courses that takes at least 1 year that cover a broad range of foundational academic skills and takes less than 2 years to complete.

ceterms:HigherEducationLevel1Certificate.label: Higher Education Level 1 Certificate
ceterms:HigherEducationLevel1Certificate.definition: Credential awarded at the postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal higher education program that takes about one year in a specific subject.

ceterms:HigherEducationLevel2Certificate.label: Higher Education Level 2 Certificate
ceterms:HigherEducationLevel2Certificate.definition: Credential awarded at the postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal higher education program that takes about two years in a specific subject.

ceterms:Industry.label: Industry
ceterms:Industry.definition: Broad category of economic activities encompassing various sectors.

ceterms:Job.label: Job
ceterms:Job.definition: Set of responsibilities based on work roles within an occupation as defined by an employer.

ceterms:JobComponent.label: Job Component
ceterms:JobComponent.definition: Resource that identifies a work position, employment, or occupation.

ceterms:JourneymanCertificate.label: Journeyman Certificate
ceterms:JourneymanCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at the Journeyman level for successful completion of an apprenticeship program in industry trades and professions.

ceterms:LearningOpportunityProfile.label: Learning Opportunity Profile
ceterms:LearningOpportunityProfile.definition: Entity describing an educational or training opportunity.

ceterms:LearningProgram.label: Learning Program
ceterms:LearningProgram.definition: Set of learning opportunities that leads to an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate.

ceterms:License.label: License
ceterms:License.definition: Credential awarded by a government agency or other authorized organization that constitutes legal authority to do a specific job and/or utilize a specific item, system or infrastructure and are typically earned through some combination of degree or certificate attainment, certifications, assessments, work experience, and/or fees, and are time-limited and must be renewed periodically.

ceterms:MasterCertificate.label: Master Trade Certificate
ceterms:MasterCertificate.definition: Credential awarded at the Master level for demonstration of the highest level of skills and performance in industry trades and professions.

ceterms:MasterDegree.label: Master's Degree
ceterms:MasterDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent.

ceterms:MasterOfArtsDegree.label: Master of Arts Degree
ceterms:MasterOfArtsDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent, with an emphasis in the liberal arts and sciences such as the humanities and social science fields.

ceterms:MasterOfScienceDegree.label: Master of Science Degree
ceterms:MasterOfScienceDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent, with an emphasis in scientific and technical fields and professional fields of study.

ceterms:MicroCredential.label: Micro-Credential
ceterms:MicroCredential.definition: Credential that addresses a subset of field-specific knowledge, skills, or competencies; often developmental with relationships to other micro-credentials and field credentials.

ceterms:MultiComponent.label: Multi Component
ceterms:MultiComponent.definition: Resource that is a proxy for multiple entities.

ceterms:Occupation.label: Occupation
ceterms:Occupation.definition: Profession, trade, or career field that may involve training and/or a formal qualification.

ceterms:OfferAction.label: Offer Action
ceterms:OfferAction.definition: Action by an authoritative agent offering access to a entity such as a credential, learning opportunity or assessment.

ceterms:OpenBadge.label: Open Badge
ceterms:OpenBadge.definition: Visual symbol containing verifiable claims in accordance with the Open Badges specification and delivered digitally.

ceterms:Organization.label: Organization
ceterms:Organization.definition: An entity such as an association, company, corporation, club, co-operative, labor union etc.

ceterms:Pathway.label: Pathway
ceterms:Pathway.definition: Resource composed of a structured set of PathwayComponents defining points along a route to fulfillment of a goal or objective.

ceterms:PostBaccalaureateCertificate.label: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate
ceterms:PostBaccalaureateCertificate.definition: Credential award that requires completion of an organized program of study at a level beyond that of a bachelor's degree, which is designed for persons who have completed a baccalaureate degree but does not meet the requirements of a master's degree.

ceterms:PostMasterCertificate.label: Post-Master Certificate
ceterms:PostMasterCertificate.definition: Credential award that requires completion of an organized program of study beyond that of a master's degree, which is designed for persons who have completed a master's degree but does not meet the requirements of a doctor's degree.

ceterms:PreApprenticeshipCertificate.label: Pre-Apprenticeship Certificate
ceterms:PreApprenticeshipCertificate.definition: Credential awarded to indicate readiness for an apprentice-level program.

ceterms:PriorLearningPolicy.label: Prior Learning Policy
ceterms:PriorLearningPolicy.definition: Authoritative statement of rules, principles, or procedures adopted by an organization to govern decisions and actions within the scope of prior learning.

ceterms:ProcessProfile.label: Process Profile
ceterms:ProcessProfile.definition: Entity describing the type, nature, and other relevant information about a process.

ceterms:ProfessionalCertificate.label: Professional Certificate
ceterms:ProfessionalCertificate.definition: Credential awarded for demonstrating competencies in a profession or particular occupational field, including job readiness.

ceterms:ProfessionalDoctorate.label: Professional Doctorate
ceterms:ProfessionalDoctorate.definition: Doctoral degree conferred upon completion of a program providing the knowledge and skills for the recognition, credential, or license required for professional practice.

ceterms:ProficiencyCertificate.label: Proficiency Certificate
ceterms:ProficiencyCertificate.definition: Credential awarded after assessment of skills in a specific area defined by a recognized body of experts, without regard for how the skills were learned.

ceterms:QACredentialOrganization.label: QA Credential Organization
ceterms:QACredentialOrganization.definition: Quality assurance organization that plays one or more key roles in the lifecycle of a credential, learning program, or assessment.

ceterms:QualificationsFramework.label: Qualifications Framework
ceterms:QualificationsFramework.definition: Instrument for developing, classifying and issuing qualifications at international, national, regional or sectoral levels according to a set of criteria (such as descriptors) applicable to specified levels of learning outcomes.

ceterms:QualityAssuranceCredential.label: Quality Assurance Credential
ceterms:QualityAssuranceCredential.definition: Credential assuring that an organization, program, or awarded credential meets prescribed requirements and may include development and administration of qualifying examinations.

ceterms:RecognizeAction.label: Recognize Action
ceterms:RecognizeAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent acknowledging the validity of a resource.

ceterms:RegistrationAction.label: Registration Action
ceterms:RegistrationAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent that registers a resource that has been vetted, approved, and validated to meet specific criteria.

ceterms:RegulateAction.label: Regulate Action
ceterms:RegulateAction.definition: Action by an independent, neutral, and authoritative agent enforcing the legal requirements of a resource.

ceterms:RegulatoryInformation.label: Regulatory Information
ceterms:RegulatoryInformation.definition: Statements provided about a resource in order to comply with legal requirements.

ceterms:RenewAction.label: Renew Action
ceterms:RenewAction.definition: Action by an agent renewing an existing credential assertion.

ceterms:ResearchDoctorate.label: Research Doctorate
ceterms:ResearchDoctorate.definition: Doctoral degree conferred for advanced work beyond the master level, including the preparation and defense of a thesis or dissertation based on original research, or the planning and execution of an original project demonstrating substantial artistic or scholarly achievement.

ceterms:RevokeAction.label: Revoke Action
ceterms:RevokeAction.definition: Action by an agent removing an awarded credential (credential assertion) from the credential holder based on violations or failure of the holder to renew.

ceterms:RightsAction.label: Rights Action
ceterms:RightsAction.definition: Action asserting legal rights by an agent to possess, defend, transfer, license, and grant conditional access to a credential, learning opportunity, or assessment.

ceterms:ScheduledOffering.label: Scheduled Offering
ceterms:ScheduledOffering.definition: Offering of a Learning Opportunity or Assessment with a schedule associated with a specified location or modality.

ceterms:SecondaryEducationCertificate.label: Secondary Education Certificate
ceterms:SecondaryEducationCertificate.definition: Credential for successful completion of a formal secondary-level education program that is less than a diploma and does not indicate completion of secondary education graduation requirements.

ceterms:SecondarySchoolDiploma.label: Secondary School Diploma
ceterms:SecondarySchoolDiploma.definition: Diploma awarded by secondary education institutions for successful completion of a secondary school program of study.

ceterms:SpecialistDegree.label: Specialist Degree
ceterms:SpecialistDegree.definition: Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the master’s degree and less than a doctoral degree and provide specific preparation for advanced careers in a specialist field.

ceterms:SupportService.label: Support Service
ceterms:SupportService.definition: Resources and assistance that help people overcome barriers to succeed in their education and career goals.

ceterms:Task.label: Task
ceterms:Task.definition: Specific activity, typically related to performing a function or achieving a goal.

ceterms:TechnicalLevel1Certificate.label: Technical Level 1 Certificate
ceterms:TechnicalLevel1Certificate.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is more than one semester and less than 1 year, demonstrating competencies within a specific subject area or an occupational area indicating job readiness.

ceterms:TechnicalLevel2Certificate.label: Technical Level 2 Certificate
ceterms:TechnicalLevel2Certificate.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is at least 1 year but less than 2 years, demonstrating competencies within a specific subject area or in an occupational area indicating job readiness.

ceterms:TechnicalLevel3Certificate.label: Technical Level 3 Certificate
ceterms:TechnicalLevel3Certificate.definition: Credential award at a postsecondary level for successful completion of a formal education program that is at least 2 years but less than 4 years, demonstrating competencies within specific occupational areas indicating job readiness.

ceterms:TransferAgreement.label: Transfer Agreement
ceterms:TransferAgreement.definition: Formal agreement between two or more parties that specifies how prior learning is recognized, including its transfer and applicability for credit.

ceterms:TransferValueProfile.label: Transfer Value Profile
ceterms:TransferValueProfile.definition: Description of learning value from one context when transferred to another.

ceterms:VerificationServiceProfile.label: Verification Service Profile
ceterms:VerificationServiceProfile.definition: Entity describing the means by which someone can verify whether a credential has been attained.

ceterms:WorkBasedLearningCertificate.label: Work-Based Learning Certificate
ceterms:WorkBasedLearningCertificate.definition: Credential awarded for work-based learning and earn-and-learn models that meet standards and are applicable to industry, trades, occupations, and professions.

ceterms:WorkExperienceComponent.label: Work Experience Component
ceterms:WorkExperienceComponent.definition: Resource describing an activity or training through which a person gains job experience.

ceterms:WorkRole.label: Work Role
ceterms:WorkRole.definition: Collection of tasks and competencies that embody a particular function in one or more jobs.

ceterms:WorkforceDemandAction.label: Workforce Demand Action
ceterms:WorkforceDemandAction.definition: Action taken by an agent asserting that the resource being described has a workforce demand level worthy of note.
